I went for the Dexter beef shin ragu with Primitivo and Chianti. Let’s just say this is my new pasta spot. Can’t wait to come back. Thank you 🙏

I loved Padella. It was my first time eating here, and I would definitely recommend again and again! Will definitely be returning. The food was creamy, flavoursome and probably one of the best Italian places I have visited. Also in a great location, if you want to get desserts after from near-by!

Impeccable. Incredible. The service to the food quality to the atomasphere, one of the best experiences of Italian food I have ever had. So many vegetarian options. The loveliest, funny staff. Blown away, we will be back ❤️

venues.name: Bocconcino Soho
venues.description: Chic Italian dining room & bar serving traditional wood-fired pizza & homemade pasta.

reviews.text:
A beautiful spot with lively ambience, and delicious food. Definitely worth a visit if you're in Soho!!
I appreciated the thoughtful and tasty options available. Highlights for me included the vegetarian Tagliatelle with Black Summer Truffle, and the Ravioli stuffed with Spinach & Ricotta!! all of which felt indulgent and well‑prepared.
Service was warm and efficient.

The interior of the restaurant was lovely - stylish and thoughtfully designed, which made a great first impression. However, £18 for a few cherry tomatoes with buffalo cheese felt excessive, especially considering the portion size. The rest of the food was decent, but nothing that really stood out.

A rather odd moment was when my friend’s small bottle of water, which was on the table, was taken away by the staff with the promise to keep it for her - only for it never to be returned.

While the restaurant seems to aim for a fine dining experience, the details let it down. There were quite a few fruit flies around, and at one point a server (in a suit) actually had to catch one with a napkin while serving food - I had pointed it out, but still, not what you'd expect.

Our waitress was pleasant, but service was quite slow, particularly when it came time to pay. When we asked to split the bill by exact amounts, she seemed visibly annoyed, which was disappointing.

As we left, neither of the two hostesses at the front acknowledged us - no goodbye, no thank you - they were too busy chatting with each other, despite clearly seeing us leave.

We did pay the 13.5% service charge, but honestly, it didn’t feel earned. While some dishes were enjoyable, overall the experience didn’t meet expectations, and I wouldn’t return. There are plenty of other places offering better food and service for the same price - or less.

Really enjoyed their bottomless brunch! Food was delicious and our drinks were never empty. The restaurant is beautiful and loved the saxophone player. The waiters were extremely friendly and service was great. One thing to mention- we had already payed for the brunch online prior so when we received a bill on the day we had to correct this and show proof. Issue was sorted quickly though. Would definitely recommend and would come again!

Bocconcino is interesting.

Really liked the vibe, the food was quite alright.
I thought I could stomach cold cuts, but it showed me up lol. My date had a ball with the cold section though (had maybe 3 runs at it)
I opted for the Lamb Sunday roast right after, that I kinda really enjoyed. It was good.
The desserts were half good, you could feel it had some potential to be much better.

I was a bit concerned with some reviews regarding value, service, etc.
The Vibe is definitely amazing, live singer while you down prosecco is always an amazing feeling.
I suppose if I was a cold cut person, I would have had much more fun. But yeah. So it would be somewhat disingenuous to knock it outright on the basis of "Value".
(Suggestion: maybe add some plates of sautéed prawns, etc. Adds options without going out of the way.)
The service was a bit wonky initially, but someone else took over our section and it was greatly improved.

We visited for the bottomless brunch and it was fabulous. Angela who served us was so lovely as we're the rest of the staff. Our glasses never even got half empty at any point. The food was great, we skipped the oysters but the charcuterie board was tastey with lots of different bits, loved the pickled cauliflower! Then we ordered pizza and carbonara from the menu. We would definitely return and think it would be better with more people so you could try more pizzas having slices of each as after 2 we were stuffed! Live music was a real treat too, the sax player was fabulous.

venues.name: Osteria romana
venues.description: Intimate, elegant setting with a Roman theme for upscale Italian dishes made with imported produce.

address.formatted: Albert Gate Court, 3-4 Park Cl, London

venues.vicinity: Albert Gate Court, 3-4 Park Cl, London

reviews.text:
Very nice and cozy Italian restaurant in the heart of Knightsbridge.

The food is great and the service was excellent. Jesus was really nice and friendly. He came to our table all the time to check on us.

The ambiance is really charming and hearing all the different accents all around was very pleasant. It felt like Rome!

Thank you, Jesus.

A top rated place located close to Hyde park. We tried the cacio e pepe with truffles. The pasta is actually further cheesed up in a wheel for some extra indulgence. And the basic spaghetti pomodoro.
The star of the meal was the tiramisu. The best tiramisu I have had anywhere in my life. Had I known this before entering the restaurant, I'd have had 3 mugs for starters, mains and dessert. Absolutely sublime. Rich, luxurious, perfect amount of sweetness, every single thing was spot on for me. There was a father-daughter duo having a meal next to us. The daughter spilled her juice. The staff was kind enough to replace her drink. Terrific experience overall.

Best Gnocchi ever 🤤

This family-run Italian restaurant is an absolute treasure. From the moment you walk in, you're welcomed like part of the family. The atmosphere is warm, intimate, and perfect for a romantic night out or celebrating something special.

The food? Outstanding. Every dish is made with care, using original family recipes that you can truly taste in every bite. Fresh ingredients, rich flavors, and beautifully presented plates make for an unforgettable dining experience.

The staff are incredibly attentive, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what they do. You can tell they take pride in creating not just a meal, but a memorable evening.

Highly recommended — a place you’ll want to come back to again and again.

One of the best Italian restaurants and love the vibe and great hospitality!! Fabrizio provides clear explanation on the order and best service which marks a great ending of our dinner. Fabrizio also always checked on us to ensure we our time!
Roman style Gnocchi and black Truffle sauce is absolutely fantastic! Tonnarelli al Tartufo is also very yammy. You also can’t miss the beef!
We enjoy the food and great service! I would love to come back !

The waiter, Rafaello (if I’m not mistaken), was an Italian gentleman — so sweet and kind! The service was excellent and the food was absolutely delicious. We had truffle pasta, spaghetti with red sauce and sea bass, and finished with tiramisu for dessert while celebrating a birthday. Everything was perfect — great atmosphere, great food, and such a lovely experience overall. Highly recommend!

venues.name: Amalfi Ristorante - Argyll Street
venues.description: Casual, stylish restaurant preparing modern takes on Italian pizza, pasta & seafood.

address.formatted: Oxford Circus House, 25 Argyll St, London

venues.vicinity: Oxford Circus House, 25 Argyll St, London

reviews.text:
I’ll get straight to the point – this isn’t a restaurant I’d personally return to. I have to admit, I’m not the biggest fan of Italian food in general (even though I consider myself a foodie), so I’ll be a bit subjective there. But where I can be objective is in how the food was cooked, presented, and tasted.

My partner had the pasta, which was freshly made and tasted good, but it didn’t exactly blow her away – just a nice, decent dish. I had the steak, which was a premium cut, not a cheap one, but unfortunately it came out cold. It also wasn’t cooked perfectly to medium rare. It was still edible, and when the waiter asked how it was, I mentioned it was “good but cold” – though she ignored the second part and didn’t follow up or offer a solution.

The kids’ meal was generous, well-priced, and definitely one of the highlights. Cocktails were decent, and the service overall was polite and friendly. The restaurant itself was busy and felt a bit cramped – I assume they’ve added more tables to increase seating, which is understandable.

We only visited because we had a voucher, and while the overall experience was okay, if we had paid full price, I wouldn’t feel it was worth it. Just not somewhere I’d choose to come back to, unfortunately.

Really lovely atmosphere, accommodated our request to be early. Advised us NOT to order something and resulted in our bill being cheaper than if they had let us order. Food was delicious and obviously prepared fresh to order. Shout out to Monica who advised us on best dishes to order and gave us incredible service.

Georgous food, fast service.
Atmosphere stilted and staff hands off.
Lighting a bit too dim for us and toilets were not great. Whilst upstairs seating looked plush, there was a second room wirh awful bamboo seating and cheap looking decor. 15% service charge was automatically added to bill which was already expensive. Super expensive. Quite loud inside as tables close together.

Had a lovely lunch here! The pasta was perfectly cooked, the oysters were fresh, and the tiramisu was the highlight to end the meal. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and Maya and Scooter made the experience even better with their friendly and attentive service. Definitely a place I’d come back to for a great Italian lunch!

The food wasn’t too salty and everything was delicious. I was already full, but after one bite of the tiramisu I couldn’t stop until it was gone. Maya, my server, was so sweet and caring, which made the whole dinner feel really warm and enjoyable

venues.name: Bancone Covent Garden
venues.description: Housemade pastas are offered with Prosecco & espresso in a chic setting with 3 dining counters.

reviews.text:
Let me start off with their famous Silk Handkerchiefs Walnut Butter pasta: it is flawless, I can still remember the taste and feeling, definetelt would wanna eat it again. Additionally Cacio and Pepe was equally good. We also tried burrata, which is nice but a bit pricey compared to what you get.

We visitied Bancone in an early afternoon, no reservation and we were seated in 5 minutes. It is open kitchen and as we were eating we were also able to watch kitchen, which was really fun.

My only negative point is that they only accept card

ordered the silk handkerchiefs with walnut butter, the agnolotti, and the artichoke. The pasta was excellent — perfectly al dente and full of flavor. The silk handkerchiefs were my favorite; rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. The service was a bit slow, but nothing that took away from the overall great experience. Highly recommend!

We were seated on the counter and enjoyed the artichoke, sourdough, signature carbonara and gnocchi. To be honest we really found everything very tasty, the price a bit high. Pasta were all dente and tasty, and all sauces were very interesting. It wasnt just a classic sauce but there was a specific spin to it. The service was nice but quite slow. Decoration wise, it wasnt anything fancy, it is quite small and narrow. Though it is nice to see the staff cooking in front of you.

My Michelin bucket list in London!
The silk handkerchief has a really good chewy texture and is a great match with egg yolk and truffle.

The stuff might just be a little busy and missed my request, so I’ll probably need to remind them a couple of times.

The pasta were excellent.
The starter was ok
The Campari is a bit a joke, 7 pounds for a big ice cube
Dessert was tasty
2 problems :
- quantities are very very small
- the server dropped dirty cutlery on my partner s jacket while cleaning the table

He did apologize, but a commercial gesture such as offering a digestif would have been the least he could do.

All in all
2 small Campari
1 starter
2 small pasta
2 small desert and sparking water for 90 pounds 😬

venues.name: Como Garden
venues.description: Airy, plant-filled venue serving elevated Italian tapas, sides & desserts, plus wine & cocktails.

reviews.text: Went as a family of 5. Gorgeous interior! Very beautifully set out. Food was good, everything tasted great! Portions on the smaller side considering the prices. Service was ok, a bit on the slow side, but everyone was lovely. Overall I did enjoy the night, but personally I think people mainly go there because of the interior and for social media posts 😜.

The best Italian restaurant outside Italy in London! The lasagna was incredible, rich and full of flavor. We also had pizza with vegetables, pesto pasta, and a fresh salad with figs and grapes   all absolutely delicious. Excellent service and charming atmosphere. Highly recommend!

The food was okay. Nothing special. The server Lena was very very good. She went out of her way to please and serve nicely.

The manager was very standoffish and when he was asked to give napkins, he said they had run out of them and brought tissues to the table

Superb.

Service: we were greeted and sat down by a tall Caucasian gentleman (I don't know his name) and his manner was professional, upbeat and friendly. Pooja looked after us and she was delightful, filled our cup whenever necessary and plated our table correctly.

Food: I am not a huge fan of the Italian cuisine but I must say this place exceeded my expectations. The soup was delicate and bursting with just the right amount of flavours. You can taste every ingredient which has been taken care of to the utmost standard.

My partner ordered a pizza, and a slice lifted off perfectly from the plate without an excess of oil and toppings dripping off the pizza. It was flavoursome and definitely worth paying extra for because it DOES NOT taste like frozen pizza whatsoever.

We had also ordered a bruschetta - and wow! Every bite had brought a "wow" expression on my life. Each half cherry tomato on the bread was seasoned with care and the quality really comes out with each bite.

We had such a wonderful experience at Como Garden! From the moment we walked in, we were impressed by the beautiful interior and relaxing atmosphere , it really feels like a little piece of Lake Como in London. 🌿✨

The staff were warm and welcoming, and the food arrived very quickly. Every dish we tried was absolutely delicious — fresh, full of flavour, and perfectly presented. The sharing-style plates were a great way to enjoy a variety of Italian tastes together.

The combination of the vibrant greenery, elegant setting, and top-quality food made the whole evening truly enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back soon! Highly recommend for anyone looking for authentic Italian food in a stunning atmosphere.
Truly recommending, especially to our server Rayhan.🙏🏼

venues.name: Doppo
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Had a lovely meal here this weekend for my birthday. Service was lovely, very friendly and made good recommendations for the food and wine. A few times we were waiting a little longer than we’d have liked to be asked/served a drink but this didn’t spoil our experience.

The special truffle pasta and lamb cutlets were lovely, and the complimentary drink on arrival was a nice touch.

Had a fantastic Sunday lunch at Doppo. We came for the Sunday roast - it was genuinely one of the best I've had.
Rich, perfectly cooked, and full of flavour. The portions were very generous, we definitely left fuller than expected!
What really made the experience stand out was the service. Our waitress and the sommelier were both incredibly friendly.

A very small and cozy restaurant. Perfect for a date in the evening or for a family gathering on the weekend.
Offers a set menu on Sunday, with a choice of 3 starters (we went for anchovies and burrata) and a roast which is served  with broccoli and potatoes.

Amazing desserts and wine selection offering 700+ wines.
Strongly recommend.

I cannot say enough good things about Doppo! The hospitality and food are unmatched, rivaling that of a Michelin-starred experience (with a cozier atmosphere). Emilia, the owner, is beyond thoughtful, making sure each of her guests is taken care of, from welcome drinks to finishing the evening off with a sweet dessert wine - offering non-alcoholic options too. While I don't personally drink, Beppe, Doppo's in-house sommelier, provided endless knowledge for my wine drinking friends. And Doppo is no joke in the wine department; they've won several prestigious wine awards.

Our dinner's standout tastes included the locally sourced burrata, arancini, pappardelle ragu, tiramisu, and the bread - St. JOHN sourdough no less. If you have allergy restrictions, give the restaurant a heads up and they'll do their best to accommodate. We will definitely be back again. I cannot recommend a better place to catch up with friends, celebrate a job promotion, have a date night, or even host an event (on their second floor overlooking Dean Street). Doppo is one to watch!
The food was excellent.  Service got us to our show on time while never feeling rushed.  My favorite was the extensive wine list paired with a fantastic sommelier.

venues.name: manteca
venues.description: Fire-cooked nose-to-tail cuts of meat meet hand-rolled pasta in this simple, Italian-inspired diner.

reviews.text: - Incredible. Definitely coming back. Pasta was absolutely perfectly cooked to an al dente that was so satisfying. The kale sauce was the best (and cheapest). It paired so well with the white wine the lovely waitress suggested. Crab bucatini was also banging but wouldn’t get beef nduja again. The focaccia was so fluffy and great evoo. Ricotta was super lemony-so interesting. Lovely staff, lovely ambience, amazing pasta. Even tho pricey & smallish portions I’d say quality is so good it’s good value

Manteca is a real gem of London showcasing refined Italian cuisine and extensive wine list. The menu is meant to be shared, so bring your friends, grab some wine and enjoy. The flavors are excellent and you will walk away from the meal feeling fulfilled. There are subtle technique changes that could be made to the dishes that would further elevate their offerings, but the flavor is what matters and Manteca does not disappoint in that department.

Lovely restaurant. We ordered coppa, beef shin fritti, and focaccia as entrees. Ewe chop and fazzoletti as main dish, finished with a chocolate tart. Everything was well cooked and taste great. Highly recommended!

The atmosphere was so lovely, and we truly appreciated that you paid attention to the note we left when we made our reservation (we wanted a seat closer to the window). We enjoyed every dish we ordered, especially the fried olives, kale sauce pasta, and the duck. We'll definitely be back. Thank you so much! :)

I had an amazing experience! I enjoyed the crab cacio e pepe (they offer gluten-free pasta), and the steak was perfectly cooked and delicious. The wine selection, including options by the glass, is wonderful. The attention to detail was impeccable. I look forward to coming back soon! I absolutely loved it!

venues.name: Bocconcino Mayfair
venues.description: Chic Italian dining room & bar serving traditional wood-fired pizza & homemade pasta.

reviews.text: Always a fun idea to start a girls night out in Mayfair with some Italian food. Bocconcino London was the best spot to have a lively yap & get stuffed for a long night ahead. Aside from their highlight items like the lobster linguine and scallops with artichoke and mushroom, I highly recommend their cocktail menu. Since I wasn’t ready to let go of summer I got nostalgia which was infused with limoncello

We came for the Sunday bottomless brunch at Bocconcino in Mayfair and had the best experience! The buffet was incredible such a wide variety of seafood, fresh salads, desserts, Sunday roast, pasta, pizza… truly something for everyone and everything was delicious. Our server, Raphael, was fantastic attentive, friendly, and so quick and efficient with everything. The service really matched the quality of the food. A perfect spot for a Sunday treat, we’ll definitely be back!

We really enjoyed the food here. My husband and I shared the cucumber, tomato, corn, and avocado salad, which was plenty for two. I had the linguine with crab in a darker bisque sauce, and it was delicious. My husband tried the pappardelle with wild boar and really enjoyed it. We also shared a broccoli side (which was definitely frozen but cooked well) and a rocket salad with the provided vinegar and oil — the salad was flavorful and came with plenty of Parmesan.

For dessert, we had the New York cheesecake. I’m from the northeastern U.S. and have had authentic New York-style cheesecake many times. This one was good, but more pudding-like than the thick, rich texture you’d expect from classic New York cheesecake.

The wine selection is strong, though the dining room was very noisy due to a birthday party in the back, making conversation a bit difficult. Overall, a tasty meal with some room for small improvements.

The venue was lovely, but the service was disappointing. On my birthday, the waiter placed the cake without any gesture and left, and later I overheard offensive remarks in Italian. As someone who understands several languages, I found this very disrespectful. I share this feedback hoping it helps improve the courtesy and attention that such a place should reflect.

Still, I want to sincerely thank the staff members who treated me with respect and kindness (Who took care of the dishes)

The food was delicious, it is good quality but portion can be bigger, especially for the price they are charging. But overall good vibes, good service and very nice food. The burrata pizza is nice but the truffle based starter is a game changer.

venues.name: Giulia Restaurant
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My new favourite place, a true gourmet experience with such special dishes and good size portions. Menu is small but delicious and changes every month. Service is awesome, friendly, professional and very attentive. Came back after one week and planing to go back often.

Giulia is a lovely neighbourhood restaurant with amazing food. The menu changes monthly with focus on seasonal produce, so it is always a fantastic experience (needless to say I go literally every month to try the new menu). Can’t recommend it enough. One of my absolute favourites.

So happy to have booked dinner at this little gem of a restaurant for my girlfriend’s 30th birthday.

We loved all the dishes we ordered - the quality of the ingredients and the combination of flavours really shone through & the service was fantastic.

A place that will no doubt leave you wanting to come back. Highly recommend! :)

I've been meaning to leave a review since our last visit in July. Giulia's is a special place. We've been coming here since it first opened and the food has been consistently amazing. We were so lucky to have this authentic Italian restaurant five minutes away from where we lived, and Giulia and her fiancé are a fantastic team. They've created something that is truly rare, with dishes you wouldn't find in hundreds of other Italian restaurants. All delicious because you can see the passion that goes into the flavours. We've moved to Manchester now, but when we're in London next we'll make sure to treat ourselves to a meal at our favourite place, Giulia's. Thank you for always welcoming us and treating us so warmly!

Came here in early July and had a fantastic experience. Both the food and service were sublime. Gulia was warm, attentive, and made us, and other diners,  feel genuinely welcomed. The young man also working the floor was excellent. Every course impressed: the starters, pasta, and mains were beautifully prepared. The pork cheeks,  a recent addition to the menu, I believe, were especially tender and succulent. We’ll definitely be back.

venues.name: Sparrow Italia
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
The Italian food here is absolutely delicious, and the service is exceptional. Located on Bond Street, it’s incredibly convenient to get to, with a distinct "old money" vibe.

The dining atmosphere is fantastic—there’s even a wine cellar on the ground floor stocked with a wide variety of wines. While we didn’t try their desserts (we’re on a healthy diet), they likely taste amazing too. Importantly, the restaurant’s offerings fully align with our healthy eating plan.

Upscale Italian dining experience, great wine selection, beautifully crafted cocktails, elegant setting and delicious food. Also features a cigar lounge with a small selection of cigars but they do carry the good ones. Definitely recommend!

I’ve always enjoyed dining at The Sparrow and had a wonderful visit previously, so last night’s experience was a surprise. My friend and I ordered side dishes along with our mains, but the portions were far smaller than expected—especially given the price. The spinach side was £12 and the mushrooms £15, yet both arrived in what felt like a very modest serving.

The atmosphere and service were pleasant as always, but the value for these sides just didn’t match the quality I’ve come to associate with The Sparrow. I hope the restaurant can review the portion sizes or pricing so that future visits feel more in line with their usual high standards.

I went to Sparrow restaurant in Mayfair and it was a wonderful experience. The atmosphere is chic yet welcoming, making it a great spot for a memorable dinner.

For appetizers, I had the Pane al Tartufo (grilled focaccia with truffle ricotta, honey, and truffle) — an absolute highlight. For mains, I tried the veal Milanese and the Wagyu ribeye, both perfectly cooked and full of flavor. To finish, the tiramisu and the chocolate hazelnut cake were the perfect sweet ending — rich, indulgent, and beautifully presented.

Overall, delicious food, warm service, and a stylish setting — definitely one of the best dining spots in London.

The restaurant was recommended by my daughter, and I would highly recommend paying Sparrow Italian a visit; very nice Italian restaurant with 👌 quality and excellent service. The menu doesn’t contain ham products 👏 The restaurant is very nice and cozy 🇮🇹 have shared the menu and the ordered dishes ✨ My regards to the chef 🧑‍🍳

venues.name: Luca
venues.description: Warm, vintage, brick-lined restaurant featuring an elevated Italian menu & fireside terrace seating.

reviews.text: Chef's menu was pretty good value for money. Portion size was generous and definitely a decent menu with good protein. Culinary skills were clearly showcased in a variety of pasta and meat courses. Truly sensational. Bar counter was less comfortable, but when food was done to perfection, I tended to be less picky on many other things.

The fried potato was unexpectedly great, would highly recommend them as well as the scallops which were cooked perfectly complemented by the sauce. The pastas were also well presented and tasty but I did find them too salty.

The interior is beautiful and service is excellent as expected. Would be a great place for special occasions.

I’ve been to my fair share of Michelin star restaurants and Luca deservedly stands amongst the best in London. From the service, to the interior design/decor, all the way to the food. Attention to detail is something that is clearly drilled into the entire staff. The level of care and professionalism provided such a relaxed and memorable dining experience. We went for the Chefs Menu for 3 guests and every course was close to being faultless. It was a fine example of simplicity done right with fresh ingredients and textures. I found myself asking the waiter about certain elements in each course that caught my attention as I was eating.
As you would expect, the waiting staff was informative and attentive. It’s visibly obvious to see that the standards are set very high and it was hard for me to find faults with the service at any point.
Whenever I find similarities in specific dishes that I’ve had elsewhere, I tend to play the comparison game. Before going to Luca, the best fine dining pork dish I’d had was at Trinity in Clapham. On the chefs menu they served us a pork dish with beans and apricots. To say this was the standout dish by mile is an understatement, officially making it the best pork dish I’ve ever had. This is the true level of Michelin and it’s exactly what brings customers back for more.

Highly recommend

It’s a superb place - amazing ambience. Is loud but not very loud. I was here with a client. Was fun. Food was top quality and service was good.

If I had to pick one suggestion / improvement - the staff appeared to be pressurizing with respect to ordering wine. Like trying to fill the glass more quickly than we desire as then we would have to order a new bottle. This sometimes felt a bit odd. But otherwise delighted with everything I saw and received.

ITALIAN MICHELIN MAGIC 🇮🇹✨
📍 Clerkenwell, London
⭐️ 5/5
💸 ££££
🍴Craving a proper Italian fine dining experience? @lucarestaurant is that place. From the moment you step inside this stunning Clerkenwell spot, housed in a beautifully restored 18th-century building, you know you're in for something special. Awarded a #MichelinStar, it brings Italian cooking into the modern age, balancing elegance with comfort and tradition with creativity 🔥
We went for their set menu and honestly, every single course felt like a masterpiece. Top highlights? The Roast Orkney #Scallops with Jerusalem artichoke and ‘nduja: rich, spicy, and perfectly cooked. The #Parmesan Fries? Unexpected, crispy, cheesy heaven. And let’s talk about the LUCA #Tiramisù, hands down the best I’ve had in #London, creamy, bold, and just sweet enough 🤤 If you're after a refined foodie moment, this place nails it. The service is warm, the vibe is chic but not pretentious, and the food? Impeccable ⭐️

venues.name: Amor Gastronomia
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: You pop in for a bite to eat on Holow Rd and then you're whisked away to a local "osteria" in an Italian town. You can practice a few Italian words and get rewarded for trying. The food is good, the atmosphere is friendly. A good option for an evening in the area.

We celebrated my wife’s birthday at Amor Gastronomia and it was absolutely unforgettable. The food was exceptional — full of authentic Italian flavor and beautifully presented.
A special shoutout to Michele, who made the evening truly magical. His warmth, attention to detail, and personal touches elevated the entire experience. He made us feel like family and went above and beyond to make my wife’s night special.
We can’t wait to come back. Highly recommended!
I have been here twice. I met different staff's and they all are friendly. Food quality is good. Lots of options and very tasty. A cosy place with good Italian music. I will cone again for sure.

I went to this place with some friends and tried an excellent pinsa romana as well as some incredible fried gnocchi with gorgonzola. My friends, on the other hand, had a trio of delicious gnocchi and some outstanding paccheri with sausage and mushrooms. We finished off with two very good tiramisù.

I highly recommend this cosy and uniquely decorated restaurant. I’ll definitely be coming back soon to try more dishes and for the vibrant, family-like atmosphere created by the staff.
Fantastic service and delicious food! Pamela was absolutely lovely—so kind and understanding. Even when we ordered the wrong dish, she was super nice about it and got us a new one without any fuss :)

venues.name: Zuma London
venues.description: Informal, high-end Modern Japanese with sushi counter, robata grill and natural designer interior.

reviews.text:
I have such wonderful memories of this restaurant. Even though I didn’t have a reservation, they seated me at the chef’s table, which turned out to be a really fun and fascinating experience. I was dining alone, but the food portions were so generous that I left absolutely full and happy.

The first dish was sliced yellowtail sea bass — beautifully fresh, with a delicate pink color. A solid 10/10.

Next came the fried soft-shell crab with wasabi mayonnaise. The flavor was so unique and delicious that I’d definitely come back just for this. Another 10/10.

The jumbo tiger prawn followed — juicy, perfectly cooked, and simply amazing. 10/10 again.

For dessert, I had ice cream with pecan pie and sliced banana — the perfect sweet ending. 10/10.

Overall, I’ll absolutely be returning here on my next trip to London, and I’ll be recommending this place to all my friends.

Service was very good (8/10). The waiter brought out the crab but forgot the cutlery — apart from that, everything was excellent.

This has to be one of my favourite restaurants. From when you enter the restaurant you are made to feel special and welcomed. Our food was delicious and drinks…. Wow. Our waiter was very attentive, helpful and polite.

There is a great chilled vibe and you don’t feel rushed or as if you’re being hounded.

Did I mention the food is amazing.

You have to try the soft shell crab!!!! 10/10

Despite we came early for dinner and had no reservation, the staff gratefully offered
a table and accommodated us. (However make a reservation because there was a large queue by the time we left)
All the drinks we ordered were quite impeccable, really balanced flavors and  mixing top notch ingredients.
Zuma is renowned for its excellent modern Japanese cuisine and did not disappoint at all. Well umami on the dishes, fresh seafood and detailed cooking (also plenty of vegetarian options)

Service initially was horrible.

Re-ordering new drinks was a hassle, Sushi came without soy sauce and when I requested it I waited 15 minutes before losing patience and getting up to ask for it.

My waiter was definitely not on top of things- perhaps a bit green or overwhelmed as it was a busy night.

I was close to giving the restaurant a very low star rating but Natalia ended up saving the day and was truly superb and I don’t think it was her section- she deserves applause for her efforts checking numerous times with me after and being quite humble when I aired my anger.

Then Nikola (a manager) also checked on us throughout the night numerous times and was really great. He was gracious , kind and understanding and is truly a gem as well.
Had such a great experience at Zuma London! I went for the tasting menu and everything was really good, full of flavor. The cocktail I tried was also amazing.

venues.name: Kanpai Classic Soho
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Great restaurant in the heart of Soho with amazing food and experienced servers who are ready to educate you on all things Wagyu!

So many different cuts and a good selection of dishes and wines, the only thing that would have made this place more ‘fine dining’ is the decor (which looks a little cheap with low quality materials and scratched dark floors etc) and the atmosphere was rather lacking.

Otherwise a great experience and a hot spot for those with expense accounts and paid-for lunch meetings due to the price point and meat-heavy menu.

Overall a bit skeptical on this place. Is it fine dining? Is it fast casual dining? I went there and they seated us right on front of restaurant. Air-conditioning blaring on us. Asked to change direction and that helped, but the manager found this request challenging I had to ask twice. The beef tongue was good, and the rib eye fingers were good. Just not 5 star overall. Sorry can't be overly excited. The staff were pleasant - but did not have the details required on each dish to live up to the marketing of this place.

Honestly, this was the best meal I’ve had in London! We went for the full set menu and enjoyed fresh sushi, oysters, sea urchin, caviar, and an incredible meat selection. The wagyu was outstanding—tender, flavorful, and simply melted in my mouth. Each dish was prepared right in front of us by the staff and paired with unique sauces and sides that elevated the flavors even more. Highly recommended!

We had the Wagyu steak dining experience for my birthday and it was lovely! Food's the best, especially the presentation; we were well taken cared of by the superb staff, shoutout to Yip for the best service, talking us through the food and all. Very welcoming! Worth a try! They even gave me an extra dessert for my birthday! Will come back again with my friends soon!

This was my first time trying Omakase, and I absolutely loved it! The quality of the food was truly premium — every dish was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The service was also excellent, with staff who were attentive and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I’m really glad I chose to come here for my first Omakase and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a special dining experience.

venues.name: Machiya
venues.description: Traditional Japanese cuisine — with decor to match — accompanied by cocktails, whiskeys and sakes.

reviews.text: Our server was so sweet and attentive; we loved chatting with her. She recommended a delicious sake. We had the beef udon, pork donburi, grilled chicken skewers, karagae, and miso aubergine. The aubergine was a bit sweet for my taste but everything else was 10/10.

A sweet little restaurant with wonderfully cheerful staff who took care of us the whole time! We were early for our reservation which wasn't a problem - and despite a few other people already present, food was served piping hot and surprisingly quickly, especially as we ordered a mix of one main and lots of small plates together. The tonkatsu and agedashi tofu were highlights in particular - but the desserts and coffee we had were also fantastic, espwcially the matcha mille crepe. We'll be back next time we're in London! 😊

An amazing Japanese restaurant in the heart of London. The location was perfect. Just a few minutes away from Leicester square. My local friends took me there. The place is small and cozy. The chicken katsu was delicious, and the same goes for the meatballs. The service was quick and excellent, the price was great for the value.

Had an unfortunate extremely poor experience this time. Don’t think I’ll come back. The panko coating is very thinly wrapped and all fell off. From the very light color can tell it not even fried long enough. Comparing to the same dish from last year(2nd pic), this time is a complete miss. ( btw. The size shrinks  as well but I guess if you just want to have customers who come only once , it doesn’t matter).

IN LOVE WITH THEIR MATCHA DESSERTS!! 10/10 would def go back here to try their main dishes!! 💚💚

Edit: came back here a year later for my birthday dinner and the waiters came and sang happy birthday for me🥹🥹🥹 it was a heart warming experience and I really appreciated it.. one of the waiters were really nice to me as when I was done with the food, i told them I wanted to get dessert but would like to walk around first (as I was so full! Portions are huge) and she made sure the desserts I wanted were in stock 🩷

Katsu curry was great, as usual the matcha desserts are the best. Will definitely come back here!

venues.name: OITA Soho
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: This is a popular place and best to make a booking. Came on a Friday evening and it is packed with several sittings. For starters, the Takoyaki was great. We shared the salmon lovers roll. Also had the Salmon Sashimi don and Ikura don. All the seafood was fresh and large portions. Service was prompt.

We popped into OITA for lunch and left seriously impressed. The food was fresh, bold, and full of flavour — and the service was super quick too

The takoyaki was a total standout — crispy on the outside, soft and gooey inside, topped with a rich umami sauce and dancing bonito flakes. Comforting, savoury, and genuinely some of the best we’ve had.

The Fire Dragon Roll was just as good — warm, spicy, and perfectly crisp with a great balance of texture and flavour. Definitely something we’d order again.

We also had the kakuni ramen — the broth was rich and satisfying, though the pork belly was a bit firmer than expected. Still a solid, hearty bowl.

To drink, we tried a piña colada and a raspberry mojito — both super refreshing and well-made, the perfect finishing touch to a really enjoyable lunch.

@brownsugaaaa

This place is perfect. Very nice interior design and helpful staff (especially Mrs. Joanna, who has made our visit a wonderful experience, thank you!).
We ordered some sushi and fried chicken, it was really tasty. The waiting time was short and the quality of the dishes high.
We highly recommend and surely come back during next trip to London.

One of the easiest 5 stars I have. So good. Service was epic level! Wow.
Food was excellent with such a good taste. All the ingredients were super fresh.

My partner and I loved it here. The food and cocktails were fantastic. We finished everything (which we don't usually do!). It was a little snug, the tables are a tad close together, but nothing too bad.

venues.name: SUSHISAMBA London
venues.description: Creative Japanese & Latin American sushi in contemporary surroundings, plus cocktails.

reviews.text:
This was my second visit, and it was just as amazing as the first! Located on the 38th floor, the views are incredible, and the whole atmosphere feels special. The service is top-notch — the staff are always so friendly and helpful, really making you feel looked after.

The food is outstanding — the sea bass, the sushi, everything was absolutely on point. It’s one of those places where every dish tastes fresh and full of flavour. Definitely one of my favourite spots for a treat meal!

We went for an early dinner, the food was amazing. We ordered tiger makki samba roll, pork rib robata and kobe gyoza. Amazing drinks collection and our service was very welcoming!!! We reserved samba room, and seated facing the window! It was an experience next time we would probably choose the restaurant! Loved it! Definitely would visit again!!

From the moment we stepped in, the ambience, the views were absolutely spectacular…the kind that make you stop and just take it all in. The whole vibe of the restaurant felt so vibrant and elevated, yet cozy and welcoming at the same time.

The staff were so friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of all night. The food? Incredible. I had the ribs, and they were so good — tender, flavorful, just perfect. I also tried this sweet potato baked dish and some sweet corn on the side, and everything was delicious. You can tell a lot of care goes into every single plate. It’s one of those spots that leaves you smiling long after you’ve left. Definitely a must-visit when in London!

We come here for early dinner , I was super disappointed. We all went for the set menu, they took our orders. Never came back to take our drinks orders. We had to request someone to take the drinks orders. The set menu which was 90£ look likes it it had a range of different dish. All the portions are small. I don't believe it was enough for all six of us. Some came with like two bowls which is fine if the food was good. The only thing that really stood out was the lamb chops. They were okay. The prawns weren't that nice at all. The sushi was okay but I've had so much better sushi in angel for Half the price. If you're paying for the view then the view is amazing but the food not that great was expecting so much better.
We had a lovely experience for Sunday Brunch. The restaurant has magnificent views and the decor is stunning! Great menu with good variety! The food was all delicious!

venues.name: Sanjugo Victoria
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
You are absolutely brilliant!

I’ve been trying Japanese restaurant in this country and many others and you are one of the greatest no doubt. We tried many dishes and they were all outstanding.

From the reservation (I book 1hr in advance), to the service, the INCREDIBLE FOOD, the ambience, etc… NEVER CHANGE!

I will be back, over and over and over again as this amazing place is local and just discovered now! Thank you for everything and please keep up the good work 🙏🏻
What a hidden gem! I walked in on a Friday evening and was pleasantly surprised to find a seat available. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. Highly recommend!
We visited for the first time tonight and we had a great time. The food was excellent and Carla, our waitress was very kind and made our dinner perfect. Thank you and we will be definitely back !

First time eating at Sanjugo in Victoria and received excellent service from the moment we stepped through the door thank you to all the team.

Alot of great choice on the menu, the food was cooked to a very high standard with lots of flavour and filling too. Great value for money, bright, clean, peaceful and relaxing atmosphere with a lovely interior Asia design.

The management went over and above for us by accommodating the adjustments of our booking time due to travel delays. I was also able to amend the reservation on Sanjugo website too ,which was helpful.

I highly recommend Sanjugo restaurant in Victoria you will love it just as much as we did.

The drinks you gave us were such a lovely touch to end our afternoon on a high.

Thank you so much and look forward to dining with you again soon
Fish was very fresh and great quality, which is difficult to find in London. The small restaurant has a nice ambience that matched the food. The staff were very friendly also.

venues.name: Maru London
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Wonderful dining experience with outstanding hospitality and delicious food. The staff are so friendly and personable whilst maintaining a professional level of service and the style of food really emphasises the qualities of each ingredient. Watching the preparation is also a fascinating and makes this a really fun evening. We also enjoyed having a tea pairing option (must be ordered in advance) which complemented the food really well.

We had an amazing Omakase experience here! The ingredients were super fresh and everything tasted delicious. There were 20 courses in total, so we were really full by the end. The chef was not only skilled but also very friendly (and good-looking!). Highly recommended!

Incredible omakase experience! The best in London for us and it took us right back to some great places we experienced in Japan. The chefs were so amazing and so was the rest of the staff and the courses were fantastic. It felt very intimate and special.

One of the best omakase experiences I’ve had in London.

The dry-aged fish like tuna and brill were incredibly flavorful, and the balance with the rice was perfect. The eel tempura handroll was a highlight - crispy, rich, and comforting.

I also loved the refreshing touches throughout the meal, like the basil lemonade shaved ice and the pink prawn with sweetcorn.

The desserts (coffee panna cotta and warabi mochi) wrapped it all up beautifully. The chefs were warm, thoughtful, and made the experience feel very personal. Highly recommend for a special night out.

The entire experience was a perfect 10 out of 10. From the exquisite food to the impeccable service—and the genuine smiles on the chefs’ faces—every detail was thoughtfully executed. The setting is wonderfully intimate, accommodating no more than 10 guests per evening, which makes the omakase experience feel truly personal. I thoroughly enjoyed every moment.

venues.name: SUSHINOEN
venues.description: Stylish modern dining room with kimono-clad staff, serving classic and modern fusion dishes.

reviews.text: As a Japanese, I was impressed by the quality of the food as well as the interior design! Really beautiful restaurant with so many staple Japanese food options😍 all the servers are so lovely, especially Haruki-san! We got some tempura, karaage for starters and makis for the main. The volcano maki and aldgate roll were their highest recommendation and did not disappoint! Their matcha crepe cake was insane! Best I’ve had outside Japan! Also get the Kirin beer on tap, it’s so good! Highly recommend this place 😍
Really amazing food and service! The atmosphere was gorgeous and overall 10/10 experience. It felt very authentic as well! Would definitely come back 🍱🍣 really good cocktails as well

The restaurant was filled with Japanese vibe and the food was perfect! I ordered a sea bass and it was perfectly cooked and the presentation was amazing! We also had the grilled aubergine with miso paste, which was unique and satisfying. Highly recommend!

This is one of my favourite places in London. I will come here every time when I am in this area. The food is fantastic nicely cook and the presentation is great. I have been to this restaurant many times and the food is always good.

Overall the choices and taste are good.
Love their Hamachi jalapeño and their special drink lemon zink (?).

Note on weekday lunch, last order around 2/2.15pm and since they close to rest at 3pm you should leave by then

venues.name: Sanjugo Shoreditch
venues.description: Classic & contemporary sushi in a cozy space with sushi bar seating & a skylight-inspired ceiling.

reviews.text: A week day first time visit to Sanjugo, we arrived slightly earlier and were were seated down. The Menus where presented and very much like coffee table books, clear and well presented. We decided and ordered our dishes and drinks. They came out quickly and the food was fine. The only comment was that my dish Chicken Katsu Curry with Rice wasnt hot as I had wished, but it was fine. Everything else was well presented and tasty and met our expectations. I would say the food was fine, but again, London has multiple eateries that offer very much the same dishes at a similar price point. If you are in the area, them drop on in and give it a try. It is close to City of London and does a lot of the City folks as well as well as the Shoreditch Tech crowd. Enjoy, a nice eating experience.

From start to finish this was an outstanding meal. The wagyu was incredibly tender and flavorful, melt in your mouth, while the Hiramasa salad was fresh and vibrant. We sampled many items from the tasting menu and every course was beautifully presented and utterly delicious. Highly recommended.

It was a good experience dining at Sanjugo. Customer service was great. Staff were attentive and they kept refilling our tea cups without us needing to ask. A special mention to the slim Chinese lady who brought us to our table and the young Japanese Guy from Mie! They even Brought out a complimentary dessert knowing it was my birthday. It was much appreciated 🍰😊. Food was needlessly to say very good also. Flavourful, presented well and value for money. We will be back!!

I don’t know what the good reviews are about. I’m assuming these people haven’t had proper Japanese food before so may not be aware. But the quality was dire. We got the sashimi set, nigiri sushi set and unagi don each. The salmon was ok in the sashimi set but the other 2 were not good. Texture was rough and not smooth like a sashimi should have been. The quality was just not there. Nigiri was also quite unpalatable. I think this is because it wasn’t as fresh as it could have been. The only good thing was unagi don, of course not the best I’ve had but for the price it was ok. Also the staff don’t really say ‘irrasshaimase’ which kind of throws you off. It’s such a small word but it sets the tone in a true Japanese restaurant. It’s more than a greeting it’s part of the whole experience which I did not receive here.

My partner and I visited your restaurant on the Bank Holiday early evening without a reservation. Although it was moderately busy, your staff kindly seated us at the counter bar. We enjoyed the lovely, cosy atmosphere and found the staff to be friendly and attentive. Drinks were served promptly, while the food took a little longer, likely due to the busy period. Desserts arrived quickly, and overall, we were very pleased with our experience. We will definitely be returning.

venues.name: High Yaki
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: UNIT 13, High Yaki, 10 Newport Pl, London

venues.vicinity: UNIT 13, High Yaki, 10 Newport Pl, London

reviews.text:
Had a mix of the bbq meats and sushi  - the scallop tataki and sea bass with black truffle rolls were standout, some of the best scallops were had.

Great stop for some quality food, quick service, well presented, gorgeous interior.

Only con: some of the bbq meats were a little chewy but may have just been a bad cut, and the salmon was a little over cooked.

They also have some great lunch deals where you can get massive portions for around £20 each.

High Yaki was amazing! It’s the best Japanese BBQ we’ve tried in London so far. It’s a lot of fun to cook your own food on the grill and everything we ordered was so tasty. We ordered the 12 kinds of beef, you get so much variety in one order and the meat is so tender - and they also include chicken, seafood and pork too! We also got the sushi variety, it was excellent quality. 10/10 would recommend

I had such a great experience at this Japanese restaurant in Chinatown. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with a nice mix of traditional Japanese style and modern design. The staff were friendly and attentive, always ready to recommend dishes and explain the menu.

The food was the real highlight—fresh sashimi that melted in the mouth, creative sushi rolls with balanced flavors, and a bowl of ramen that was rich, flavorful, and comforting. Every dish was carefully prepared and beautifully presented, showing the chefs’ attention to detail.

Considering the quality and location, the prices were very reasonable. Overall, it’s a fantastic spot for anyone who loves authentic Japanese food. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Tried High Yaki in Chinatown and it was a really fun Japanese BBQ experience. The highlight was definitely the 12-variety platter with different meats and seafood — well-marbled and grilled nicely at the table. The sushi rolls were also tasty and a nice addition to the meal.

The restaurant has a cozy vibe and it’s a great spot for groups or date nights. Service was friendly and helpful with the grill.

I can’t believe that I just found this place! Now it is one of my favourite Japanese restaurants in London! I have tried two of their bbq set meals - highly recommend the ones with beef short ribs! Beef is fresh, tender and juicy! Really good value for money too! I will definitely come back for more!

venues.name: Eat Tokyo (Soho)
venues.description: Small Japanese eatery with no-frills decor serving sushi and bento boxes, plus sharing platters.

reviews.text:
INCREDIBLE food experience!
Great value for money - good portions (it is hard now day to find a sushi restaurant with his prices!!) 100% worth the wait.
It is very popular within locals, might suggest to prepare yourselves for a queue (even tho, depending on the days, it is quite fast).

Food 12 out of 10! (Sushi speaking 🤓)

There was a queue outside and I thought it was just another gimmick BUT the food was really nice, sushi to be exact. Nice place to dine as a group, date or on your own. There was a group of 8 and the bill came to £37 (alcohol included). I recommend booking a reservation to avoid the long line.

Perfect spot to come with friends! The sushi is lovely and the portions for the Chicken Katsu Curry were very big for the price (regular on the left, large on the right). We are always welcomed by the lovely manager who is so friendly and accommodating 💖 It can get a little busy at times but so far I have been lucky, will definitely be back again soon! 🫶🏼

Wonderful restaurant and good location closed to Tottingham Court station.

We have to queue for 15mins at around 1900, it's fair.  The Sushi are taste good, the portions of soba is very large.  Most of the Sushi are fresh and taste good.

The waitress are nice and helpful, we surely will visit there again.

I love eat tokyo, the food is amazing, price to quality ratio solid, and the service is equally as great, staff is very friendly. It’s always worth the wait, me and my friends go at least a couple times a month! Can’t go wrong with the sushi and the bento boxes :)

venues.name: Hanasaki Japanese Restaurant
venues.description: From Tokyo's finest to London's tables - authentic Japanese cuisine with contemporary style. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We really love the food here. I think I would rate grilled wagyu beef and king prawn, seared toro signature sushi, soft shell crab signature sushi, truffle beef tataki are the top in London. Sooooooo good. yellow tail, grilled chicken and wagyu beef tongue also nice

An absolute gem! Having spent a lot of time in Japan, I'm always on the hunt for truly authentic Japanese food in London, and Hanasaki completely blew me away. The sushi and sashimi are incredibly fresh, a testament to their high standards. Every dish is crafted with impeccable attention to detail, from the perfect slice of fish to the beautiful presentation. If you're a purist who appreciates genuine Japanese cuisine, do yourself a favor and visit Hanasaki. It's the real deal.

This sushi restaurant offers incredibly fresh, high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere is pleasant and inviting, making for a relaxing dining experience. The service was also excellent; attentive and friendly. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for delicious sushi. It's definitely worth a visit.
Super high quality food! Staff are very welcoming and friendly as well. One of the best sushi’s that I have ever had. Will definitely come back and recommend to friends
Great experience! I tried the sushi nigiri and the prawn tempura—both were fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. A really good spot for quality sushi.

venues.name: NIJŪ
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I’ve had many opportunities to try different styles of Japanese cuisine, from traditional to modern, and dining at NIJŪ was definitely an interesting experience. The customer service was excellent, and the course menu we tried had some good dishes. However, there didn’t seem to be any real connection between each course — it felt as though each dish was created by a different chef who hadn’t spoken to the others.

The dessert was phenomenal, but again, it didn’t match or flow naturally with the rest of the meal. Overall, it was worth trying once, but I wouldn’t return.

Unfortunately, this time the experience really fell short of my expectations. The waiter was overly enthusiastic and kept hovering around my table, which made me feel uncomfortable, as if I were being watched the whole time. The restaurant was also quite noisy.

To make matters worse, I even found hair in my food — which is unacceptable. Because of this, I don’t think I’ll ever come back.

I brought my friend here to celebrate her birthday, and it was my first visit after hearing so many great things. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly greeted by the reception team who kindly showed us to our table. The atmosphere was relaxed, welcoming, and had a lovely friendly vibe.

My friend is from Japan and has really missed authentic Japanese food, I was hoping to bring her a taste of home, and this place absolutely delivered. We both thoroughly enjoyed the food and the attentive service. The quality was outstanding, some of the best Japanese cuisine we’ve had in a long time.

We went for the 3-course meal and also tried a few dishes from the à la carte menu. Everything was beautifully presented and tasted incredible. I’d definitely come back and highly recommend it, especially if you’re a fan of sashimi!

Growing up in Japan, I’ve had a lot of opportunities to try different types of Japanese from authentic to modern - it was definitely a nice experience at NIJŪ. Customer service was excellent. Each menu was good (we did a course menu). However there is no connections between each menus as if they had different chefs for each menu and didn’t talk with each other.
Dessert was phenomenal but again, not matching with the other menus that led to the dessert menu.
Once is enough and won’t return again.
Tried this new Japanese restaurant in Mayfair London. I was pleasantly surprised on the quality of food, esp tuna. The grilled Trout was something to die for. Simply amazing 👏

Came here off the back of trying Endo at the Rotunda, and was neither disappointed nor particularly impressed. The beef was cooked beautifully, with good smoke flavour but the sauces failed to complement it. The sushi was good and fresh, and the dessert was also satisfyingly sweet. Where Niju falls short of the mark is being more innovative than any other high-standard Japanese restaurant, but I can attest to the quality they provide of the usual dishes.

venues.name: ROKA Charlotte Street
venues.description: Premium sushi & grilled Japanese offerings in a refined, warmly furnished dining destination.

reviews.text: Had dinner twice this week. The first visit was almost perfect. The service was optimal from start to end. The second visit no to special. The food quality was good as always. I do remember back before the pandemic my husband and I loved it because the food was very creative and delicious. The food now days is good but no amazing. The second day the service felt rush and rude. One waiter kept pouring wine like a crazy mad man. I had to ask one the waiter to keep the rude one away from us. Another negative comment is that the noise level is overwhelming. Good luck and I hope they change the menu and soften their environment as it’s too harsh.

What a gem. We sat at the counter which gave us great views of their open kitchen so we could watch the chefs grilling. The service was prompt, and attentive. We ordered the £38 theater menu and everything was delicious and filling. The lemon chicken was some of the most tender and juiciest chickens I’ve ever had, and their dark chocolate and green tea pudding with crunchy jivara, pear ice cream for dessert was incredible.

We would 100% recommend to anyone traveling to London for a great meal and fun and lively area in the city

Simply beautiful and exquisite.
We had the premium tasting menu for four people, plus additional dishes for a vegetarian guest — and every single plate was a work of art. The presentation was stunning, and the flavours were perfectly balanced throughout. From the sushi and hot dishes to the desserts, everything was truly exceptional. We couldn’t find a single fault. There was also plenty of food, leaving us more than satisfied. A memorable dining experience from start to finish!

A perfect Japanese dining experience in central London! The decoration of the restaurant is stunning, and the robata grill in the centre is so unique! We had the avocado salmon maki, nigiri selection and chicken skewers, which all tasted delicious. Will definitely try the tasting menus next time!

A very nice Japanese style restaurant with amazing food and great service. Nice variety of dishes, beautifully presented. They are happy to accommodate various dietary requirements. The staff is amazing, very friendly and attentive. We had a great time here.

venues.name: RAI Restaurant London
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I visited Rai for my birthday lunch as a solo diner and chose the 13-course Omakase. It was an incredible, intimate experience where the chef’s expertise really shone - each dish was beautifully crafted, and watching the skill and precision behind them made it even more special. The fish was unbelievably fresh and melted in my mouth; every course felt like a new favourite. Standouts for me were the butterfish, eel with grated black truffle, spicy scallop, and the black cod main.

The service was exceptional - attentive, friendly, and made me feel very welcome dining alone. A lovely surprise was a complimentary glass of champagne and a birthday dessert with a candle, which made the whole experience extra memorable.

Rai truly delivered a 5-star dining experience and made my birthday feel very special. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to enjoy a refined and beautifully thought-out omakase in London.

Great omakase experience for our anniversary. Service was absolutely great, food was fresh and delicious! Would be great if seats were more comfortable but overall, it’s very cozy.

We had additional wagyu, but honestly wouldn’t recommend that one.

We came here to celebrate my fiance's birthday and it was the most amazing experience. The food was delicious, very fresh fish that literally melted in our mouths. The chefs were fantastic and put on an amazing show. We had the 13 course meal and it was the perfect amount of food. I'm not a big eater so I was stuffed by the end of it. You have to option to order more food if you like. They also gave us complimentary glasses of champagne for my fiance's birthday. Would definitely love to come back.

An absolutely exceptional experience at RAI! The atmosphere was elegant yet welcoming, and every dish was a true work of art. I had the privilege of meeting Chef Rai himself who not only entertained us with his warm personality, but also impressed with his incredible skill and precision in crafting sushi. Watching his mastery up close elevated the whole dining experience, each piece was both visually stunning and bursting with flavour. Truly one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in London. Highly recommended for anyone who values world-class Japanese cuisine with a personal touch!

We had our anniversary dinner here and we absolutely loved it. Definitely one of the best omakase experiences I’ve had and the best I’ve had in London. The ingredients were fresh and the chef’s creative twists on the classic nigiris were simply delicious, a scrumptious balance of flavours in every bite, and even though they used premium ingredients (otoro, ikura and uni for example), they didn’t skimp- it’s probably the first time I’ve had omakase and felt happily full afterwards. The freshly grated fresh wasabi was one of my favourite things.
Chef Padam and his team are doing a great job. Only two minuses in our opinion: the seating is a bit too crowded and in one course the rice was too moist - those are our only two minor complaints.

I’m already looking forward to our next visit.

venues.name: Uzumaki London
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Such an amazing experience. I went on the 16th of September with my friend who isn’t that interested in anime and even she was amazed with the amount of detail from the figurine shop, the decor, to the menu. Our server was Kai and he was very polite and attentive and so were the rest of the staff. They are constantly checking that everything is ok. I cannot explain how cool the art work is, I mean take a look at the pictures yourself. 10/10 experience, highly recommend.

Went to Uzumaki and understood why the reviews are so good. The food - Uchiha Ramen and edamame - was perfect and really filling. Good options of halal dishes too. Annoyingly no Japanese sodas were available that day so we had to settle for a fruit tea. My friend had the 9 tailed fox mango but did not enjoy the after taste.  Customer service was good too, with the servers being friendly and helpful.

We had such a fantastic experience at Uzumaki London. The restaurant has really great dishes with an amazing, exotic taste. It’s easily one of the best spots in London and has quickly become my most visited place.

A special mention to our server, Kay, who was absolutely wonderful. We had a small issue with the seating, but Kay immediately took action, spoke to the manager right away, and made sure we were accommodated as quickly and comfortably as possible. Throughout our meal he was attentive, professional, and genuinely made sure everything went smoothly.

Great food and incredible service. I can’t wait to come back again!

Had a wonderful anime-themed 🥷dinner experience! As an anime fan, I really enjoyed the cozy and creative atmosphere. The Naruto Ramen was absolutely amazing — the tonkotsu broth was rich, flavorful, and mouthwatering. Definitely recommend this spot to any anime lover or ramen enthusiast! 🍜✨

Best ramen I have ever had! From what I've tried, this is the only restaurant I have ever liked their ramen in London and many other cities (with halal options). I highly recommend the Beef ramen ( Bankai ramen ) which is my absolute favourite. Dango was delicious too! Staff were considerate about my needs of halal food and gave me some recommendations. Optional seasonings are available for free at the dining tables. Atmosphere there is cool too I can think of going back there when I can :) I hope there will be more branches in the south in the future!

venues.name: Chisou Sushi and Izakaya
venues.description: A sophisticated Japanese experience that's as elegant as it is flavorful. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: One of my favourite places to get high quality sushi and Japanese cuisine. The staff are always super fast and friendly. The food is fresh and delicious. They get quite busy so make sure to call ahead and make a reservation. Overall, I have never been disappointed dining here.

After hearing positive reviews from friends i was delighted to stop by Chisou on Woodstock street. After a much pleasant welcome we were greeted with warmth and kindness. The waitress was calm and patient whilst taking our order. With a full palate to choose from it was a tough call to decide but the plate took us worlds away. Savouring and enjoying every mouthful. What was noticed was the attention to detail especially with the table service, the hand towels before ordering and the prompt clearing of used dishes, topping up our glasses throughout the meal and checking in with us felt completely natural and the experience was enjoyable throughout. Highly recommended for those wishing for more from dining out in the heart of London.

Experience a fine Japanese cuisine in Mafair, London. The resturant offer variety of typical Japanese Sushi, Sashimi, noodles and much more. We ordered Kaiso slad, Chirashi, Nigiri max, Negitoro maki, Unagi maki, Tonkatsu, Unaju, Saikyo, Tempura  moriawase and Age Dahil Dofu. All are delicious. I would recommend to make reservation before hand.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Chisou Sushi is an absolute gem in the heart of London. The sushi is incredibly fresh, artfully prepared, and packed with flavor. The ambiance is warm and elegant, and the staff made us feel truly welcome from start to finish.

The highlight? The mochi ice cream dessert — soft, colorful, and the perfect sweet ending to a flawless meal. Every detail, from presentation to service, shows how much care goes into the dining experience here. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates authentic Japanese cuisine!

Our server yesterday was Owen, he was extremely kind and helpful with recommendations. He recommended things which ended up being my fave items on the menu. The chefs are incredibly skilled, I loved the quality of the food and the green tea ice cream ended everything perfectly. Thank you to all staff!

venues.name: INKO NITO - Soho
venues.description: Upscale restaurant offering sushi, inventive Japanese small plates & cocktails in a modern interior.

reviews.text: We were hoping to try their famous steak, but it was sold out. Despite that, the food was excellent, especially the burger and vegetarian noodles. The service was outstanding, thanks to a friendly waitress and manager. But the music created a slightly inappropriate atmosphere for families. Overall, great food and service, but the vibe could be better.

I had such an amazing experience at INKO NITO in Soho. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt lively, modern, and welcoming. The interior has a great energy to it – stylish but not pretentious, and perfect for both casual dining and a fun night out with friends.

The food was outstanding. Every dish we ordered was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The quality of ingredients really came through, and the creativity in the menu made it exciting to try different plates. The robata-style cooking added such a delicious smoky depth to the dishes, and everything was cooked to perfection. The flavors were bold yet balanced, and it was one of those meals where you want to keep ordering just to see what else surprises you.

Service was also excellent – attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. The staff were happy to give recommendations, and they really added to the overall positive experience.

This place is definitely worth a visit if you love Japanese-inspired cuisine with a twist. It has that perfect mix of great food, top service, and a buzzing atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends.

My husband and I used First Table for the first time to book a dinner to celebrate his birthday! We dined at Inko Nito, and we were greeted right away at the entrance by one of their staff who asked if we had a reservation. We waited for our table to be ready but due to some unforeseen issues in the kitchen, our order took some time to arrive but the staff kept us updated the whole time. They even let us take home our leftovers, which we know is usually outside their terms and conditions, so kind of them!

The food was lovely! We especially loved the bone marrow, tiger prawns, chicken yakitori, pork ribs, and the French toast dessert. Definitely worth the wait! 🤗💓

We love the place and we love the atmosphere. Staff is so welcoming and friendly, ambience is just perfect. Food is just delicious and luckily 4pm-6:30pm they have happy hours for cocktails. We have been served by Annie, amazing supervisor. Fabulous place, I hope to visit again.

Unbelievably good, so much so that I ate here on successive nights.

Food is incredible, I highly recommend the bone marrow and the tiger prawns but in truth, everything is superb

Service is friendly and efficient. I cannot recommend this place highly enough. Go, you will not be disappointed.

venues.name: Hot Stone London
venues.description: Relaxed Japanese meat outfit where diners can cook their own high-end steak on a hot volcanic stone.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Hot Stone in London. The menu offered a great selection — we ordered mocktails, salmon sushi to start, followed by grilled sea bass with sesame spinach and steamed rice, and grilled teriyaki salmon with rice and miso soup. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavour. Cherry on top was everything was halal.

The service was attentive and the ambiance was refined yet welcoming, making it an ideal spot for a relaxed evening. The only minor drawback was that the portion sizes were quite small, but the overall quality of the food and dining experience more than compensated for it. Highly recommended for anyone looking for elegant Japanese cuisine in London.

The sushi here was good but the hot stone experience not so much. They often have discount offers like 80% off summer Wagyu deal for 29.95£/ person but in my opinion it is only worth that much really and definitely not worth full price.
Olive fed British wagyu isn’t good.

Portions here are very small and service is unfortunately although friendly enough not very efficient.

The ventilation system of the restaurant is also insufficient therefore the alarm can go off frequently.

I would say if you have a discount voucher yes why not give hotstone a try but if you are planning to visit for full price I would stay away from it.

Food was amazing. The plates of sushi might have been one of the best things I have tasted. We did the 5 course sushi tasting menu for £30pp was very much worth the money. We upgraded to have drinks alongside it which was worth it for the experience. The staff were very nice and friendly. The sushi bar is right by the door and in the form of a counter. We got the 450 degree hot plate included which was a really fun experience. Would definitely come back!!

We came here yesterday to celebrate my birthday, and it was such a great experience. The place has a nice, welcoming vibe—perfect for any kind of occasion, even just catching up with friends or families.

The food was excellent and freshly made, even the raw dishes. The Wagyu was a highlight—so tender and flavorful. Service was also really good, friendly and attentive.

What impressed me most was that my husband, who’s a chef and very picky about food, rated this his best restaurant we’ve tried so far in London. That says a lot! 🙂

We came here to celebrate my birthday. Had the 5 course tasting menu offer with drinks pairing. Love the experience of grilling the meat on a hot stone and trying different food. Despite the food portions are on the smaller side, we were both full by the end! The food was very good but im not sure if its worth paying the full price for it.

venues.name: Shack-Fuyu Soho
venues.description: Izakaya-style dining for Japanese comfort food in a relaxed, bi-level setting with a counter bar.
