I usually don't like fish but all the fish dishes were spectacular. Can definitely see why they got their Michelin star! Staff were all very friendly and they gave us a great seta by the window as well as a beautiful dessert to celebrate the birthday. Thank you for such a memorable meal

What a wonderful meal and experience!  It could not have been better. The staff were understanding and always helpful. Their explanations and suggestions greatly enhanced the meal.

We’re so happy that we saw the feature on CBS ‘The Dish’ and were able to visit while in London.

Definitely looking forward to our next trip! And thank you so much for the note on the menu. It’s a lovely keepsake!

Stunning dinner experience. Star of the night was the spiderweb crab. I think it's their signature. HUGE fan. Second close was the bread curry. Something in that bread. Appetizer beetroot was a pleasant surprise for me too as I usually hated beetroot. But it didn't taste like it. Will be coming back! Riesling that our sommelier pick was really nice too. Unfussed vibe despite the michelin star, some dishes can be spicy for English taste but it didn't bother us

venues.name: Smoking Goat Shoreditch
venues.description: Cool, laid-back restaurant serving quirky dishes & drinks inspired by Bangkok’s late-night canteens.

address.formatted: Tea Building, 64 Shoreditch High St, London

venues.vicinity: Tea Building, 64 Shoreditch High St, London

reviews.text: Couldn’t leave a better review! The food and cocktails were absolutely delicious, everything we had was a must try - especially the wings, beef massaman and the mackerel. We sat at the bar in front of the kitchen, was so lovely to see all the staff getting along so well and the kiwi chef was so friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Jack who gave us great recommendations and looked after us! Can’t wait to come back soon

The fish sauce wings here are great, super sticky and crispy. They're quite expensive(~4£ each) and only sold as single wings but it is a whole wing; I would say these are a must try. They are pretty big. The crispy chicken skins were nice, but I think a dipping sauce with them would go a long way. Cocktails were good. Service was pretty slow, but overall would come back for the wings, they're very unique and some of the best in this style I've had.

I've heard for a long time about the quality of Smoking Goat, I finally had it yesterday and I already cant wait to go back! Food was absolutely delicious like 10/10 and the vibe was a nice cosy environment. It was very busy and a full restaurant throughout but not too busy to the point it affected our meal.

Special shoutout to Yasmin she made our time 12/10 due to her customer service and know how of the menu and recommendations. I asked her about what drinks she'd recommend and picked the perfect drink and she basically ended up curating our whole meal. The chill wing was one of the best chicken wings I've had all year down to the exquisite sauce. And the massaman beef cheek was to die for!! Also had a daikon salad which added another dimension and the squid was divine also.

She encouraged to try the grilled cockles which i was skeptical at first but as i love seafood and her assurance I wouldn't be disappointed and explained where in Wales they come from and how to enjoy them with the lovely sauce and im so glad we trusted her judgement, i can't wait to go back to try them again!!

5 star dining experience! Wish i could give them 6! Thanks again for everything Yasmin you are a superstar!!

Amazing food here, very interesting and delicious dishes. The bread is a must, so is the beef cheek dish, and the mussels and clams. Mussels exceptionally fresh. The mackerel and the thick noodle dish were very good, although the noodle dish seemed like it was “ all noodle” but the soup fish with the noodles had too much broth, not enough noodle. The “Asteroid” wine is excellent, as are the home made soft drinks.

Strangely and rather irritating the noodle dish came out right away and then everything else twenty minutes later. Otherwise pleasant service at the bar.

Forgot to leave a review, this was one of my favourite places in London. Staff are really friendly and the food is amazing!

If I could give the smallest improvement, it would be to please turn down the music 10% so that you can talk to your friends without shouting. Other than that, can't wait to visit again.

venues.name: Khao Bird
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: at The Globe tavern, 8 Bedale Street Upstairs, London

venues.vicinity: at The Globe tavern, 8 Bedale Street Upstairs, London

reviews.text: An underrated spot tucked above a pub and delivering amazing and strong flavours! Outstanding food with a lot of zing, creativity, and consideration. Every dish balanced textures, spices, and citrus so perfectly. My partner and I shared 2 small plates and the whole sea bass special, which was a perfect amount of food for us. The corn ribs are a must-try! The sea bass was- by far- the best sea bass I’ve had. The fry was perfect and light, the garnishes fresh and balanced, and the green coriander sauce was so bright and punchy!

Unique & Delicious
KHAO BIRD packs a punch with a creative, flavor-bursting menu of Northern Thai cuisine.
The bbq chicken is beyond amazing!
Great vibe, great staff and an overall great experience.
We went for brunch which was unexpected and still delivered on inventive offerings washed down beautifully with a Som Tam Bloody Mary or two!!

Food was very nice and came out hot. There is a 3 course meal menu which 3 of our group of 6 wanted but you can only have it if everyone at the table wants it which was disappointing but this meant we actually spent less money so that’s their choice to make. The whole Bridget jones apartment thing feels a bit mis-sold. She lived in the loft and the restaurant is on the first floor. I know the place is now a restaurant and would have changed a lot but I couldn’t even find a familiar window in the restaurant. You could see stairs going up from the restaurant which was all painted white like in the film but you couldn’t go up there. So if you’re going for the Bridget Jones experience don’t bother but if you like Thai food this was a nice place to visit. The young lady that served us was great. The cocktails were around £12 my one was so small it was like a shoot so didn’t order more. I don’t mean to sound negative we actually had a lovely time and the food was great. The Bridget blue cocktail went down well so some people in our group had 2. We also had to pay a £30 service charge which worked out £5 each. Just a warning in case you’re not expecting it.

Absolutely loved our meal here! The food was sumptuous, vibrant, and full of flavour — especially the lemongrass chicken, which was perfectly grilled and aromatic, and the som tam, which struck the perfect balance of tangy, spicy, and refreshing. We also tried the khao soi - rich, comforting, and deliciously complex.

To finish, we had the fried doughnut with cinnamon ice cream, and it was a standout — warm, crispy, and beautifully paired with the cool, spiced ice cream.

A huge thank you to the staff for their warm and attentive service. Special shoutout to Bella, who made our dining experience even more enjoyable with her friendly smile and thoughtful recommendations. She went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.

The portion sizes aren’t particularly large, but the quality and flavour more than make up for it.

The food was a mix of hits and misses and the service felt fairly average and inattentive, especially considering the restaurant wasn’t particularly busy. Between the three of us, we shared the egg tarts (this came with three different sauces and was unexpectedly good), som tam (lacked flavour), pad prik king (found the dish to lack any depth and it wasn't too spicy either), shan meatballs (good), white corn ribs (ok), Khao soi (the curry flavour was so overpowering and not like a typical Thai Khao soi), BBQ lemongrass chicken (the chicken was so succulent and the flavour was on point - this was the best dish) and for dessert, we had the cinnamon and coconut chocolate chip ice cream doughnut baos.

venues.name: Kiln
venues.description: Casual open kitchen cooking noodles & Thai-inspired dishes using wood-burning ovens and grills.

reviews.text:
Gonna go out on a limb here and say this place is just not worth the likely 45min+ wait and elevated price level. Both for the food and the experience. Food wasn’t terrible, but just not what I expected after such a long wait and the amount of hype around it. All starters were fine, but even for someone who loves and eats a lot of spice, the (presumably) Thai chilies overpowered many dishes. Skewers had nice flavor but quite fatty. Unfortunately all meats were similar, including the rump- flavor itself was nice. The one great dish that I’d happily eat again is the clay pot noodles - truly delicious. 140£~ for two people.

I think there’s a larger conversation to be had about the “reservation system” (non existent). While I can appreciate the no resi policy in a city where great restaurants are booked out in advance for months, I feel some adjustments are necessary. Not only are people waiting outside in droves, but they continue the “line” inside- the restaurant is incredibly cramped/small without people waiting for tables, but they cram people in behind the diners to keep the queue “shorter”. This makes the already loud environment even more hectic. That being said all staff was friendly, albeit understandably overwhelmed. If you can walk in without having to wait I think this is a fun place to try - just not if you have to stand around in the rain.

Kiln is amazing! The flavours are bold, the ingredients fresh, and every dish was delicious.

The service is excellent. Staff is very friendly and attentive. We even got there early on Saturday to queue before opening, so we didn’t have to wait, which made the experience even better. The atmosphere is cozy and lively, and the smoky charcoal cooking adds a really unique depth to the dishes. I’ll definitely come back when I miss the taste of home.

This was incredible - the highlight of our London food spots. We went on a Thursday at 7:30pm and it took about an hour to be seated (you can leave your name and number). The vibe of the upstairs is great with the open kitchen and bar - we were offered to sit downstairs but waited for the upstairs because of the ambience. All of the upstairs seating is at a bar so it’s best for parties of 2.

The dishes were strong. Very pork heavy menu. The highlights were the pork loin (the best pork dish I’ve ever had), jowl (the first bites were better than the last, which were chewy), sticky rice, and crab glass noodles. I didn’t know pork could be so good and the loin completely blew me away with how tender and tasty it was. They say it can take up to 45 minutes to cook so I’d recommend ordering it as soon as you’re seated.

Service was great with all the staff being friendly and attentive. They just get the ambience right - you feel like you’re at a trendy restaurant when eating here.

- super hyped and we had to wait 1.5 hours to get in as they only do walk ins. It wasn’t bad by any means- the meat was incredible quality and perfectly cooked. Had the steak, cod and chicken starters. Would definitely get those again as they were about £8-12 so I’d say decent value for good quality meat. Unfortunately the mains weren’t as good value as we got pad Thai which was £22 and for some reason the same size as a starter and didn’t even come with rice (had to order separately). I thought the spice was highest end of nice (which tbf is quite rare as often under spicey) however for Mel it was too spicey to the point she couldn’t really enjoy the texture or other flavours. The rice should’ve been illegal as SO clearly pre cooked and reheated but done so badly. Tiny portion too but not as bad as speedboat bar as only £2.50 not SIXXX for badly cooked rice. Still though badly cooked rice at a Thai restaurant (and such a renowned one) is unacceptable. I would come back if there was a

Kiln surpassed any Asian food I’ve had before, the flavors were so bold specially adding the charcoal smoke in few of the dishes it just blows you away. We had quite a few dishes and each was better than the other, the glass noodle with brown crab, the lamb skewers, the greens everything was outstanding!!!! Their Tequila Ginger and Lime cocktail was delicious as well!!!! Wish I had 3 to 4 stomachs so could have more stuff here. Recommend this place to anyone who appreciates Asian food, I would rate this the highest of all. Gerry will see you for sure on my next trip to London!!!!

venues.name: Plaza Khao Gaeng
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
My fave Thai restaurant in London!
I’ve been going here for the past three years and I love the fact that they always have a special menu that changes. It keeps the food exciting and different.

The flavours always burst in your mouth and I love spicy food too!

Truly authentic and amazing food!

The service was really good with helpful staff in making your decisions.

Truly a gem!

Was really impressed by the flavours of the dishes here. The roti bread and Morning Glory had a divine, delicate in flavour. The crust quails egg was good, but the accompanying sauce made it an excellent dish. The Massaman curry had rich flavours, and even though I didn’t sample the fried chicken dish, the other diner said that it was amazing. Many of the dishes do have a kick to them, so be mindful of that if you’re not good with hot food.

The staff were nice and attentive, they also treated us to some coconut pudding due to it being one of our parties birthday.

The only qualm I had was the fact that we were a party of three, sat at a table for two and it was quite cramped. I had to sit with my legs to the side and we couldn’t easily fit all our dishes on the table.

The food tastes really good and very authentic 🍽️ Portions are okay for the price. Service wasn’t the best, which does affect the overall experience, but would I return? Yes haha, I believe one fish can’t make the whole sea rotten ka!

Amazing Authentic Thai Food in a Buzzing Spot

Absolutely fantastic Thai food in a lively and vibrant setting. We tried three dishes, including several that are rarely found in typical Thai restaurants abroad each one was packed with flavour and clearly made with care.

The atmosphere is casual and no-frills, reminiscent of a Bangkok street food canteen. It feels like a little piece of Thailand transported straight to London. The soft drinks were also a highlight; refreshing and not overly sweet. I highly recommend the Thai iced lemon tea.

The staff were friendly and provided great customer service throughout. A must-visit for anyone craving truly authentic Thai dishes.

Tip: Make sure to book if you’re going in the evening — seating is limited. We walked in and ended up sitting at the bar facing the wall, which wasn’t ideal for sharing multiple plates, but the food made up for it

Very authentic Thai food! Highly recommend the iced milk tea, glass noodles, and pork belly – all were delicious. Although seating is limited to a set time, the service was excellent and the restaurant had a lively atmosphere with affordable prices. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu!

venues.name: Patara Knightsbridge
venues.description: Upscale venue with chic, sleek decor offering an innovative contemporary take on Thai cooking.

reviews.text: Absolutely incredible Thai food. Highly recommend the lamb massaman curry and wok fried noodles with beef. The Patara passion cocktail is also fantastic if you want to enjoy a nice refreshing beverage with your meal! We will definitely be back!

Excellent service and food!
It’s my second time dining here I really like the fried sea bass! You can tell the chef did a great job with his knife skills.
Highly recommended! It’s close to Harrods so if you are craving some legit Asian cuisine, should definitely try them out!!

reviews.author_name: สุภัทรสร ขุนเเก้ว
reviews.text: I came here for my husband’s birthday and we both had a wonderful meal! The food was sooooo tasty and all of the staff were great. I highly recommend Patara if you are looking for a Thai restaurant in London.!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Beautiful Dinner with My Husband at Patara
My husband and I had a wonderful dinner at Patara to celebrate a special evening. The atmosphere was romantic and refined, perfect for a couple’s night out. The food was outstanding—elegant, full of rich Thai flavors, and beautifully presented. We especially loved the grilled sea bass and the beef panang curry. The service was warm and attentive without being intrusive, and they made us feel truly welcome. It was the perfect setting to relax, connect, and enjoy an exceptional meal together. Highly recommended for a special night out!

Went to this fantastic restaurant last night. Went there with my wife. Upon entering the restaurant there was this foul smell of wet cloth. Anyway we were shown our table and menu given. We sat down and the smell was more intense. Basically smelly cloth was used to clean the tables. That smell was horrible.

We ordered our food from the menu. The beef and chicken is halal. The food came within 20mins. Service was excellent. The restaurant was nice and calm. It felt cosy.

The food was 5 stars. Everything we ordered tasted so good. Coming from holiday in Thailand very recently, I can say the food here is authentic. I will definitely come back here again.

venues.name: Phakoon Thai Kitchen - Earlsfield
venues.description: From Thai street food to contemporary dining - authentic flavors with modern presentation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Palace Gate Estates, 346-348 Garratt Ln, London

venues.vicinity: Palace Gate Estates, 346-348 Garratt Ln, London

reviews.text: Finally, a place that gets "hot" and "spicy" right. I specifically asked for spicy spicy and not British spicy (no offence intended here) for my takeaway order and they delivered beautifully. This place is run by a warm, friendly family. Good service, good food! I had the curry with rice and absolutely loved it! The other flavours aren't buried underneath all the heat from the chilies. Well balanced, would definitely recommend this place. The ambience looks good so hope to dine at the restaurant some day :)

A Triumphant Return to Thai Dining at Phakoon Thai

After a long hiatus from Thai restaurants, Phakoon Thai has completely rekindled my love for the cuisine. What a fantastic evening! Every dish we sampled boasted its own distinct and memorable flavor profile, a refreshing change from many unpleasant Thai restaurants out there.

The Crispy Golden Bags were a highlight—perfectly prepared and delightfully grease-free. The Chicken Satay was equally impressive, offering a wonderful smoky curry flavor and incredibly tender chicken.

We were also pleasantly surprised by the steamed sea bass fillet with ginger and the tamarind Silken tofu, both exceeding our initial expectations with their delicate yet impactful tastes.

Beyond the exquisite food, the overall experience was truly exceptional. The service was natural and perfectly attentive, never feeling intrusive. It was clear the staff were genuinely happy and eager to please, which added significantly to the welcoming atmosphere.

As a gluten-intolerant diner, I particularly appreciated Phakoon Thai's excellent accommodation. It's a huge relief to find a restaurant that caters so thoughtfully to dietary needs without compromising on flavor or experience.

Well done, Phakoon Thai, and thank you for a truly delightful evening!

Food was delicious and came out very fast. Although the food had great flavour there wasn’t all that much to it (I had the chicken massaman curry). Portions were quite decent as I was quite full after the rice and curry. I think it would have been better to make a reservation as they turned down a couple people with no reservations despite the restaurant being semi empty (there were definitely quite a few tables available). We got given a table on the basis we vacated within an hour and a half which was plenty of time. Overall, staff were nice, food was good and came out quite fast and pricing was decent as well.

A wonderful Thai restaurant with authentic Thai tea. I am so glad I took the plunge and visited this restaurant I should have known why it was always busy. I came here with one of my friends on a friend dinner date and I would highly recommend. We ordered the vegetarian starter platter and it was a good mix of foods for us to try. We then both got the pad Thai, I had chicken and she had tofu. The chicken does also come with tofu however I will say the tofu came with additional vegetables which I was envious of after trying the vegetable tempura which was 10/10. We then both had mango desserts and the only thing I found weird was my sticky rice was warm when it came out which I had never had before it was still delicious just means it was fresh. The mango was amazingly sweet which was also true for the mango sorbet/icecream. I will be visiting here again.
The best Thai I’ve ever had in London. The flavours were amazing, tasted extremely authentic, large portion size. Great service, very attentive. Really enjoyed our meal here!

venues.name: The Great THAI Kitchen
venues.description: Thai cuisine that's as vibrant as Bangkok itself - bold, beautiful, and delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Really tasty Thai food with fair but not overly sized portions and fresh ingredients. The flavors were authentic and well-balanced, and the service was friendly. The atmosphere is casual but welcoming, perfect for a relaxed meal. The only reason it’s not 5 stars is that it could’ve been a little spicier for my taste and the chicken satay was quite watery – but overall, a great spot I’d happily come back to!

I had a lovely meal at this Thai restaurant and was really impressed by the food quality and presentation. I ordered mango sticky rice, prawn cake, Pad Thai noodles, and curry with rice, and every dish was full of authentic flavour.

Tiny little place that doesn't have the capacity to seat more than 16 people, so you may have to wait for a table. But service was excellent. For a no frills place with just 2 people running front of house. They actually come check on you to make sure everything is okay. Their spicy noodles with thick rice noodles was 5/5. Generous portion and they don't use store bought dried noodles. It's proper chewy rice noodles, with a lot of minced meat and herbs in the soup base.  Better than the other Thai noodle place down the road. They also have a good dessert selection which I'll be back for.

Although the restaurant is a bit small, my friend and I had a great time here. The food was delicious, and the service was excellent. We’d definitely come back when we have a chance to visit London again :)

Authentic Thai spot with a cozy, no-frills atmosphere that really brings back memories of Bangkok. The dishes are full of traditional flavour, though the spice level is toned down for Western tastes - do ask for the prik nam pla if you want the extra heat. Wood tables and stools add to the street-style charm. Prices are very reasonable, making it great value for money. Definitely worth a visit if you're after a more genuine Thai experience.

venues.name: Nipa Thai
venues.description: Upscale Thai dining in a hotel restaurant with a panelled teak interior and original furnishings.

address.formatted: First Floor, of, Lancaster London, Lancaster Terrace, London

venues.vicinity: First Floor, of, Lancaster London, Lancaster Terrace, London

reviews.text: Booked through First Table and enjoyed a fantastic 50% off the bill. The food was absolutely delicious and tasted authentic, with prompt service and minimal wait times. Most of the staff were very friendly and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The only downside was one waitress who gave incorrect information about a menu item and rushed our order, but it didn’t take away from the overall experience. The restaurant is small and cozy, located within a lovely hotel, making it a great spot for a relaxed and enjoyable meal.

The restaurant is tucked away on the first floor of the Royal Lancaster London Hotel. You enter through the elegant marble foyer, head up the stairs, and turn right. It sets the tone beautifully.

We were greeted warmly by the manager and shown to a window table overlooking Hyde Park. Our 18:30 reservation meant the restaurant was still quiet, with only one other table occupied, a perfect start.

The menu is broad but not overwhelming. I chose the chicken and coconut soup, chicken stir-fry, and mango sorbet for dessert. Every dish was exceptional, the best Thai food I’ve had anywhere.

Service was attentive without being intrusive. The team clearly know what they’re doing and let the food speak for itself.

The whole experience reflects the setting, refined, calm, and just the right side of luxurious.

Excellent food, excellent staff. I’ll definitely be back, and would highly recommend you book a table too.

This restaurant is up there in my top 3 restaurants of all time. An absolute game changer!

I was treated to an early birthday dinner by a friend and I chose here as they were rated very highly on tripadvisor.

Had a little Google before hand on what to order and their website mentioned that chef’s favourite and known for dish was the Tom Kha soup and Prawn Pad Thai

I’d never had Tom Kha before but it’s probably one my favourite dishes of all time now - and actually I’ve had it elsewhere since and it didn’t compare! Had the prawn pad Thai too which was just delicious

My friend had the dumplings which I had a cheeky sample of too which were tasty.

Staff were friendly and attentive - probably the best service I’ve ever received.

Defo my new favourite spot! It’s located in the Royal Lancaster hotel and is a little spenny but worth it!

Nipa Thai offers a lovely atmosphere with authentic Thai decor and attentive service. The food is flavorful and well-presented, but the prices feel a bit steep for the portion sizes. Overall a good experience, but slightly overpriced for what you get. Great for a special occasion, but not ideal if you're looking for value.

This restaurant is located within Royal Lancaster, we were here for a business dinner. The food is good and recipes are various and tasty. There is a good selection of beverages. The service is kind and well organized, and portions are just right.

venues.name: Thai Square Trafalgar Square
venues.description: Contemporary Thai chain restaurant with bronze Buddhist sculptures & traditional carvings.

reviews.text:
Lovely and elite experience! The staff were very welcoming and kind, plus they confirmed  for us that the chicken was halal 🙂‍↕️

The ambiance was beautiful with lovely decor, air conditioning, and a very peaceful environment 😌

And the food was very delicious! Everything on the starters platter and mains was bursting with flavour 🤤 The soup’s broth was very good but the shrimp felt tasteless 🥲

Overall we had a great time 👍

Beautiful setting but disappointing service and portions

The restaurant has a grand entrance and is in a perfect location. The décor is lovely and feels authentic – I’d give five stars for atmosphere.

Unfortunately, the service didn’t live up to expectations. We visited during a quiet Sunday lunchtime with only two other tables occupied. The waiter seemed disinterested and inattentive. We ordered a bottle of sparkling water but weren’t given any glasses. We also had to ask for knives with our starter and call the staff over whenever we needed anything. For a high-end restaurant during a quiet period, I would expect the service to be far more attentive. One staff member who came by later was friendlier and asked about our meal, which was appreciated, but overall the service fell short.

The food was good, but the portion sizes were underwhelming for the price. The most disappointing dish was the Padang Thai beef curry – the portion was so small it didn’t even cover a bowl of rice. It was also served on a small plate rather than in a bowl, which was surprising for a curry.

Overall, a beautiful place with potential, but service and value for money need improvement.

Just a short 5-minute walk from Charing Cross, Thai Square is a lovely little spot tucked away near Trafalgar Square. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the service was top-notch. The staff were really attentive, especially Tia, who went out of her way to make sure we were looked after.

The drinks menu was great—lots of options. We went for mocktails, which were refreshing and well made. Starters were a hit too; the corn cakes and dumplings were especially tasty.

The mains came out fairly quickly, and everything was nicely cooked. We had the red chicken curry, glass noodles with prawns, Penang curry (though I was meant to get prawns and ended up with chicken, they swapped it for me but I had to wait a little so double check your dish before diving in!), and duck in sauce. The coconut rice was a standout for me - really fragrant and creamy. Just a heads-up: rice has to be ordered separately.

It was a birthday dinner, and they surprised us with a complimentary little chocolate cake and ice cream, which was a lovely touch.

The only downsides were the duck dish, which didn’t look the most appetising (though it tasted okay), and the fact there are no male toilets - just urinals.

Also one thing to note – no one asked about allergies when we ordered, so it’s worth mentioning any dietary requirements upfront just to be safe.

Overall, it was a really enjoyable evening with good food and excellent service.

Succulent, falling off the bone lamb shank curry. Papaya salad was authentic and spicy-sour-fresh, which went down very well in this hot weather. The pad see yew was sweet and delicious, with a nice bite to the noodles. One of the better Thai restos in Westminster borough.

Impressive entrance but the rest is not so. We were to the Strand but ended up here because of some issue or the other. Grand entry with an impressive statue and fountain but the service was slow though not busy, the food was a hit and miss with the duck getting the lowest score. Not sure I would go again but maybe try a different location as this can happen with restaurant chains. 3.5 is what I would give it.

venues.name: Rosa's Thai Covent Garden
venues.description: Casual eatery with a warm vibe offering typical Thai dishes made with carefully sourced ingredients.

address.formatted: Sartaj Indian Restaurant, 26 Earlham St, Seven Dials, London

venues.vicinity: Sartaj Indian Restaurant, 26 Earlham St, Seven Dials, London

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Rosa’s Thai in Covent Garden! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. A special shoutout to General Manager Nicky, who went above and beyond to make us feel at home, incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional.
The service was outstanding throughout, and the food was absolutely delicious! fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. Whether you're a Thai food lover or trying it for the first time, this place is a must-visit

Rosa’s Thai had been popping up on my Instagram feed like that one friend who won’t stop humble-bragging about their vacation 📸🍜—so naturally, I had to check it out while in London. Good call.

I started with the crispy corn fritters (yes, they’re as addictive as they sound) and then dove into the eggplant stir-fry, which honestly made me question why I don’t cook eggplant like that at home. Both dishes were packed with flavor, balanced spice, and just the right hit of comfort.

The hype? Totally justified. Rosa’s feels like one of those rare spots where vegetarians don’t just have “options”—they actually get the good stuff. 🌱 If you’re in London and looking for Thai food that doesn’t disappoint, this is it.

Ratings:
🍴 Food: 5/5
🛎 Service & Ambience: 4/5
💸 Money’s Worth: 4/5

Overall: 5/5 – A hype train I’m actually glad I boarded.

Vegan incredible! Watch out for the sauce on the fresh rolls, sweet, sour and finished with some unexpected but enjoyable heat. The drunken noodles were excellent as well. The tofu fried rive was very good, but the noodles were better...Did not have to wait as we got right in between shows at the palace theater but it did get busy as soon as we were leaving. A must try!

Fantastic lunch at Rosa’s Thai Covent Garden! The £15 Saiphin’s Lunch Deal is amazing value-generous, flavour-packed, and super satisfying. The grilled giant prawns are a must have, wrap them in lettuce with vermicelli and spicy peanut sauce… unreal! Huge thanks to Nikki for being such a warm and welcoming host, she really made our visit special. Highly recommend!

Very nice restaurant. I discovered this place by chance with my wife while exploring Covent Garden during our summer break, and we were really satisfied. The place is small but very cosy and with a nice atmosphere. The staff is very gentle and friendly (always available to explain the dishes in case of doubts), the prices are fair and the food is delicious. Highly recommended.

venues.name: Banana Tree Soho
venues.description: Pan-Asian fare served in a lively, industrial-chic restaurant with a bar & happy hours.

reviews.text:
had such a fantastic experience at Banana Tree! The food was absolutely delicious — full of flavor, fresh, and beautifully presented. What really made the visit extra special, though, was the amazing service. Ash went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. They were attentive, friendly, and made us feel truly welcome. It’s rare to find such genuine hospitality, and it really stood out.

I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend Banana Tree to anyone looking for both great food and exceptional service. Huge thanks to Ash for making the evening so enjoyable!

The food at Banana Tree was quite good. I’d give it a solid 4/5 for taste and quality. However, the dining experience was let down by the extremely slow and inattentive service.

We had to wait over 10 minutes just to get tissues, and every time we tried to get the staff’s attention to order something, they would see us but ignore and kept doing their chores, which wasted a lot of time and really affected the overall experience.

What was more disappointing was that despite the lacklustre service, the staff still expected a generous tip, which didn’t feel justified given how we were treated.

I hope the management works on training the staff to be more attentive and responsive, because the food is genuinely good and the place has potential.

I’ve returned to this Soho branch many times because of the exceptional service provided by Paula and Silvan. They’re always incredibly welcoming and know my food preferences and choices. I’m grateful to both of them and the newer team members for their dedication.

We had a fantastic experience at Banana Tree! We ordered the Pad Thai and Katsu Curry - both dishes were absolutely delicious, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. The Pad Thai was perfectly balanced with just the right amount of tang and spice, while the Katsu Curry was rich, comforting, and generously portioned.

A special shoutout to Paula, who was absolutely lovely throughout our visit. Her warm, attentive service really made our meal even more enjoyable. It’s always a pleasure to be looked after by someone so friendly and professional.

Highly recommend Banana Tree if you’re looking for tasty food and great service. We’ll definitely be back!

Stepped into the vibrant chaos of this Soho Pan-Asian spot and was immediately struck by the cool, industrial-chic vibe. The place was buzzing, the bar looked inviting, and the promise of happy hour definitely added to the allure. While the atmosphere was electric, the food itself was really good. Service was friendly but understandably stretched given how busy it was. Overall, a fun spot for a lively night out and some interesting bites.

venues.name: Champor-Champor
venues.description: Thai-Malay restaurant with candlelit balcony, decorated with exotic artefacts, silks and statues.

reviews.text:
We booked a Friday evening table for a birthday dinner, and the place was buzzing! The ambience is absolutely beautiful — very warm and aesthetic.

I’m a vegetarian and ordered the tofu butternut squash green curry with jasmine rice. It was scrumptious, filling, and served hot with a lovely touch of basil oil. The portion size was generous too.

My friends had the king prawn pad thai and chicken massaman, and they really enjoyed both — the massaman was their favourite of the night.

For dessert, we shared the chocolate chilli cheesecake, which we completely devoured!

The only downside was that the service was quite slow. I understand it was a busy evening, but it did take away a bit from the overall experience.

Still, the food and atmosphere made it a lovely evening overall. I’d happily come back!

We brought our guests here for dinner and everyone left with a smile, truly happy. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. One of our guests had never tried Thai cuisine before, yet they loved it! We were impressed as well. The team was genuinely friendly and the food was fantastic thank you!

Really enjoyed my chicken green curry, and my friend loved her vegan version too — both were delicious! It was a lovely evening overall. Just a heads-up: the restaurant gets very busy, and there’s a 2-hour dining limit, so worth keeping in mind when booking. We went on a Tuesday evening and the place was absolutely heaving.

Quick Lunch Catch-Up Done Right!
Stopped by for a quick lunch and a girls' catch-up and wow, what a treat! The food was absolutely amazing and the customer service was warm and attentive. We had the Massaman lamb shank with rice and the Massaman grilled chicken curry with roti. Both dishes were bursting with flavor, and the presentation was spot on. We’ll be back in a heartbeat!

Been here twice now and the second time was even better. Really tasty food. Great interiors with lovely, attentive staff. We had the calamari, beef salad to start and then the prawn pad Thai which was definitely the stand out! Highly recommend this place.

venues.name: Kin + Deum
venues.description: Contemporary cooking of Bangkok with cocktails in a stylishly spare, dog-friendly dining room.

reviews.text: Kin + Deum offers a warm, cozy ambiance paired with genuinely friendly service. The Thai-inspired dishes are flavorful and thoughtfully presented. The noodles were cooked to perfection, with rich, balanced flavors that really stood out. Desserts were a delightful surprise—light, creative, and satisfying. It’s also dog-friendly, making it a perfect spot for pet owners. A great choice for casual dinners or catching up with friends. Highly recommend for anyone seeking comforting food with a modern twist.

Tried their special manual, pink lychee martini, pandan chicken. All so good. The stuff here are supper helpful, and friendly. We don’t know what to order. They provided so many good recommendation. Definitely will came back.

Really delicious Thai food and generous portions. Each dish had so much flavour and the meat dishes were so tender. Standout dish was the grilled honey tamarind spare ribs and the mango cheesecake. Service was friendly and the restaurant itself was spacious, would recommend booking ahead as it does fill up in the evening.

Kin+Deum is a hidden gem that brings authentic Thai flavours to the heart of London. The menu is creative yet comforting, offering both classic dishes and modern twists that highlight fresh, high-quality ingredients. Each plate feels thoughtfully crafted, with bold spices balanced perfectly for a memorable dining experience. The atmosphere is warm, stylish, and welcoming—perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. Service is attentive and friendly without being overbearing, adding to the overall charm. Whether you’re after a quick lunch or a relaxed dinner, Kin+Deum consistently delivers delicious food and a genuine sense of hospitality. Nan really made my service enjoyable. Highly recommended.

The vibe was low key but upmarket at the same time. It was cozy and a perfect evening dinner spot. The food was fantastic- you can certainly taste each ingredient. I highly recommend the mango cheesecake! I never order cheesecake but it was recommended by my server. It absolutely fantastic!

The service was perfect- so kind and attentive! I will certainly be back!

venues.name: Chet's
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Union House Shepherds Bush Green, 65 Shepherd's Bush Grn, London

venues.vicinity: Union House Shepherds Bush Green, 65 Shepherd's Bush Grn, London

reviews.text:
I visited for both breakfast and lunch. The restaurant is located toward the middle of the building on the ground, but it's filled with natural light and has a bright, welcoming atmosphere. There are various types of seating, and if it's not too crowded, the staff will kindly let you choose the kind of seat you prefer, which makes the experience even more pleasant.
Everyone from the reception to the servers was polite and warm, and I truly appreciated the thoughtful and graceful service. Every dish I tried was carefully crafted and absolutely delicious. This is definitely a place I'd love to visit again.

We had prawn toast, pineapple fried rice, pork ribs and coconut yellow curry hake fish clams - they were all absolutely banging! Wouldn’t miss out on coconut rice & mango and banana roti. Every bite felt like we’re instantly transported back to Asia. The ambiance was cozy & service was great! The staff and the chefs were quite friendly. We will definitely come back to try their other food!

I tried Chet’s BBQ pork belly and wagyu fried rice, and I was absolutely blown away! The fried rice was full of flavor due to having so many different components and seasoning, and every bite felt like an incredible, new experience. The pork belly was also very enjoyable and my only complaint was that there wasn’t more of it on the plate! I was also quite surprised by the serving size of the fried rice; it could have easily fed 3! The service was also perfect, my waitress was attentive and helpful throughout (as I had a few questions). Definitely a 5-star experience!

Great service! Our waiter was very attentive and the food arrived quickly.

We got the hot chicken burger for £18 which came with chips, and the pineapple fried rice for £23 (which came served in a pineapple)…fun, but not the most practical to eat from!

Both were tasty, but overpriced in my opinion! They were normal portion sizes, and in my experience, you can order similar items for around £15-18 from other Thai restaurants for similar quality…

Side note, both had lots of coriander mixed in, so tell your waiter if you don’t prefer that!

Great venue with delicious food and next level service. We came here for the tingling onion and famous smash burger. Based on a review we watched.
We weren't disappointed, in fact we loved the food so much & the service stood out so we're reviewing it ourselves.
Why is it the only place in London serving the whole onion this way? Whatever, Chet's do it and do it well. That smash burger, with coriander and green chilly was juicy and delicious! Highly recommended.
Danny and Vikram have earned a shout out as they did everything to make us feel welcome & enjoy our meal.

venues.name: Patara Oxford Circus
venues.description: Modern Thai cuisine in a contemporary dining room with traditional motifs and stone sculpture.

reviews.text: I went here for my birthday and the food was amazing, definitely up there with some of the best Thai food I’ve ever had. The massaman curry was absolute perfection and the service was good as well. Highly recommend a visit if you’re a big fan of Thai food like me!

We popped into this place on a whim since it was nearby and had great reviews- it absolutely lived up to the hype!

Our waitress was incredibly kind and attentive, making the whole experience even better.

The food was fantastic and tasted genuinely authentic. My friend ordered the prawn Thai Green Curry and declared it the best she’s ever had and for someone who always orders Thai Green Curry- that’s saying something!

I went with the Vegetable Rice Noodle in brown soy sauce it was perfection.

For starters, we had the Fried Tofu and the Garlic Okra, both of which were excellent.

We’re already looking forward to coming back and trying more dishes!

This restaurant is wonderful. The service as soon as you step through the door is amazing - the staff are very friendly and attentive and make you feel very comfortable. The decor is tasteful and the furniture is comfortable.

The food is amazing, 10/10. Myself and a friend ordered 2 starters (sweetcorn fritters and vegetable spring rolls). They came out piping hot and tasted extremely fresh in the best way. For mains, 1 got the pad thai (really good, the chick was great and the noodles and veg really pulled it together so well. loved the addition option that allowed to add peanut pieces at my own pace). Second main was the chicken masseman and egg noodles (the chicken came over lit candles which allowed it to stay hot the whole
meal and as someone who doesn't always enjoy rice, the noodles were an excellent accompaniment). The portion sizes are really good too.

For drinks, lychee martini and mock tail lychee drink. They were both really tasty.

No complaints on this meal at all, will be back again for sure.

Can’t believe I just found the cheapest and most authentic Thai boat noodles in London, only £3.75 a bowl at Sen-Sen Thai Boat Noodle Shop (basement of Patara, Maddox Street)! The thin noodles are perfectly chewy, the broth is rich and comforting, and the meats are spot on. On top of that, the crispy pork crackling is addictive, the crispy prawn dumplings and fried tofu are amazing, and the longan drink with chunky fruit is the perfect finish. Honestly, this place feels just like eating in Thailand – you have to try it!

I had an amazing meal here. It was my first Thai meal experience and it was worth every penny spent. The staff are amazingly courteous and friendly. The atmosphere is serene and cozy. The bathrooms are cleaner and hygienic. And the food,….my goodness…the food. I had the lamb with coconut rice. Let me start with how quickly they came out with the food. I was expecting to stay longer than I did waiting. The presentation was very good, my appetite rose exponentially on merely sighting the food.

When I dug in, the experience was much more exhilarating! The rice was perfectly done, the grains well cooked that they just rolled off your tongue into your throat! The curry sauce….awwww. Every single spice was alive in that sauce. It has a distinct sweet taste that went straight to your brain, bursting open sacks of serotonin and dopamine.

And lastly came the lamb itself, so succulent, it was like a being extending its hands to you to be lifted off its bone.

venues.name: Kibele Restaurant
venues.description: Vibrant eatery offering classic & modern Turkish cuisine plus cocktails, live music & belly dancing.

address.formatted: devon house, 175-177 Great Portland St, London

venues.vicinity: devon house, 175-177 Great Portland St, London

reviews.text: I would have written this review the same day,no words can truly capture the customer service. Although they charge £15.50, which feels a bit on the higher side and not entirely fair, the experience made up for it. The service was excellent and so warm, the toilets were clean (though the place itself felt a little dark), and the food,what can I say? Generous portions, authentic flavours, and absolutely delicious. A must-visit for anyone who loves real, tasty food!

the food was amazing!!! would totally come back here a second time. the staff are respectful and welcoming, the environment is the perfect mix of lively and colourful and a relaxing place; and the music is calm and chill. our waiter, Ayten was amazing! she was very kind and nice.
overall, a wonderful evening; highly recommend!

Surprisingly good. Very substantial portions, which weren’t a substitute for quality. Could have been a tiny bit more seasoned.

Live saxophone music which was not too loud and made for great ambience.

Murat was our waiter, very professional yet warm demeanour.

Will be coming back soon

The food is fantastic! The meat is juicy and tender, stunning flavour!
Their baklava dessert is also amazing!
The food and drinks arrived quick.
The highlight for me was their staff, they're extremely welcoming and they make you feel home! My husband and I went there for our anniversary and Pri made sure to give us the best experience you could ask for. I wish all restaurants had an amazing staff like her. The coffee she made was also fantastic!
Overall, it was a great experience.

We celebrated our director’s birthday at Kibele, and it was a great experience! The food was delicious, the ambience lovely, but what really stood out was the exceptional service. Cemsit was an amazing host and took such good care of us. I’ll definitely be back!

venues.name: FIRIN
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I was desperate to find good food in London until I discovered Fırın. My personal favorite is the vegan aubergine, but honestly, everything you try there is brilliant. The people who make the food are true masters of their craft. As a Turkish person, I can say it’s one of the best of its kind.

Great great great food! So lovely. Best flavours, quick, hot and the people working here were very friendly. We had the table next to the kitchen and that’s a bit of a weird spot to be. But the food definitely made up for it.

Went here for a work event so there was about 14 of us. The food was amazing. Meze starters, delicious pide and to die for kebabs/stews. A little on the expensive side but that could be due to our drinks order. Will definitely be going back

Freshly made and tasty. Great flavors. I had lamacun and babaganoush. They were great. Wish they gave a little more bread. I tried their kombucha. It was watery. It was great to have a tea at the end too. Definitely check this little treat out.

A very simple and sophisticated concept. Had an absolutely amazing experience here. The food was all cooked on a traditional stone stove, which gave it an incredible flavour and beautifully presented. Staff were super friendly. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a memorable meal - will defo come back.

venues.name: MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT
venues.description: A taste of Turkey in the heart of London - sophisticated, authentic, and absolutely delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

venues.vicinity: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

reviews.text: Highly recommend Masa. The food was wonderful, the people were so friendly and welcoming and the place was beautiful. Also everything was reasonably priced and big portions.

This restaurant is just recently opened may be couple of weeks ago.Since it has been opened,This is my 3rd time to come and try them.

Let me start with their menu;This is traditional Turkish cuisine however with loads of choices which is not many other Turkish restaurants have.This is one of the important detail that makes them privileged.They use fresh ingredients and daily preparation is taken place.
They are you experts what they are doing

I was lucky and had a chance to talk to owner and chef.
Owner has been in this industry more then 40 years which shows the outcome anyway from the location,taste to ambiance as well as the service.He is also fantastic chef as he also prepared something special to me by himself.
He is really very down to earth and very friendly
Also very funny guy.
I really loved the way he runs the business and also hosting his guests in his restaurant.

I also talked to the main chef  as he was standing behind the open kitchen.He is very approachable.He has been industry around 35 years.He said he used to work in hotel industry and was preparing variety of dishes for around 2000 people in one go and this was just for one round and everday.This is something incredible and beyond the admiration.I did all my best to try everything on the menu and even chef’s specials.They were soo delicious.

Plus,waiters are so lovely there.They are prompt,quick,responsible,smiley and friendly.
They really know what they are doing.
I admire them.

Quality wise from a to z is that this restaurant can be one of the top 3 not just in London also all across the UK.
They deserve the best and it is a must at least to be visited once in a life time.

Highly highly recommended
The most attentive and amazing staff, ambience and incredible food. We absolutely love this restaurant, live music( but not too loud) and the wine and food is incredible. It’s a must for all foodies!
Great restaurant with amazing staff! Mustafa and Alex are professional, friendly, and truly care about quality and service. Highly recommended!
Perfect food, service exceeding perfect. Great place, I would definitely come again. Everything tasted great and we felt very well served. Would definitely come again.

venues.name: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar
venues.description: Turkish hospitality meets London sophistication - where every meal is a celebration. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
As a big fan of Middle Eastern cuisine, I can confidently say Turkish cuisine holds a special place in my heart, and this restaurant delivered wonderfully on that front. The food and quantity were amazing every cold meze we tried had a great balance of flavors, though I personally found the salt to be a pinch more than my preference. Nonetheless, well done to the chef for putting together such a delightful spread.

The atmosphere was decent not over the top, and not in your face, just right for a comfortable meal.

Service wise, it was fast and efficient, which I appreciate. However, there’s a difference between being served and feeling welcomed. While the male server was warm and smiling, the female server seemed like she was simply going through the motions, without much warmth or hospitality. These little touches make a difference, especially in an otherwise empty restaurant. Still, overall, the experience was great, and I’d happily come back for the food.

We had a fantastic experience at Ana Turkish Restaurant in Kensington! From the moment we walked in, we felt warmly welcomed. Our server Moh was absolutely wonderful – friendly, attentive, and genuinely kind. He made us feel at home and looked after us throughout the meal with such grace.

The food was incredibly tasty and truly authentic – every dish was full of flavour and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into the cooking. Whether you’re a fan of Turkish cuisine or trying it for the first time, this place will not disappoint!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a lovely atmosphere. Thank you, Moh, and the Ana team – we’ll definitely be back!

What a find! A truly delicious experience. The food is so well cooked, beautifully seasoned with such a freshness that is hard to beat. We had the best time here and the service was outstanding. Highly recommended.

Had mid-afternoon meal, very quiet but attentive service. We ordered the Ana sharer for 3/4 people and an extra side, the food was beautiful, taste and presentation! Came with a huge, tasty salad and a large side of chips. The meat was cooked perfectly and we finished everything. Finished off with some Turkish tea and baklava. Highly recommend this restaurant.
We had the cold Meze and Ana set for 2-3 persons. The food was very tasty, big portions and enjoyed my first Turkish beer. They're a relatively new business, and I would recommend supporting them.

venues.name: Gökyüzü Green Lanes
venues.description: Informal family-run Turkish spot serving classic dishes cooked in a traditional oven.

reviews.text: Visiting in the UK, this restaurant was recommended by family members living in the neighborhood. It was an excellent suggestion. The food was delicious, savory and flavorful. The portions were much larger than the menu suggested and we enjoyed it all. Your most difficult choice is narrowing your selections from their extensive menu. You won't regret this meal.

My friend who lives around Hampstead introduced me to this place last year and since then we’ve been regular here to enjoy some genuinely good Turkish food!! The service here is always nice and the mixed platter is very generous and serves delicious meats alongside salad and Turkish rice! A must have and definitely bring your friends along! Good value for money!

This time we were served by Havni & Yaren who were great hosts and we recommend them for their attention to detail and hospitality

A proper Turkish restaurant. It was such a nice experience. Nice food full of flavour and cooked properly, nice service and friendly. Really big portions. We tried a lot of dishes and apart from one dish we liked all the rest.

We celebrated my dad's birthday at Gokyuzu, and it was a truly wonderful experience from start to finish. As soon as we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, filled with a vibrant energy that made the occasion even more special.

The food was, without a doubt, the highlight of the evening. We ordered a variety of dishes, and everything was cooked to perfection. The lamacun, Adana kebab, and Turkish grilled beef cubes were incredibly tender and flavorful, clearly made with high-quality ingredients and expert grilling. The accompanying rice was light and fluffy, while the grilled peppers added a delightful touch. Each dish truly showcased authentic Turkish cuisine.

In addition to the amazing food, the service was exceptional. The staff were attentive and friendly, going out of their way to ensure we had a memorable evening. They even surprised my dad with a little something special for his birthday, which was a thoughtful gesture.

Gokyuzu is more than just a restaurant; it's a place where you can gather with loved ones and enjoy delicious food in a vibrant and welcoming setting. It was the perfect venue to celebrate my dad's birthday, and we left feeling happy and full, already looking forward to our next visit. If you're searching for a fantastic Turkish meal in a great atmosphere, look no further than Gokyuzu! Highly recommended.

We visited Gokyuzu and tried the breakfast sharing platter—it was absolutely amazing! Everything was so fresh and flavorful, and there was plenty for everyone to enjoy. My little one especially loved all the fruit and had so much fun dipping the simit into all the little spreads and treats they served. The service was also fantastic—friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. We can’t wait to come back!

venues.name: Tower Mangal
venues.description: Informal restaurant offering generous Turkish dishes & teas, plus a take-out option.

reviews.text: Great experience here! We’ve got a family with some picky eaters and everyone LOVED their food here!!! Everything was so good and the service was fantastic as well! 12/10 recommend!

This is honestly one of the best kebab places you can find in London. Whether you come with a group of friends or on your own, you’ll feel welcome and comfortable here. You can choose to grab a takeaway if you’re in a hurry, or sit down and enjoy the food in a relaxed atmosphere. The meat wrap is absolutely delicious – tender, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic and satisfying kebabs.

Arrived around 10:45pm, the staff was kind and did not hesitate to seat us right away. We ordered hummus as a starter and the tower 1 for 2 people. The amount and quality of food was astonishing! We received a plate stacked with meats and rice and veggies— all delicious! My favorite was the chicken wings as they were both flavorful and crispy. I didn’t enjoy the beef or goat too much as it was a bit too gamey for me but other people in my party enjoyed it. The hummus portion was a bit small but it was 10/10 with the bread that was served alongside. The salad and dipping sauces were tangy and very enjoyable. We were able to eat our food as the staff closed up around us and we left by 11:30pm just because we didn’t want to stay too long as they were closing— they were still taking walk in wrap orders as we left. Overall, the staff was welcoming and kind and the meal was delicious. Would recommend but maybe come a few hours before closing as the area is a bit sketchy at night.

Particularly amazing Turkish food served here. Would recommend as one of the best I’ve been to. They have some seriously skilled chefs, no messing about.
⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ for food

Stopped here on a run to eat here myself, and was served well given the full salad plate too which was a 10/10 salad bowl 🥗.

Cons:
- slightly too suggestive for tips ended up giving in.
- £3 for the ayran that’s from the plastic sealer cup (not fresh)

Overall would visit again for the food & salad with friends.

Visited 26th August 2025 (on a 4 mile jog across tower bridge)

A very pleasant restaurant with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
The food was absolutely delicious—easily a level above the usual spots in Harringay 😋
Service was excellent; the staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely took the time to connect with us, which made the experience even more enjoyable.
The bathrooms were clean, which is always a good sign of attention to detail.
We also had the chance to meet the owner, who told us the restaurant has been serving guests for 29 years—an impressive milestone that speaks to its consistency and quality.
Highly recommended!

venues.name: Efes Premium
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Food was amazing, top quality! Interiors and atmosphere were also great. Staff were lovely. Andrea served us, she was very patient, explained the menu and gave us recommendations, she was super friendly. Had the best time here :)

We visited for a birthday celebration and had a really lovely evening. The place itself is nicely decorated—modern, clean, and stylish, with a relaxed vibe that made it a nice setting for the occasion.

The food was delicious, full of flavour and well presented. You can tell a lot of thought goes into the dishes, and there was a good variety to choose from, which made it easy for everyone to find something they liked. The “Chocolate Dream” cake was a real standout—rich, indulgent, and the perfect way to end the meal.

A big shout out to our servers Ayten and Molly, who really made the evening special. They were so kind, respectful, and attentive throughout—nothing was too much trouble, and they looked after us really well.

Overall, it was a great night, and everything went smoothly. Would definitely recommend

We had a lovely breakfast here with my parents and two children. Ordered the Turkish breakfast, very tasty ! The restaurant is beautiful and the tea at the end of the meal was perfect. Will be back for lunch or dinner next time, thank you !

Efes Premium in Wimbledon is an absolute gem! From the moment we walked in, without a booking, we were greeted with such warmth and genuine hospitality – the customer service was truly outstanding. The team made us feel incredibly welcome and attended to our every need with a smile.
But it doesn't stop there; the cuisine is simply on another level. Each dish was a delightful exploration of authentic Turkish flavours, prepared with such care and precision. The quality of the food shone through in every bite – fresh ingredients, expertly seasoned and cooked to perfection. It's clear that Efes Premium takes immense pride in their culinary offerings.
If you're looking for a top-notch Turkish dining experience in Wimbledon, with exceptional service and truly high-quality food, look no further than Efes Premium. Highly, highly recommended!

I went here for lunch with my friend because I pass it everyday on my way to work and always loved the look of it.
It didn’t disappoint from the moment we arrived we were greeted with a very warm welcome.
We had the set menu (sorry I forgot to take any food pics)
I had the lamb donor wrap with chunky chips and it was absolutely flavoursome and seasoned well and cooked to perfection.
We are definitely going back soon in the evening  and will order from the main menu ( I will remember pics next time)
I will give everything about Effs a 10/10

venues.name: Ishtar
venues.description: Charcoal-grilled skewers, modern & traditional Turkish dishes, plus live music & belly dancing.

reviews.text: What a night. Me and my sister wanted to celebrate our birthday 🎂🎉🎈at this restaurant. Glad we picked this restaurant 😁! From the beginning our waiter Niko made sure we were served all our food ( including our birthday cake) he was very lovely. The atmosphere was amazing. They had a belly dancer, cabaret act and an amazing DJ. Would 100% come back.  I would recommend this restaurant. The birthday cake tasted absolutely amazing 🤩!

We recently dined at Ishtar and had a pleasant overall experience. I had reserved a table for myself and two friends over the phone. Upon arrival, we were greeted warmly by a lovely waitress, which set a positive tone for the evening. We were served complimentary bread and hummus, the hummus, in particular, was delicious.

For our mains, we ordered Incik, a Mixed Grill, and sides of Jasmine Rice. The food was full of flavour, I especially enjoyed the Chicken Kofta, which was the highlight of the meal for me. We also ordered drinks including green and red mocktails, as well as still water.

To finish, we tried a few desserts.. Chocolate Cake, Firinda Sutlac, and Künefe. The desserts were decent, not overly impressive but certainly nothing to complain about.

The atmosphere was quite nice and added to the overall experience. However, one minor drawback was the lack of attentiveness from the staff after our mains were served. No one came over to check if we needed anything further or if we were ready for desserts, so we had to call someone over and wait.

Despite this small issue, I was overall satisfied with the visit. I’d recommend trying Ishtar at least once, it’s not necessarily an everyday restaurant, but definitely worth a visit. Best wishes to the team!

Lovely service, not too pushy, food was great. Maybe I would like to see more Turkish traditional food. I was hoping for Imam Bayildi but it wasn't on the menu. Nonetheless I enjoyed it and would be back.

I liked the atmosphere.
Very elegant place.
The service was great.
Food was OK but not substantially different to Turkish restaurants across London with better presentation.
Great Turkish food and superb friendly service. Service was quite fast when we went on a Saturday evening.  Very convenient location to public transport

venues.name: The Mantl
venues.description: Turkish restaurant offering traditional cuisine & a 6-course taster menu in an easygoing setting.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend this restaurant, we ordered many different dishes, and all of them were amazing. The meat was juicy and tender, and I liked the hummus. However the salad was simple, just punch of vegetables, and the rice was alright. The bread was amazing and remarkable, we asked them to give us some more bread for takeaway, and they gave it to us for free!, which was really nice from them.
The restaurant was clean and there was attention to details, for example the bathroom soap seems to be from an expensive brand. The staff were nice with us.

The service at The Mantl was absolutely lovely – especially one waiter who spoke Turkish with us and was extremely friendly and attentive. In terms of hospitality and staff, it’s definitely a five-star experience.

However, we were a bit disappointed with the value for money. We ordered two starters and one main dish, and although the food was decent in taste, the portion sizes were very small – even for starters. The main dish was also quite minimal, and considering the prices, the portions felt overpriced.

The quality of the food was good, but not exceptional – for example, the cooking level wasn’t perfectly on point. So overall, while the service was excellent, the food experience didn’t quite justify the price tag.

Rated as one of the best Turkish restaurants in London and boy did Mantl disappoint. They took great care of each dish, from 24-30 hour marination of the best cuts of meat to delicately presenting it when serving. The food blew us away and lived up to the hype. We were well looked after by Jacob upon arrival who explained the concept and preparation of the dishes. Whilst Ali, went out his way to make us feel hospitable and looked after our children which was quite welcoming - making us want to come back.

If you're in Knightsbridge, make sure to eat something here. You will not be disappointed.

A perfect setting to explore Turkish flavors, where the food offers original notes of lesser-known but incredibly delicious tastes.
The service is also attentive. We asked for recommendations on what dishes to order, and I believe the experience was so enjoyable thanks to that.

Celebrated my birthday at Mantl and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The mixed grill for two featured premium, perfectly cooked meats that truly impressed. The atmosphere is warm and inviting - ideal for special occasions or anyone looking to savour authentic, high-quality Turkish cuisine.

Attentive service completed the package, making the whole evening feel effortlessly special. A definite 10/10 and one of the best dining experiences I’ve had recently, and will easily return again

venues.name: Cirrik 19 Numara Bos
venues.description: Contemporary, family-run ocakbasi barbeque restaurant featuring natural wines & cocktails.

reviews.text: Food was amazing! Great atmosphere and service. The owner recommended their dishes and the recommendations did not disappoint. Thank you for having us - we’ll be back.

One of the best restaurants I have ever been to. Outstanding food, incredible flavours and the staff were so attentive, kind and lovely. Couldn't fault a thing! A must try. I'd recommend every day of the week.

⭐️⭐️⭐️✨ (3.5/5)
⚖️ 5/10

Ordered via Deliveroo 🚴‍♂️ — with a promo applied, the total came to £23.25 for the Et Beyti Yoğurtlu (£15.05) and chips (£2.80) 🍟. For the price, I can’t complain — it felt fair enough 💷. Delivery took just over an hour ⏰, which was reasonable, but by the time it landed the food had already lost its freshness.

The chips were limp and stale 🥱, lacking any crispness or warmth. The rice was standard 🍚 — no seasoning, no aroma, just a plain filler on the plate. The Beyti itself was decent but uninspired 🥙: yoghurt gave it tang, the meat had some flavour, but nothing that stood out or carried that fresh-off-the-grill vibrancy 🔥.

Overall, a mediocre, mid-tier experience 😐. Edible, yes — but uninspired. I genuinely think the food would be far better fresh at the restaurant 🍽️, where the grill and seasoning could actually shine.

Would I order delivery again? ❌ Doubt it.
Would I visit in person? ✅ Most likely.

Speechless!!! Outstanding food, couldn’t fault anything! Very authentic turkish food and the most lovely staff. Will be returning on our next visit. Just try the patlican ezme (roasted aubergine) and the hummus is to die for!! A hidden gem in Dalston. Super affordable they do a lunch deal for 13.50 per person
This was the first restaurant in London that I would say was actually very good. Nice personal, interesting flavours.

venues.name: Liman Restaurant
venues.description: Mediterranean specialties dished up in an understated destination with a warm vibe.

reviews.text: I’ve been here twice for lunch — and it’s honestly out of this world! Such a cozy, welcoming atmosphere, and the staff is incredibly friendly. The food is absolutely amazing: you must try the meatballs and the chicken kebab — they’re perfection. And their fish was fresh and beautifully cooked. This is one of those places you just keep coming back to 🙌Highly recommend!

Absolutely fantastic! The lamb chops were the best lamb I’ve ever had. Succulent and cooked perfectly. The hummus starter with crispy pitta was beautiful too, and the service was brilliant. Couldn’t recommend any higher! I asked for some more sauce for the lamb because it was absolutely beautiful. Gizem was a super helpful waitress!

What a great find! I recently had dinner here and was thoroughly impressed. I kicked things off with the calamari, and let me tell you, it was a home run. It was perfectly crispy and flavorful, and they certainly don't skimp on the portion. The real star of the show, though, was the lamb shank. It was cooked to perfection—so tender it practically melted off the bone. On top of all that, the service was top-notch. The staff were on the ball, always checking in and more than happy to help with anything we needed. Highly recommend!

An absolutely wonderful experience here at Liman restaurant! We held a 70th birthday celebration and the staff were amazing, so accommodating and helpful. We were able to decorate the place to our liking and the ambience was incredible, intimate and classy. We had the set menu for our guests and the food was sooo good! A good variety, well presented and delicious. Our guests are still raving about it days later! Even when they ran out of our dessert option, they were able to pivot smoothly and offer a lovely alternative. A truly wonderful experience, we highly recommend 👌

One of the best dinners I’ve had in a while! We ordered the calamari for starters and had complimentary Turkish bread which was delicious!
The main dinner was mixed grill, lamb skewers, lamb chops and shanks which was so lovely and cooked to perfection 😋

venues.name: Hala Restaurant
venues.description: Traditional Turkish plates offered in a wood- and brick-lined setting with wagon wheel chandeliers.

reviews.text: With no exaggeration, this is the best turk food in London. It is even better in some ways than that in Istanbul. Looking for authentic flavour and craving tender cooked to perfection Mediterranean food? I highly recommend this place!

As a Turk, we were very happy to find these dishes at a restaurant in London.
The homemade mantı, içli köfte, and liver were very good.
As in classic Turkish restaurants, yoghurt-based meze and spicy sauce were served with bread before the meal.
The lahmacun was a disappointment — we had high expectations.
But unfortunately, the dough was soft, the topping was sparse, and the taste was not what we hoped for.
The ayran was also quite tasteless.
We would have been much happier if the staff had been a bit more friendly.
They offered a turkish tea after meal
desserts were very nice we had kunafa and rice pudding.
We ordered the large portion of the cop shish, but it seemed small to us.
The prices were reasonable.
We paid £35 per person

Had an incredible meal at Hala Turkish Restaurant in London. I ordered the Hala Signature Platter and was absolutely blown away — the meats were grilled to perfection, bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The selection of cold appetizers complemented the main perfectly and added a refreshing balance to the meal.

A special shoutout to Ferman, our server, who elevated the entire experience. His professionalism, attentiveness, and warm hospitality made our visit unforgettable. You can truly feel the pride he takes in his service.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for authentic Turkish cuisine paired with top-notch service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

"We had an incredible experience at Hala Restaurant! 🙌 I booked the garden area for my dad's private birthday party, and it was absolutely amazing. Our server, Abbas, was incredibly kind and helpful. The food was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. 👏 I would highly recommend this place – it truly deserves a 5-star rating for its exceptional service. 👍"

We came to Hala Wood Green Restaurant as a group of 7 friends and had an amazing time! The food was fresh, full of flavor, and served quickly even though we were a big group. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, perfect for enjoying a meal together.
A big thank you to SAMET for looking after us so well—he was friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit. His service really made the experience special.
Highly recommend Hala Wood Green for both small and large groups—we’ll definitely be coming back!

venues.name: Antalya
venues.description: Lavish, colourful frescoes adorn this vibrant restaurant for classic Turkish and Mediterranean fare.

reviews.text: Antalya Restaurant was a fantastic find in the heart of London. We sat outdoors on a warm summer evening, and the setting was perfect, relaxed and inviting. The food was full of authentic Turkish flavour, beautifully presented, and made with fresh ingredients. From the grilled meats to the baklava, everything was delicious. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great Turkish food, especially in the summer. Thank you again for the amazing food and service! We will definitely come back again ☺️🙏

Stumbled above this restaurant on the way from the train station to our hotel and what a wonderful find it was!! Lunch was beyond a bargain. The chicken wrap was delicious and as for the Rosè… stunning. Our waiter Fatih was so friendly and welcoming. Such a gorgeous start to our holiday in London.

Tried the lunch deal and opted for the mezze meal option, definitely not worth almost £20 for the quantity given. Food was average, I was expecting a lot more considering the high reviews. The other dish in the picture is the lamb iskander, which was also alright, again not worth nearly £25. I'd probably skip this and get better value for money + better tasting food elsewhere.

My husband and I dined at Antalya last month when we visited London for two days. It was near the hotel we were staying in so we decided to try it. What a culinary delight! We were greeted immediately and made to feel welcome. Our phenomenal server was Fatih. He was attentive, friendly and a joy to talk with! He made our experience extra special!!
