The staff were super friendly and helpful. I'd have to say the best part is the ambiance - I couldn't get enough of the decor!!!

venues.name: Los Mochis London City
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Liverpool Street Station, 100 Liverpool St, London

venues.vicinity: Liverpool Street Station, 100 Liverpool St, London

reviews.text: Took our daughter here for her 18th birthday lunch. And what a lunch it was. We were welcomed right from start and ushered to our table right away. The place is huge and we were surprised at its size. The service was great - attentive, helpful and prompt (without feeling rushed). The cocktails were spot on and we did have quite a few - Tikki Tulum, Tokyo Trailblazer, Tropical Paloma and Pelino Jalapeño Margarita. We were disappointed that a couple of unique cocktails such as the bartender’s competition drink were not available (though they were on the menu). The best part was the food. The starters - asparagus yakiniku, chipotle calamari, truffle guacamole on crispy rice and shiitake, left us smacking our lips and craving for more. The main course was equally good - dynamite prawn and courgette dynamite tacos were yummy. To top off a great afternoon, our daughter was surprised with a complimentary birthday dessert and sake, which made her very happy. We will be back for more.

We visited Los Mochis London City and tried a selection of small plates alongside a couple of cocktails. I did however go with someone who unfortunately doesn't like seafood (so there's a lack of sushi in this review - but luckily Los Mochis caters for all).

For food, the chipotle calamari was good, though I’ve had better elsewhere. The chipotle mayo that came with it was delicious & smokey which made all the difference. The pato on crispy rice (duck) had a tasty batter but was quite heavy, making it tricky to eat with chopsticks but I still thoroughly enjoyed it. The chutoro (medium fatty bluefin tuna) melted on my tongue. Both the shrimp tempura maki rolls and the dynamite prawn tacos were excellent, with the tacos easily my favourite dish of the night: sweet, spicy, and perfectly balanced.

For drinks, the Pepino Jalapeño cocktail was outstanding. Unlike similar versions I’ve had elsewhere, it was refreshing, light, and had just the right gentle kick. It was so good I had to order it again. The margarita was a safe but smooth classic.

Service was polite and attentive throughout. They are strict with table timings, and once our time was up, they kindly moved us over to the bar so we could continue our evening without feeling rushed.

Something I don’t usually review, but worth mentioning: the restrooms. They were impressive - clean, stylish, and with a refreshing yet relaxing ambiance. I love when a restaurant makes a statement with its facilities, and Los Mochis definitely delivered on that.

Overall, Los Mochis offers a great mix of creative Japanese-Mexican dishes, fantastic cocktails, and stylish surroundings. A spot worth visiting, especially for the dynamite prawn tacos, Pepino Jalapeño cocktail, and yes, even the restrooms.

Went with a friend to Los Mochis, we were originally booked for the sushi counter and asked on arrival if there were any standard tables available. They were able to accommodate us straight away and gave us a table next to the window.  We had a selection of dishes as it's small sharing plates paired with a few cocktails. We really enjoyed the food, really good quality and you could taste the different flavours in each dish. Very vibey with a house ambiance on a Friday night. Good for a high end London city date night.
I highly rate the service, they were great at offering recommendations on drinks and dessert and I was able to charge my phone for a bit at the front desk. Also can't not mention a view of St Paul's in the distance.

Amazing 100% gluten free menu. I walked in and sat at the terrace bar because I was by myself but highly recommend a reservation.
The drinks were wonderful. The food was incredible. But they take service to a new level. I would say you pay for the quality, experience and location, but found it fine what’s offered. Will return to try more food because the whole menu looked great.

I came with a friend for her birthday and it was incredible. Our table was for 3pm which we thought wouldn’t be too busy but when we got there we were surprised to see lots of full tables! Despite the restaurant being busy, the team worked incredibly well to keep everything running smoothly and we didn’t have to wait for long to order or for our food to come out.

As soon as we tasted the food we understood why they were busy and for good reason. The food was incredible in both taste and texture and I almost couldn’t believe that it was 100% gluten free! As someone with coeliac it’s such a relief to find restaurants that are totally gluten free, especially when their food is also incredible. To top off the incredible dining experience we had, they brought out a free birthday dessert for my friend. All in all an amazing experience and I can’t wait to come back again.

venues.name: Mestizo Chelsea: Mexican Restaurant & Margarita Bar
venues.description: Mexican flavors that bring the fiesta to London - bold, beautiful, and absolutely delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful dinner here with friends. We all went for the Taco Tuesday offer of unlimited tacos. As a pescatarian there were plenty of veggie options to choose from. The time in between ordering your tacos and getting the next ones was not too long. Our waiter Damian was also great, very knowledgeable and attentive.

First Time at Mestizo – Blown Away!

I’d never been to an authentic Mexican restaurant before, but after hearing my colleagues talk about how amazing Mestizo is, I had to check it out..and I’m so glad I did! The food was seriously delicious and looked just as good as it tasted.

The place itself has a really cool vibe, perfect for a Friday lunch that eased us right into the weekend. Big shoutout to Prasun who looked after us..his service was spot on and really made the experience even better.

If you’re after some proper good Mexican food and a great atmosphere, I’d definitely recommend giving Mestizo a try. I’ll be back for sure!

Had a lovely experience with my family Saturday afternoon, it was my mother in laws pre birthday dinner.
We particularly enjoyed the atmosphere, which was more informal than expected.  Alberto was our main server, he has a really lovely character and made us felt at ease and respected. He spent time talking us through the menu and guided us to what would suit our group, this is reflected in his staff as well, who are incredibly professional and clearly take pride in their work. We enjoyed our meal (amazing volcano hot pot to share) and as it was a surprise birthday meal, we were given good treatment with dessert and a surprise performance that made my mother in law smiling. Highly recommend this place, we would definitely go back, we were all left feeling content with smiles. Alberto was a fantastic host and super attentive.

Had a great experience at Mestizo! The food was delicious and full of authentic flavor, and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming. Our server William provided excellent service — friendly, attentive, and made great recommendations. Overall, a wonderful meal and experience. Will definitely be back!

Loved it here!

Our waiter was lovely and took his time to explain his favourites on the menu and chat to us. We got 2 for 1 frozen Margaritas (can’t complain) and the food was tasty and I didn’t think it was overpriced as you got a decent amount of everything. I will be coming back to try more of the menu.

venues.name: El Pastor
venues.description: Tacos al pastor & other South American–inspired food & drinks served in buzzy, colourful digs.

reviews.text: A fun, casual, and delicious spot in Borough Market serving up tasty tacos, guacamole, ceviche and more. We got the beef brisket tacos which comes with salsa verde, al pastor tacos, and agave prawn tacos which were a special. There’s not a lot of filling in each taco so if you’re hungry, order a couple more. The prawn tacos could use a little more flavour, but get yourself a sauce on the side and you’re good. The service was so nice, prompt, and attentive. Also try the mezcal!

Fantastic Mexican food. Started with nacho’s with a choice of 5 dips, watch the hot one, it’s very hot!  I had soft shell crab tacos and then shredded beef tacos. Both were good, but the crab was the best. If you want quiet this isn’t the place for you, it was noisy and busy but that added to the great atmosphere. The staff were also great.

This was my first Mexican restaurant in London, and it did not disappoint.
I adored the crab tacos, al pastor, and the limited crispy potato. The corn cake was just perfect—nothing to add.
If you can’t handle spicy food, just ask them for recommendations. The staff were really helpful and super nice.
A bit expensive, but worth it.

Incredible tacos in an excellent spot to watch the passing traffic. I would say that that they were quite pricy and definitely added up at the end. Still, the tacos were very juicy and tender. We did have to wait around 5 minutes but I recommend if you are ever visiting the Borough Market.

We love this place and even though it is not the cheapest, it is worth it for the quality of the food.

The crab tostadas and tuna tostadas are superb as are the various tacos.

The roasted pineapple salsa is simply sublime and each of the taco dishes are individually spiced to differentiate between them.

venues.name: Loco Mexicano
venues.description: Upbeat, party-style Cuban/Mexican-themed bar and salsa club for tequila, tacos and nachos.

reviews.text: Loved the place. Just had the spicy beef nachos and spicy chicken nachos and both were tasty and amazing, well sized portions as well. Excellent service from staff and thoroughly enjoyed the evening. Place was super busy but waited for it to empty a bit to take photos

This restaurant has a fun atmosphere and friendly staff. We appreciated that they were willing to make a special margarita we requested, though my partner had to go up to the bar to place the order. The food was fresh and flavourful — the pulled pork was tasty but a bit too wet for our liking. Overall, a good spot for casual Mexican fare with great drink options.

This place is amazing, absolutely well worth a visit. The food was fantastic and the pitcher of margaritas was pretty good too🤣 the staff was so friendly and provided some sombreros for our entertainment! But behind all the fun the food was truly excellent.

Booked for 7 ppl to celebrate 2 birthdays. Even though the reviews were mixed, as mostly was quite promising we braved ourselves to try out this place.
The Good(s):
Atmosphere is quite Mexican theme, nice and had various art on the wall with good music. They have these Mexican hats which creates quirky fun for the diners.
Food were all decent portions - nachos were great, so was the prawns we had and BBQ ribs and wings.
The food was all edible - everything was nice but not really a wow factor that makes me think, I want to come back here again.
The Bad(s):
We wanted to get Starters sharer platter of 4 and they had beef as part of it but our family do not eat beef. We asked if we could exchange to another meat but the chef didn't allow, not even we offered to pay extra. And due to limitations, its either this platter or vegetarian platter.
The staff were friendly but I think they could be students. So a staff brought our mains and repeated the order, for example Chimichanga Beef. we reminded we didn't order any beef and he looked confused. The right food was served but he announced it as beef.
Based on my previous experiences, Fajita bread comes in an enclosed container so that the bread retains the heat and the dish normally comes out on a sizzling hot plate - the drama is on the sizzle dish. But it was neither, no sizzling and the fajita bread came by the side. Last but least, all food served (except breaded mushroom) was luke warm. It wasnt hot - its almost like its been sitting in kitchen for a while before it was served.
For the reasons above, its a 3 star review.
The experience was decent, not great and for that reason I don't think we will be back here again.

⸻

A Hidden Halal Mexican Gem in London Victoria 🌮🔥

Tucked away in London Victoria, only a 5minute walk from Victoria station. This place is a rare find – halal Mexican food done right. The menu is packed with veggie-friendly options, so there’s something for everyone.

The lunch menu is ideal for work breaks or casual catch-ups, with generous portions and solid value. I also loved the non-alcoholic drinks – refreshing and full of flavour.

The vibe? Cosy and colourful, with cool Mexican-themed artwork and traditional sombreros adding a fun, laid-back touch to the space.

If you’re in the area, definitely worth checking out. A welcome change from the usual lunch spots!

venues.name: Mexican Seoul
venues.description: Mexican cuisine that's as vibrant as Mexico City itself - authentic flavors, modern style. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Fantastic restaurant. The restaurant is welcoming, its lovely and the staff are kind, friendly, and attentive. The food was amazing, so yummy. The pork belly taco was incredible.

They stock PRETTY DECENT pale ale which is brewed right next door. Best of all, the food tastes amazingly authentic to both Mexico and Korea. It's really tasty.

This was quite a find and worth our trek all the way from SW London! We arrived 45min early on a Sunday and just whiling away the time by walking by the restaurant to check out the menu and the surrounding area but was immediately greeted by the friendly and consummate host Patrick. When we returned shortly before opening, we were immediately seated in the pleasant outdoor area. We started with the absolutely delicious Drunken Egg salad - the eggs perfectly marinated and the yolks beautifully jammy. This was followed by the generously portioned Bulgogi Beef Tacos. But you definitely come here because of the Korean style wings, in our case the Soy Garlic Butter version which was spectacular. Going slightly out of order, we then added the Elote Ribs, which upon tasting, we deemed an excellent decision. Oh wow, that sweet firm corn paired with all kinds of umami was just 👌!  They only have one dessert choice and when the Banana Fritters are this good, they don’t really need another, do they? Is Mexican and Korean a match made in heaven? I suggest you go and find out for yourself!

First time coming here and it was so good!
From the time we arrived to when we left, we had great service from the guys there. The wings were so crispy and delicious 😋!  So much flavour! And the beef tacos were my favourite, what a great fusion paired with soju. Thank you Mexican Seoul!

Absolutely amazing!
First of all, a huge thank you to Ashley, who went above and beyond to accommodate us even though the restaurant was fully booked.

The food is outstanding – the kind of fusion that truly works, offering fresh and exciting flavours that feel genuinely unique. This was my third visit, and it never disappoints.

A special mention as well to Anna, our waitress, who was absolutely wonderful and made the experience even better.

When my sister asked me what my dream hen party would be, my response not actually thinking it would ever come true “hiring out Mexican Seoul, all the wings, margaritas, best tunes and best gals”

Well apparently dreams do come true! Not only was it a life highlight & one of the best days of my life, the food (obviously) was exceptional, the staff even more so. My sister said it was the easiest, helpful, friendliest booking ever 🥹

1 million % recommend Mexican Seoul for private functions, as well as every day feasting! Just the BEST!!!

THANK YOU SO SO SOOOOO MUCH ❤️✨

venues.name: El Cenote
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Yummy tacos
Tuna Tostada was my fave and the margaritas were delish.
Welcoming customer service from all the staff including the chef. Looking forward to going again.

Exceptional quality, fresh and authentic Mexican cuisine and drinks. The manageress was genuinely very kind, patient and supportive which put me at ease.
A hidden gem just off Camden High Street and very close to Camden Town station.
I will certainly be returning here.

As a fellow Mexican.. I visited London in March. I was missing home food and had a really difficult time finding “Authentic” mexican food. When I tell you the food here is amazing it’s very authentic, please believe it! The tacos were soo soo delicious.. tasted just like home. They also had “Jarritos” a mexican soda which I had to order as well. I spoke to the owner who was present and complimented him on the food & atmosphere. The owner himself is from Mexico 🇲🇽 This place is the spot. Search no further.
Great spot for Mexican food. We shared the grill plate which was really tasty, and the margaritas are excellent. Can’t wait to go back and try the tacos

El Cenote is a charming little restaurant tucked away in a quieter part of Camden, offering a welcome break from the usual hustle. The food is as vibrant as its surroundings, delivering authentic Mexican flavours with confidence. The ceviche stands out — simple, fresh, and perfectly balanced. The drinks menu is equally impressive; the hibiscus margarita was a personal favourite, expertly crafted, and the classic Cheladas lived up to their reputation. The service was attentive and friendly, rounding out a genuinely enjoyable experience.

venues.name: Cavita
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
A True Taste of Mexico in the Heart of London – CAVITA

After visiting Tulum, I’ve been searching for a restaurant that could take me back to that same authentic Mexican warmth and flavour — and my search was finally over when I discovered CAVITA.

From the moment you step inside, you’re transported straight to Mexico. The interiors are earthy, vibrant, and full of soul — just like the food. My wife and I had the most incredible experience here, guided by the wonderful team and the energy of the restaurant.

We quite literally tried everything! From the tostadas and small plates to the grilled prawns, skewers, and the catch of the day — every dish was bursting with layered flavours and authenticity. The desserts? Simply divine. Every bite felt like a journey through Mexico’s regions, just as the restaurant’s concept promises.

And to top it all off, we had the pleasure of meeting Chef Adriana Cavita herself — her passion for Mexican heritage and culinary craft shines through in every detail.

If you want real Mexican food, cooked the way Mexicans eat it, this is an absolute must-try. The margaritas are exceptional, the atmosphere is electric, and the food is nothing short of extraordinary.

¡Viva CAVITA! 🇲🇽✨

We very much enjoyed our experience at Cavita.  I am not sure why, but good Mexican food seems harder and harder to find in London; for me, this has been the best Mexican meal I have had in the UK in the last few years.  The decor is beautiful and the staff extremely friendly and efficient.  The fact that they are dog-friendly makes us like them even more.  We certainly intend to return, especially as, since our first visit to Cavita, we have spent two weeks eating our way around Mexico.  It will be interesting to compare for authenticity and taste of course.  Having said that, while we were in Oaxaca (capital of more modern/pared down Mexican food, in the style of Cavita), I remember thinking that the meal at Cavita was comparable in both taste and presentation.

Wow… just wow! Dining at Cavita was an unforgettable experience. From the moment we stepped in, we were swept away by the vibrant yet elegant atmosphere. The restaurant’s setup is both stylish and inviting, blending authentic Mexican charm with a modern twist — a true feast for the senses before the food even arrives.

Now, the food… where do I even begin? Every bite was bursting with flavor — bold, refined, and deeply satisfying. You can feel the passion behind each dish. The ingredients were fresh and the presentation was stunning,

And the cocktails! Creative, perfectly balanced, and crafted with care. They complemented the meal beautifully and added another layer of delight to the whole evening.

A very special thank you to Daniel, who greeted us so warmly at the door and made us feel instantly at home. And a heartfelt thank you to Stephanie, whose kind presence, attentiveness, and knowledge added so much joy to our meal. Their combined hospitality truly made this experience extraordinary.

Cavita is not just a restaurant — it’s an experience. One I will definitely return to, and one I can’t recommend highly enough. Bravo!

The pictures are truly self-explanatory — no filter needed when the food looks and tastes this good!

Really, really disappointing and insanely expensive - more than 200 pounds for two people, and for Mexican food! My husband booked this place for my birthday dinner. What a let-down. The hostess was apathetic and unfriendly. Cocktails were overly filled with giant ice cubes. And the Romanian waiter - who was nice enough - knew absolutely nothing about Mexican food or the menu. Part of paying a bit more for good Mexican food should also include wait staff who are knowledgeable and passionate about the region and the food. That was not the case. And even though we both made it clear that this was my birthday dinner - there was no candle or anything when the dessert arrived. That would have salvaged an overall underwhelming and sterile experience (which Mexican food should never be!). The ceviche was fine as was the fish we shared as a main. The dessert - a corn cake - looked promising but tasted more like coconut than corn. I would have been happier with street tacos pretty much anywhere else. Will not be returning.

Hubby took me to Cavita for my birthday treat and what a treat it was!! The atmosphere is great, the decor is beautiful and the service was fantastic! Michaela was attentive, suggested great recommendations and had a great sense of humour. The food was delicious, a burst of tastes in your mouth, just amazing! We are far too much! The cocktails and mocktails were really good and the chocolate mousse was divine! A tad expensive for Mexican but then again you’re in central london so expected. I would highly recommend!

venues.name: Yucca London
venues.description: Intimate, low-lit eatery featuring tacos, burritos & other Mexican staples, plus tropical cocktails.

reviews.text:
Great place. The interior is done in a Mexican style with pleasant colors and interesting details.

The menu is varied, with plenty to choose from, and everything I tried was tasty and well prepared.

The staff are attentive.

The only surprise was the coffee—it’s really strong. If you prefer something milder, it’s better to mention it right away.

Overall, it’s a nice spot to visit with friends or for dinner if you want to enjoy authentic Mexican food.

Amazing food and service! The calamari was fresh with delicious jelopeno and the passionfruit cocktail looked and tasted fantastic. The chicken burrito had a unique British style(in traditional Mexican style, it’s usually wrapped inside)but I mixed some of the chicken with the rice, added avocado, yogurt made it incredible. The fried fish tacos were fresh and full of flavor. We came around 3 PM so it was quiet, and the staff were super friendly. Highly recommend!

100/10! To begin, service was very attentive but not overbearing or rushed- staff were happy to help with the menu. The food arrived in efficient time, and omg, this was one of the best mexican meals I’ve had. I chose the seabass which was flavourful and came with delicious rice and a fresh salad + pico de gallo. My mum had the chicken breast and said, again, that it was one of the best she’s had. Both portions were huge, but i had no problem finishing it as it was tasty, fresh and fulfilling, not too heavy at all. Atmosphere was brilliant- definitely recommend for any birthday dinners! Overall I would definitely recommend Yucca and enjoyed the experience.

Absolutely loved Yucca!
The food was delicious – full of authentic Mexican flavours and beautifully presented. The service was friendly and efficient, and the ambience was warm and inviting, with a great vibe that makes you want to stay longer.
I especially loved the spicy margaritas – perfectly balanced with just the right kick. A must-try!
Highly recommend for anyone craving quality Mexican cuisine in London!

The veggie Nachos were delicious, I especially liked the fresh tomato salsa.

The soft Taco was tasty.

The churro was presented prettily, I had it with vanilla ice cream.

My waiter was really friendly, warm, nice and attentive

venues.name: The Great Chase
venues.description: Modern venue with a warm atmosphere prepping elevated British halal fare & alcohol-free cocktails.

reviews.text:
My wife and I came here to celebrate our anniversary and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. We were seated right next to the food preparation station, which gave the evening a lively, behind-the-scenes feel and let us watch the chefs at work.

For starters we shared the BBQ bone marrow and tahini salad — both beautifully prepared and full of flavour. For mains we chose the lamb roast and the fillet steak; each dish was perfectly cooked, tender, and seasoned just right. To finish, we had the tiramisu and sticky toffee pudding — both indulgent and the perfect sweet ending.

The staff were warm and attentive throughout, and a special shout-out to the chef who was especially friendly and made the night feel personal.

A memorable evening, amazing food, and a lovely atmosphere — highly recommend

An outstanding dining experience from start to finish.
The lamb roast was tender and flavorful, while the dry-aged beef was simply exceptional — rich, perfectly cooked, and full of depth.
Service was top-tier: professional, warm, and attentive without being overbearing. Every detail, from the food to the presentation, was impeccable.
To finish it all off we tried the sticky toffee pudding and oh my god I was blown away.!
It a must try.. ❤️❤️
Truly a top-notch spot. Highly recommended.

We went to this restaurant for our anniversary, as we had heard it was a nice place that served halal food. We had booked a table in advance. Despite this, we had to wait about 10 minutes before we were seated. Our mojito arrived with ice, but the drink itself was warm, so we had to wait for it to cool down.

For starters, we ordered bone marrow and mushroom soup. The bone marrow was so hot that I burned my mouth, but it tasted great. The soup was basically cooking cream blended with mushrooms—it looked like baby porridge. The taste was fine, but nothing special.

For the main course, we ordered harissa lamb, which had absolutely no flavor and no spices. The plating was also unattractive and messy. We also ordered a sirloin steak, which again tasted like nothing at all—I even had to ask for salt and pepper just to get some flavor.

Overall, we left very disappointed and would definitely not recommend this restaurant.

Really enjoyed our meal at The Great Chase last week. Had been wanting to eat here for some time, the new location is more central and easier to get to. We arrived early evening and were seated immediately. Our server helped us to decide what to order as it was our first time here. We got the BBQ Marrow Bone (it was divine, I’d come back just for this!), the Lamb Roast and the Beef Wellington. Everything was amazing, great portion sizes, good quality ingredients and the flavours worked really well together.
Our server was polite, informative and helpful, with the right balance of attentiveness and space to enjoy our meal - wish I’d taken his name!
Definitely will be dining here again and will recommend to family and friends, thanks for a great experience.

What an amazing experience at The Great Chase!

The food was absolutely on point, full of flavour and beautifully presented. The service was fantastic – attentive and welcoming throughout.

The décor is stunning, creating a warm and elegant atmosphere that really adds to the dining experience. It is a little on the pricey side, but worth every penny for the quality and overall experience.

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed it and will definitely be returning. Highly recommended!

venues.name: Coco Grill & Lounge
venues.description: Haute choice with Tower Bridge & river views offering halal global provisions, mocktails & shisha.

address.formatted: Butlers Wharf Bldg, 34a Shad Thames, London

venues.vicinity: Butlers Wharf Bldg, 34a Shad Thames, London

reviews.text: Wow! This place is located at a very lovely location. The food was 10 google stars, the duck rolls, mixed kebab, ribeye steak. All cooked perfectly. Loved the decor, the staff were excellent. Lovely and polite. The fudge cake melts your mouth. We had an amazing birthday dinner there.  I will deffo book this one again in the future.

Coco Grill and Lounge is absolutely fantastic! The food was amazing  fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. The chicken burger was especially delicious, juicy and perfectly cooked. The drinks were just as impressive. The mango mojito was refreshing and full of flavor, and the Oreo milkshake was creamy, rich, and the perfect treat. On top of that, the service was outstanding friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to again and again!

Had a delicious business lunch with a beautiful view at CoCo restaurant. The food was tasty, and I especially loved how perfectly crispy yet tender my fish was. The mango mocktail was a bit on the sweet side, but very refreshing. The service was excellent—they kindly charged both my laptop and phone without hesitation, and everything was served promptly. Sitting outside with a view of the Thames made the whole experience even better. Thank you

Tucked beside the legendary Tower Bridge, Coco Grill & Lounge is a gem for a relaxed dinner with friends, especially on a mild evening like the one we enjoyed. My group and I headed there for a casual catch-up, drawn by the outdoor seating and those unbeatable views. We weren’t let down – the terrace setup is spot-on, with tables positioned to capture the full sweep of the bridge arching over the Thames. As we settled in under the cool breeze drifting off the river, it felt like the perfect backdrop for good conversation and laughter. The ambience is inviting: lively hum from fellow diners mixed with the gentle water sounds, all wrapped in a stylish, modern vibe that’s pure London charm. It’s got that effortless Instagram appeal too – we couldn’t resist a few group shots with the bridge glowing in the background.
Dinner kicked off on a high note. We shared a fresh salad to start, which was light and zingy, followed by the fire-grilled chicken that stole the show – smoky, perfectly spiced with a real fiery edge that cut through the breeze-chilled air. It paired seamlessly with the salad, and the portions hit just right for sharing among friends, leaving us full but not stuffed.
There were a couple of small hitches along the way. We’d spotted shisha mentions in online reviews and thought it’d be a fun add-on, but they’d quietly dropped it from the menu about a month back without updating Google – a minor surprise that we shrugged off by focusing on the food and views instead. Service was warm and capable overall, though on our bustling night, it took a beat longer than ideal to grab the waiter’s eye for extras like drink refills.
In the end, the stunning Tower Bridge panorama, that refreshing cool breeze, and easygoing spot with pals make Coco Grill & Lounge a solid pick for a neutral-good night out. It’s all about the location and simple pleasures here, with just a nudge needed for those finer details. Solid 3.5 stars from our friends – the scenery and shared bites tipped the scales.

🌟 Dining at Coco – Tower Bridge 🌟

Coco brings such a refreshing vibe to the Tower Bridge area – the space feels elegant yet inviting, with a modern décor and an atmosphere that instantly makes you want to linger a little longer.

The menu didn’t disappoint. The lamb shank was a real star – slow-cooked to perfection, juicy and packed with flavour. And the desserts… wow. Both the chocolate soufflé and the French toast were heavenly – indulgent, comforting, and the kind of dishes you’d happily go back for again and again.

Cocktails and drinks were just as impressive, crafted with care and served beautifully. What stood out most though was the team – genuinely friendly, professional, and making sure every detail was perfect. Service like that really elevates the whole experience.

Coco is definitely one of those places I’d recommend to anyone wanting great food, faultless desserts, and standout hospitality near Tower Bridge. 🍷✨

venues.name: Taste of Lahore
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The Taste of Lahore reminded of restaurants in Pakistan with the over abundance of bright track lighting and chandeliers. The food and service were fantastic, we thoroughly enjoyed every dish. We ordered the Chapli kebab, masala fish, tandoori chicken wings, and Seekh kebabs. Each dish was executed perfectly and full of flavor. Two of my friends never had Chapli kebabs before and they thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommend for traditional Pakistani food and great service.

I visited Test of Lahore in Edgware and while the ambiance was nice, the experience overall was disappointing. Coming from Canada, I expected authentic Pakistani food to really stand out, but honestly I’ve had better taste back home in Calgary.

The service was quite slow — our BBQ dishes arrived about 20 minutes before the naan and other mains, which meant the BBQ got cold by the time we could actually eat it. The food itself was just average, nothing memorable.

With so many good reviews, I was hoping for more. Unfortunately, the slow service and average flavors didn’t make it worth the wait.

We had a wonderful experience in this restaurant.
The food was sooo good. Specially the rice & the chicken korma.
Excellent service by the staff. Thank you Emmy for your excellent service

having read the reviews, finally managed to visit for the first time.

we went for the tawa which had a good range of options on there to share between 4 people. it tasted amazing! absolutely loved it.

prices are very high but I guess it’s bc of the area. we had to ask for sauces and there were no complimentary salads etc, service was okay. they do add service charge so check before you pay as the bill will be extortionate. but great tasting food!

Great busy restaurant with friendly staff and efficient service.  I had only mixed kebab, fries and soft drink and it was very tasty and hot.   I could see the curries and other options on other tables and it also looked delicious and good portions. Will definately make a return trip when in the area for lovely Pakistani food.

venues.name: The Banc
venues.description: Airy, modern restaurant for steaks, burgers & more, plus a 2-storey shisha lounge.

reviews.text: Amazing experience, went for my nieces birthday and we all loved it. The waiter Vish was so attentive with outstanding customer service. The food was on point and so flavoursome, we will most definitely be back. We chose to visit at the lunch time and am so glad as it was so peaceful atmosphere. Thank you for taking such good care of us.

We had an incredible time dining at The Banc. The drinks were incredible and the food was even better!!!! The meat was tender and perfect texure, the dynamite prawns were perfectly spicy and everything else 10/10. The ambience was very fun, the service was absolutely incredible and very speedy as well as amazing music that the DJ was playing! We will be back!

Had dinner here on a Friday night around 8pm and the atmosphere was brilliant — lively but not too loud. The staff were welcoming, attentive, and made us feel really looked after despite how busy it was. The food came out quickly and every dish was packed with flavour, beautifully presented, and really good portions for the price. The cocktails were also excellent and paired perfectly with the meal. Overall, The Banc delivered on both quality and service — definitely a spot I’d recommend for a fun evening out in London.

Beautiful restaurant could not fault anything at all from the food to the atmosphere to the service everything was impeccable. Had the most outstanding service from Vish, honestly the kindest and most helpful person and made our experience so so special and food was the best I’ve had! Highly recommend especially during lunch when it is a little bit quieter.

I’ve been to The Banc before in Dubai and now again in London. And it didn’t disappoint!!

The ambience is warm and stylish, making it the perfect spot for a relaxed evening out. The food was absolutely delicious with plenty of choice, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality. The service was friendly and attentive, which really added to the overall experience. Great atmosphere, great food, and definitely a place I’d love to come back to!

venues.name: Shahs Halal Food Soho
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One of the best halal food places I’ve tried in Central London near the BT Tower! The taste is unmatched, portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable. The staff are friendly and supportive, making the whole experience even better. They also have a convenient self-checkout system for ordering food, which is quick and easy. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for top-quality halal food in London.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ (Okay, but could be better)**

The food was decent, but the experience didn’t quite live up to expectations. The service was slow—we waited in a long queue just to get our portion, and the cramped seating made it hard to enjoy the meal comfortably. The chicken had an oddly artificial texture, which was disappointing for the price.

If you’re looking for a quick, reliable bite in the area, you might find better value elsewhere. Hopefully, they can improve on speed and quality control!

Chicken on salad was delicious, and an amazing value. White sauce tasted kinda like ranch. Green sauce is minty. Red sauce has a nice kick.

£10.5 with extra protein.

Absolutely amazing experience at Shah’s Halal Food in Soho. The food was fresh, packed with flavor, and perfectly cooked — I had the [insert dish, e.g. chicken over rice], and it was honestly one of the best halal meals I’ve had in London.

The service was 10/10 — super friendly, fast, and welcoming. You can tell the team really cares about their food and their customers.

Highly recommend if you’re in Soho and craving something delicious, filling, and halal. Will definitely be coming back!
"Had a great experience at Shah Halal's! The food taste was superb, served in a super neat and clean environment. Loved the vibes and the location is perfect too!"

venues.name: Meet Bros (by Me’nate x Jibby&co.)
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Amazing food and service. We got served by Tahleel, great guy. Made us feel welcome and was really helpful and polite. The wait is quite long but granted it was a Saturday and there’s a seating area for you to wait until your table is ready. Would recommend you book a table in advance otherwise you’ll most likely get sent away, it’s that busy and we weren’t surprised as to why as the food is great. Nonetheless, service was great, Food was cooked perfectly, great flavours, atmosphere was beautiful. We recommend getting the Sando’s and spring rolls for starters. Thank you to Tahleel and the Meet Bro’s team for making me and my partners evening delightful.

From start to finish, our experience at this restaurant was nothing short of exceptional. We arrived without a reservation and, despite how busy it was, we were warmly welcomed and seated within just 15 minutes. That alone already set a positive tone for the evening.

We began with starters of spring rolls and ribeye beef. Both were perfectly prepared — the spring rolls were crisp, golden, and packed with flavour, while the ribeye beef was tender and rich, cooked exactly how it should be. Moving on to mains, we chose the fillet mignon and the Asian-style carbonara. The fillet mignon was melt-in-your-mouth perfection, bursting with flavour in every bite, and the carbonara was a creative twist on a classic — beautifully balanced with a unique Asian flair that worked incredibly well.

For dessert, we indulged in the pineapple turnover and the baked apple filo pastry. They were both heavenly — light, sweet, and the perfect way to end the meal. You could really taste the thought and effort put into each dish from start to finish.

The décor added so much to the experience too. Modern, stylish, and atmospheric, it gave the restaurant such a warm and inviting feel.

A special mention must go to our waiter, Tahleel. His service was outstanding — attentive without ever being intrusive, knowledgeable about the menu, and genuinely friendly. He went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and made the whole evening even more enjoyable.

This restaurant truly ticks every box: fantastic food, beautiful surroundings, and first-class service. It’s rare to find a place that excels in all three, but this one does it effortlessly. We will most definitely be back and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable dining experience.

Spectacular food and lightning fast service, the steak sando, chicken wings and apple filo pastry dessert were unbelievably good, rest of the good also top tier. The midnight blue mocktail is beautiful.

Amazing interior in the form of a stone labyrinth, just stunning. Will be back 100% and Oasis perfectly looked after us.

Most beautiful restaurant I’ve been to!! Got the £25 lunch deal , ordered the steak and chips and the sauce was divineeee, pepper was very strong but I love it like that, and the watermelon mocktail was beautiful too. For dessert had the banana and orange crepe, was beautiful! Service could’ve been a bit more available but still lovely!

If you're looking for a amazing Halal steak restaurant in West London, then this is the place for you.
Incredible food,  beautiful decor and prompt friendly service.
We started with Calamari, which to be honest was not great, the outside was a bit overdone and inside was still a bit chewy.
But when we got to mains, we'd forgotten all about that, we both got Wagyu beef steak and this really hit the spot, as perfect as it gets.
Was accompanied by chips, watermelon juice but after the steak, the next best thing we had was the lychee mocktail.
All in all, a brilliant dining experience

venues.name: Steak and Company - Covent Garden
venues.description: Contemporary venue specialising in chargrilled beef, ribs and comfort food with a pre-theatre menu.

reviews.text:
We had prawns, pork belly, and something like burger spring rolls as starters. For the main, we got the ribeye steak served on a hot stone with chips. We added mushroom sauce, peppercorn sauce, and another one with wine that I can’t remember the name.

The seasoning on the steaks was nice, and the meat was good quality, but nothing that really wowed me. Overall, the whole experience was cute and different, and it was my first time trying this kind of place, but I probably wouldn’t go back.

It was a bit expensive to be honest, and the steak doesn’t come with anything – you have to add the sauce, chips or mash separately. Also, the stone gets cold halfway through, and I wasn’t really in the mood to ask for a new one since it’s a bit awkward to handle.

The staff were nice and friendly, and even when we arrived late, the lady in charge of bookings was really kind and accommodating.

Overall, I think it’s a bit overhyped considering how it’s always fully booked. Actually you can even ask for your steak to be done by the chef in the kitchen but Personally, I’d rather go to another steakhouse next time and honestly, why am I cooking it myself when I’m paying that much.

Easy 5 stars. Easy. One of the best steaks I had in my life if not the best. The price 100% worth the value, and I hope it will stay this way! The atmosphere is absolutely amazing and the service was friendly and kind. Recommended

We were welcomed by a very friendly man who seated us at the table.
We came for a birthday lunch.
The place wasn’t busy.
The inside area is cozy and nice.
To start with we ordered the fried goat cheese and it was excellent!
I loved every bite of it, perfect combination of flavours.
My partner ordered the steak with the option to fry it on the stone by the table as we thought it might be a nice experience.
I went for a veggie burger and fries on the side that had to be ordered separately.
The frying process was easy and interesting.
We were explained the steps of frying the meat what was very helpful.
My burger was just ok.
The service was nice and friendly what made a great atmosphere at the restaurant.
We had a chat with a man who I believe was a manager.
We were given a nice dessert on the house as we were celebrating birthday.
This was very nice of them.
We also enjoyed our 2 drinks for the price of one.
The place isn’t the cheapest but the experience was kind of worth it also it was a special occasion.

I visited Steak & Company  a few days ago and had an amazing experience. The highlight for me was the hot stone steak — it was delicious and a fun way to enjoy the meal. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, making sure everything was perfect throughout our visit. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the service was excellent. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great steak experience in London.☺️☺️

The best steak I’ve had in the UK was here! The service is incredibly friendly and helpful. Manager Agnieszka is very professional and goes above and beyond to accommodate every need. Our waitress Aiste was absolutely lovely, and her fish recommendation was spot on—exactly what I was looking for. I’ll definitely be coming back on my next visit to London!

venues.name: Colonel Saab
venues.description: Fancy restaurant with an old-world vibe offering creative Indian cooking, plus cocktails.

reviews.text: The food and setting was spectacular.. a very different menu to any other with everything absolutely delicious. We tried dishes that were completely unknown to us, which makes for an exciting change. The Banarasi cocktail was excellent. The service was polite and courteous, though we caught them just as the kitchen was closing and they were setting up for the evening, so we may have not got the best of their attentions. Already looking forward to going back and trying the full tasting menu.

I recently went for afternoon tea at Colonel Sahab, and it turned out to be a truly delightful experience. The ambiance had a charming mix of elegance and warmth, making it perfect for a relaxed afternoon. The service was attentive without being overbearing, which added to the comfort.

The food was beautifully presented—fancy yet rooted in Indian flavors, giving the whole spread a unique twist. Every bite felt fresh and thoughtfully crafted.

Now, here’s an unpopular opinion—I’m not really a chai person. Instead, I opted for a citrus chamomile tea, which was refreshing, light, and soothing. My friend went with the classic chai, and I have to admit—it smelled heavenly and tasted amazing too.

It is on the pricier side, but the overall experience makes it worth it—great food, lovely drinks, and a calm, welcoming atmosphere. I’d definitely recommend it if you’re looking to indulge in a refined afternoon tea with an Indian touch.

Amazing place. The staff are super friendly, the menu is well structured with lots of options for everyone and a great mix of different flavours and textures. The wine list is built to match the food. I had the prawn chimichi started and the fish curry as a main. The food was cooked to perfection and full of flavour. My waiter, Rony, was attentive, smiley and seemed genuinely pleased to be serving my table. I used to manage restaurants and he is sort of person I would have employed in a heartbeat, a true example of what hospitality should be.

The restaurant was busy as well, on a Monday! Which made for a great atmosphere.  Lots of happy diners and a really nice dining room with perfect lighting and lovely decor.

I don’t live in London, but the next time I’m back here I will be making a beeline for Colobel Saab!

From the very first moment you step inside Colonel Saab, you’re welcomed into a warm and inviting atmosphere. The décor tells a story — rooted in Indian heritage yet stylishly curated — and it instantly sets the tone for what’s to come.

The food ranges between flawless and truly mind-blowing. Classics like the butter chicken are executed to perfection, while surprising dishes such as the broccoli with cheese starter stand out as memorable highlights. Every plate feels carefully thought through.

Service is impeccable: attentive without ever being intrusive. The staff gave just the right amount of time to make decisions, and service flowed seamlessly, with plates arriving and leaving exactly when they should.

The cocktails deserve their own spotlight. Signature drinks are not only beautifully presented but also pair remarkably well with the dishes — a rare balance of taste and detail. Even the non-alcoholic options were crafted with the same level of care.

Overall, Colonel Saab is a restaurant I would recommend to anyone. It’s a place I’ll gladly return to every time I’m in London. Add to that the fact that the prices feel fair for the quality delivered, and you have a true gem worth experiencing.

Visited with my lady as part of a date day to London for Sunday dinner. This restaurant came highly recommended by one of her colleagues.

Entry to be greeted by many awards & trophies is a promising sight. Interior is nice with lots of characterful Indian touches & memorabilia on the walls.

We both sampled the tasting menu at £80 _each_. Wherever there was an option of choice we had both between us and shared.

Throughout the meal, our waiters would give us a geographical & culinary history of the dishes as they arrive. A fantastic meal, every plate, bowl & morsel was ravenously consumed.

venues.name: Souk
venues.description: North African dishes served in souk-like rooms with tiles, lanterns, shishas and exotic fabrics.

reviews.text:
I had a dinner with my friends and we tried different dishes, all of which were delicious especially the Royal Couscous, Lamb Tagine and Pastilla. The atmosphere and the decoration were impressive, I loved how patient and welcoming the staff were with a tone of humour. My friends and I had the time of our lives in this restaurant
I would deffo recommend it! Thanks to all the people working there for providing us with such a splendid experience

I'd give 10 stars if I could! I had an amazing experience here! The service was great! Me and my friend were treated so well by the amazing staff. The food was something else, we loved it so much! Perfect seasoning in everything. It's a little piece of Morocco in London that everyone should visit! Love love love!! Can't wait to return again and again!
Service felt a little rushed, but food and drink or were quite good. The rice and chicken are a bit dry, and you can ask for dishes to be spicy (doesn't work though).
First time trying Moroccan food and it was lovely. Interior is so nice and cosy and service was amazing - had the best birthday here, thank you!
Delicious Mediterranean food and authentic atmosphere. Variety of Moroccan tagines to grilled food. They also serve shisha outside

venues.name: Elvet Steakhouse London
venues.description: Relaxed establishment serving steaks, burgers & comfort sides, plus alcohol-free cocktails.

reviews.text:
A very good spot for steak!

My first time at Elvet, on a very special occasion. The staff were welcoming, friendly and informative.

🥩We ordered a platter of 3 steak cuts and they were all better than the last! Perfectly cooked and seasoned.

🍤The prawn tempura starters were tasty while leaving room for the steak. But lacking in presentation.

🍹Mocktails were absolutely delicious and ice cold.

🍨Desserts could be more elevated too. The tiramisu served in a flowerpot was theatrical but not that amazing.

A nice interior but the seating style and table could be a little more elevated.

I will be visiting again for the steak. The other menu items could be more tasty and better presented.

This was our second time trying Wagyu and we were not completely satisfied. There were two key things I was expecting. Number 1 being that the servers recommend how the Wagyu should be cooked. And number 2 being that we are provided with a hot plate to do the cooking ourselves.

Our first experience of Wagyu hit both of the above points. The meat was only briefly seared when it was brought out to us and the server recommended that we cook each side for a maximum of 5 seconds. This resulted in the most incredible steak we've ever had.

Don't get me wrong, the steak here was still very nice. It didn't move us as much as we were expecting. The accompanying Steak Chips and Mocktail were both lovely. We were just slightly let down by the Steak.

Service on the whole was exceptional. Really nice and attentive staff. They even moved us to a nicer spot once it became free. We will give this place another shot next time we're in London.

Elvet Steakhouse London is on another level everything from start to finish was perfect! The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a warm welcome and the place instantly feels special. The atmosphere is classy but still comfortable, with beautiful lighting and a lively vibe that makes you want to stay for hours.

The food? Absolutely incredible. The steak was cooked exactly how I wanted juicy, tender, and full of flavour. The sides were fresh and perfectly seasoned, and every bite felt like it was made with real care. The presentation was also on point every plate looked like something from a high-end magazine.

The drinks deserve their own shoutout. I had one of the best mocktails I’ve ever tasted full of flavour, refreshing, and presented so beautifully it was almost too pretty to drink (almost!). It paired perfectly with the meal and made the whole experience even better.

Service was outstanding attentive without being pushy, and they made sure everything was just right for us. You can tell the staff take pride in making customers happy.

Overall, Elvet Steakhouse isn’t just a place to eat it’s an experience. Perfect for a special night out, a celebration, or just treating yourself to something amazing. I’ll 100% be coming back!

Fantastic experience at Elvet Steakhouse! The food was absolutely delicious – perfectly cooked and full of flavour. We had the wagyu ribeye which was perfectly cooked. Service was friendly, attentive, and made the whole evening even better.  A big thanks to Mosh. Highly recommend for anyone who loves great steak and great service.

3 of us decided to book a table at Elvet.
The welcome was great, the atmosphere is fantastic.
Had Korean wings for starters, they were delicious 10/10.
For mains we all went for the fillet steaks, presentation was 10/10,  taste and flavours were 6/10 for steak, the meatballs had a very gamey taste. Hand cut steak chips were 10/10, mushroom sauce 5/10.
Enjoyed the overall experience, slightly overpriced but good for special occasions.

venues.name: Azura Restaurant & Bar
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Had a lovely meal at Azura! The food was amazing – the lamb chops were so tender and full of flavour, and the meze platter was really tasty. The ambience was lovely and relaxed, perfect for an evening out.

A special mention to our waiter Zizo, who was very friendly and gave excellent service throughout. Would definitely recommend and can’t wait to come back!

I celebrated my anniversary with my partner and it was outstanding. The food was phenomenal, Zizo was our waiter and he looked after us so well. Thank you Zizo! We definitely would like to come back. 100% recommended 💯🫰🏼

Went here last night for my boyfriend’s birthday! The food was tasty and served very quick! Our favourite was the sea bass!!! Beautiful flavour! The portion size was great. The specialty cocktails were really cool and tasted great! The lychee martini was my favourite. They were a bit expensive but can be expected. We sat in the garden area as it was warm, and the music was a good vibe. It felt like we were on holiday in Greece. The wait staff were very attentive, and though we were waiting for a 2nd round of drinks for a bit longer than normal, they apologised and gave us free shots as compensation!! They also gave us more free shots and a sparkling candle for a birthday treat! This really made the experience as I didn’t ask for them to do this! It was a little expensive but you are also paying for the experience. Overall I would recommend for a celebration dinner!

The service was attentive and the venue undeniably photogenic, but the experience fell apart as soon as the food arrived.

The menu was limited, overpriced, and felt more like a cash grab than a curated dining experience. £3.50 for a 200ml Diet Coke, not even the standard 330ml and £6 for a regular Red Bull you’d buy in Tesco for £2. The pricing simply didn’t add up.

Paying £15 for a basket of bread and dips, the kind you’d be served complimentary at most Turkish restaurants in North London - was the tipping point. The food lacked freshness, flavour, and any sense of value. We had to ask for salt and pepper and even some cheese because the pasta we ordered lacked so much flavour. We left midway, opting to settle the bill and find dessert and shisha elsewhere.

This is a place built for photos, not for food. If you’re chasing aesthetics for Instagram, it delivers. If you’re chasing quality cuisine, look elsewhere. We left disappointed and won’t return.

We went for our anniversary, and chef Ahmet as always doesn’t disappoint! The steak was amazing, and the starters were appetising. We had the basket of bread with olives to start, meze trio and steak. And we also had some dessert! The outside space is also very comfortable, think it could do with more plants. Overall a really good date night! My compliments to Chef Ahmet, and the kitchen and floor staff team!

venues.name: Le Bab
venues.description: Casual Middle Eastern & Asian spot for creative shawarma & other fare cooked over charcoal & wood.

address.formatted: Top Floor, Kingly Ct, Carnaby St, London

venues.vicinity: Top Floor, Kingly Ct, Carnaby St, London

reviews.text:
Ideal spot for lunch. Enjoyable meal, food was tasty, menu had a few different options that I would come back for.

Service was good, price was very reasonable. I went solo and had a nice spot by the window overlooking the courtyard area.

Wouldn't recommend for a dinner but definitely ideal for lunch.

Amazing service out of this world food from the lamb steak to the oh so amazing butter chicken roll. I will dream about that food and will definitely be back soon. One of the most amazing restaurants in London. Very authentic and unique flavours not found in many other places.

I had the best time here. The restaurant was cute, the waitress was really lovely and friendly, and the food was delicious. I recommend the flat iron hummus (my favourite), the smoked honey halloumi and the butter chicken kebab. It said on Google that Le Bab was started by chefs who previously worked in a Michelin star restaurant and honestly you can really tell in the food, it’s incredibly well made. I’ll defo come again.

We got the broccoli starter, the Dirty Bab, and the chicken shish kebab. All were incredible! The two kebabs were so different and gave us the opportunity to try a range of flavors. We have been before and we will be back!

Good reliable food and good options of non alcoholic beer and cocktails. Service was great. We had the salad bowls and the kale was perfectly crunchy.
Highly recommend the:
🔥 lamb adana or chicken
🔥 pistachio kulfi

The place is extremely loud so you'll need to shout even in a group of three but it was a fun vibe.

venues.name: Naroon Fitzrovia
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Bengal City, 65 Great Titchfield St., London

venues.vicinity: Bengal City, 65 Great Titchfield St., London

reviews.text: This restaurant is a real gem. The Persian stews were full of depth and flavour, the rice cooked to absolute perfection, and the aroma from the kitchen was simply unforgettable a true showcase of the chef’s skill. Everything we tried was fresh, tasty, and perfectly prepared. The service was spot on quick, friendly, and professional without ever feeling rushed. You can really tell they care about both the food and the customers. I’ll definitely be coming back.

We had an amazing experience at Naroon Fitzrovia. The food and atmosphere were both fantastic — everything we tried was delicious, but the chicken was truly out of this world.

A special mention goes to Nader, whose service was exceptional. He was attentive, professional, and made us feel genuinely welcomed from start to finish. Any restaurant would be lucky to have him run and represent them.

Highly recommend and can’t wait to return!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Lamb Shank That Took Me Back in Time

This wasn’t just a lamb shank it was an experience, a journey straight back to childhood memories I didn’t even know I’d tucked away. The very first bite stopped me in my tracks. The meat was so tender it practically slipped off the bone, no effort needed, just pure melt-in-the-mouth perfection.

The flavor balance was unreal just the right hint of smokiness, kissed with a touch of sweetness, rounded off with the perfect level of spice that warmed rather than overpowered. It was comfort and elegance in the same mouthful.

Every bite felt emotional, like revisiting a place and time that only food this soulful can unlock. It wasn’t just dinner it was memory, tradition, and craftsmanship served on a plate. Hands down, the best lamb shank I have ever had in my life.

And it wasn’t just the food. The staff were incredible. We actually booked the café by mistake instead of the restaurant, but instead of turning us away, they went out of their way to look after us. They even brought the lamb shank over from the restaurant to the café  going that extra mile that you don’t see often anymore.

While traveling in London, it was a priority to make a trip to Naroon as it had glowing reviews. It did not disappoint.

We started with the Olivieh and the Kuku Sabzi as appetizers. The olovieh could have used a bit more spice but was tasty - while the kuku took me back to childhood memories eating with my family around the table. It had pomegranate seeds sprinkled on top which added a nice contrast. The Taftoon bread and Torshi were nice complements to the appetizers and the rest of the meal.

The true standouts from our order were the mains. For the table we shared a Vaziri - which is one skewer of Joujeh Kabob (Boneless Chicken) and one skewer of Koobideh Kabob (Ground Lamb).  The Koobideh was grilled to perfection while the Joujeh was extremely tender and moist.

The Ghormeh Sabzi (Mixed Herb Stew) was one of the best I’ve had in a restaurant. You could immediately taste the dried lime doing its part to blend and mix the flavors. More times than not, when ordering this dish at a Persian restaurant, it is not fresh - however this was very fresh and comforting to eat.

At this point we were very full - yet still decided to order the desert “Se-Shir Irani” which translates to “Iranian Tres Leches.” Unfortunately, they had just sold out for the night - which was disappointing but left us something to look forward to next time.

The food, staff, space, and ambiance were all very welcoming! It will be a regular stop for me next time I’m in London.
Incredibly flavourful food with lovely service. I would highly recommend getting the platter. The meat is succulent and combined with the fragrant rice is a delight. I’d highly recommend it

venues.name: Halia Restaurant
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: This is a Malaysian style restaurant inside of the Grand Plaza Service Apartments.   The menu has good options of Malaysian dishes.   The dishes are tasty and well cooked.   Overall, a good experience here.

The location is slightly hidden but it has made this a hidden gem. The food was absolutely incredible, the pastry on the curry puffs was so flaky and the chicken curry with the nasi lemak was so flavourful.
We also got chicken satay and char kway teow which were also delicious. The server was so nice and service was quick. The food all came out hot and fresh and we enjoyed it so much.
As an FYI you need to go through a hotel to get to it, which is fine but can make it difficult to find!

A Malaysian food taste authentic experience. Portion is good. They have outdoor , indoor and 2nd storey seatings. Located inside the Grand Plaza apartments. Service was friendly. Price wise a bit expensive.

The kopi tarik was nice. Nasi lemak just average, coconut rice look like less coconut and the sambal was not bad. Rendang was not the usual kind of rendang. A bit watery and taste more like beef curry. Overall service was good and atmosphere. Next time maybe need to try different dishes to see if they taste better than Nasi Lemak

My absolute favourite Malaysian restaurant in London. Seriously the food 100% tops all other Msian restaurants so far. Delicious nasi lemak and amazing hospitality. Nurul was very pleasant helped us with the menu and was very kind to us

venues.name: Cyprus Mangal
venues.description: Sleek Turkish restaurant with a contemporary finish, plus a takeaway counter for kebabs.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Cyprus Mangal! The service was fantastic – friendly, professional, and attentive throughout. The food was absolutely excellent, and the standout for me was the ribeye steak. Honestly, it’s one of the best steaks I’ve ever had – perfectly cooked, juicy, and packed with flavour.

If you’re looking for top-quality food and great service, this place is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back!

The best Turkish/Mediterranean/Cypriot food I’ve had in London. Started with humus with lamb and the Tabbouleh. Perfection! Main meal consisted of the lamb stew and the lamb Kofta, which included a fresh salad and rice.

Try the Kenafeh and chocolate brownies, delicious.

Highly recommend paying them a visit!

One of the Best Halal Turkish Restaurants in Victoria – A Must-Visit 🇹🇷✨

I’ve been coming to Cyprus Mangal since 2017, and it’s hands down one of the top Turkish spots in Victoria – and yes, it’s fully halal.

The food is consistently delicious, with generous portions, especially on the lunchtime menu – ideal for work breaks, quick catch-ups, or relaxed group meals. You get proper flavour and freshness every single time.

The atmosphere is cosy and welcoming, with stylish furnishings and a great energy throughout. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or staying for a full meal, the service is fast, friendly, and always on point. Shoutout to Gokan and the whole team – from the chefs to the servers, they make you feel at home.

A hidden gem that never disappoints. If you’re in the area, make this your go-to for halal Turkish food.

I had a fantastic meal at Cyprus Mangal! From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel so welcome and looked after us with genuine care. The atmosphere is cozy yet lively, perfect for a relaxed evening.
If I could give this restaurant 6 stars I would... Best Turkish food Ive tasted in the UK so far. Service was amazing - Habib and Martin were both super.

venues.name: Mildreds Covent Garden
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Popped in for a Birthday lunch, solo. Was accommodated with a space at the bar (as I hadn't booked & it was very busy!), I found the service was very quick, helpful and friendly too. Food delicious & quickly served. I chose the Burrito with a side of lemon pepper fries with a glass of 0% fizz.

Will definitely be back to enjoy again✨

I had high expectations coming here due to the reviews and I was not let down. The food was exceptional and the service was fabulous.

It was actually hard to pick some starters because I honestly wanted to try them all. We settled on the Salsa Macha Hummus with some Pita Bread and Cherry Harissa Patatas Bravas. The bread was served warm and was so doughy - perfect to soak up the delicious hummus!

For mains we had the Kimchi Bokkeumbap (so flavourful and plentiful as the picture does not do the portion size justice) and the Souvlaki & Meze (it says great for sharing on the menu but ‘Joey doesn’t share food’!!!).

Service was great. We were asked once during the starters and once during the mains how are food was and the water was refilled at our table without us having to ask.

Not the cheapest place to dine, but you will not be disappointed.

We arrived around 6:00 in the evening when the place was quite busy, but the atmosphere was lively and enjoyable. We were seated outside, which gave us a great chance to soak it all in while waiting for our food, about 15-20 minutes, which felt just right.

The service was mostly fine, though there was a slight hiccup. My wife asked a server for some ketchup, but it never came, so she had to go inside and get it herself. Not a huge deal, but a small letdown in an otherwise decent experience.

As for the food, it tasted good, definitely enjoyable, though there’s a bit of room for improvement. Overall, I’d say it was a solid visit, and I’m happy to give it four stars.

Fantastic dinner tonight, shared a tasting menu with my brother huge amount of delicious food to try. Highly recommend trying this!
Noha served us throughout the evening and was beyond attentive, polite and knowledgeable. She made us feel so welcome and served us with a smile throughout.

Staff were lovely & food was delicious!!!! Thanks to Asha, Connie and Mitchell specifically. We had a big group  and they were so accommodating. I’m not vegan but I don’t eat dairy and it was amazing getting to enjoy the desserts (I shared with my friends). I had the Korean burger and loaded fries. They were so tasty!

venues.name: Mildreds Victoria
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Mildred’s has been on my list for several years, I was finally able to go, and I was not disappointed, neither were my friends. Our food was perfectly prepared(very flavorful, nice ingredient combinations), had nice textures, and was nicely plated.

I ordered the green tofu salad with southern fried plant chick+n. It was very fresh. The sugar-snap peas added a pleasant crunch to the salad and the avocado dressing was very flavorful and refreshing. The marinated tofu was flavorful as well. The portion size was perfect.

My friends ordered the ale mushroom pot pie, the kimchi bokkeumbap, and tofu green salad. Our table shared the turmeric carrot humus, pita/paratha and lemon pepper fries.

Even as the restaurant started to fill up we were able to have conversations in normal speaking tones.

Mildreds Victoria will definitely be one of my go to restaurants whenever I’m in London.

I went to dinner with my friend on a busy Saturday evening. The place was bustling, we had a lovely time together. The staff were friendly and accommodating, the food was generally good and reasonably priced. My friend ordered the kimchi rice, tofu dish, which I tried and wished I'd ordered myself. I had  a veggie burrito dish, which wasn't as flavoursome or exciting as the rice in my opinion. However, we both absolutely loved the pistachio cheesecake. Overall a wonderful dining experience and we will definitely visit again soon.

We had such a lovely experience at Mildred's. Service staff was very friendly and accommodating. They could explain the menu and took note of any allergies. Food was amazing, everything we had was delicious including the cocktails. The restaurant itself is decorated very tasteful, but when full it is very noisy.

Went for a quick brunch with the family. We needed a vegetarian/vegan restaurant with a kids friendly menu and Mildred’s was the google search we landed on.

Nice relaxed vibe with great variety in the menu if you are vegan. Dedicated kids menu with the select not too far off from the “usual” kids favourites.

Star of the day was the kiri hodi with the pineapple, ginger and apple juice to match.

Lovely restaurant, food tasted lovely and staff were super friendly. My main dish however was rather disappointing. I ordered the mushroom ale pot pie and although it looked fab, it did end up becoming  extremely messy so didn't enjoy it as much as I thought I would. The pastry was just placed on the mushroom pie so went all over my clothes when I tried cutting into it.
I did end up having to move the pastry onto a separate plate and eating the mushrooms separate and the pastry part separate.

venues.name: Mallow Borough Market
venues.description: Eco-friendly, bohemian eatery serving plant-based global dishes made from area-sourced ingredients.

reviews.text: Had a great breakfast at Mallow yesterday. Thank you to Laurence for being so amazing and going above and beyond for us, it was really appreciated. Service was excellent and food was so delicious. Look forward to visiting again & trying out the dinner options. Recommend having breakfast/ brunch here- we had French toast & pistachio pancakes!! Great vegan spot with beautiful interiors and lovely staff, making the experience 10/10. Thanks again!

Mallow was fantastic - everyone was impressed and the sharing menu and paired wine flight was so much fun. Amazing dessert and dessert wine. My non vegan family was amazed at the food and loved every course. Staff was attentive, kind, thoughtful, and made the experience so special. The food was amazing bar none

Thoughtful menu that is refreshed regularly and has really delicious dishes - both comforting and innovative. Pistachio cake recently is cut above. I take friends and go on my own. Beautiful building in Borough, wonderful place to meet and spend time. Friendly, accommodating staff.

Attentive service, lovely decor (quite hard to hear though) and nice menu. We all shared the set market menu which was good. I felt everything just needed to be much more impactful flavour wise. It was all quite samey and needed a really good whack of seasoning. Good portion sizes and colourful, clearly packed full of veg and not just bland starches like some vegan joints offer. Lovely people just not for me.

Amazing service I have to first day. Lovely calming interiors and very nice decorations. The staff were ever so friendly and helpful with the menus! Now I’m not usually customer at vegan restaurants - love my meat but this was a nice change! Only advice I would have is perhaps expanding on the menu descriptions as we did not realise the starters we ordered were very saucy. The mushroom ravioli was lovely - unique flavours and ingredients.
Good selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks too.

venues.name: Vantra Vegan
venues.description: Raw & cooked vegan dishes, along with a buffet, in a small, light, plant-filled cafe.

reviews.text:
The cracker chaat and the cracker appetizers were good. The  Dragon roll sushi was excellent. The lentil dish and curry Laksa were disappointing. The lentil dish had a strange sauce on it that made it inedible. The Laksa had heat but was bland in flavor.

We also had a smoothie, juice and teas all of which were excellent.

The service was slow even when the restaurant was not busy.

Some dishes are good, some are strange.

Recommend the exotic curry! Great flavors, great choice of vegetables that go with it.

Avoid the rainbow dish, felt like random vegetables thrown together with vastly different tastes that don't go together well.

Drinks are on the pricier side.

Amazing quite place in middle of busy London! Food is delicious well balanced! Fast and nice staff member.

Our favorite was dragon roll & gorilla green raw salad 🥗

Vantra was an excellent discovery. The service was warm and attentive.  Our server mentioned it was only their third shift and handled everything with ease. They offered to box our food without us asking, which was appreciated.

The menu offers a vast selection, including cocktails and puddings. I had the Dan Dan Mian with tofu lamb, which looked so good my friend ordered it too. My boyfriend chose the chat, which he also enjoyed, and tasted good to me!

We loved it so much we stayed for another round of drinks. Can’t wait to go back and tackle some more of the menu!

We recently discovered Vantra during a short trip to London, and I’m so glad we did! Honestly, it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences I’ve ever had.

We started with the vegan “meat” skewers in a peanut-like sauce. So flavorful that we kept the plate on the table just to dip our fries into the sauce later (it was that good!). Then came a kind of flatbread topped with fresh ingredients, and finally the absolute highlight: a sushi burger served with a mix of potato and sweet potato fries, delicious dips, and a side salad.
