This restaurant in Shoreditch offers some of the best service I’ve ever received. The atmosphere is lively and the food is delicious. We tried the fried chicken and the seared salmon, but both were a bit under-seasoned for our taste. I highly recommend this place for live music and excellent service. Don’t forget to make a reservation, though!

venues.name: Lina Stores Shoreditch - Italian Restaurant & Bar
venues.description: Authentic Italian flavors with a London twist - because sometimes you need a taste of la dolce vita. Located in the trendy surroundings of Hackney, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I stopped here impromptu on my way elsewhere and was so pleasantly surprised by the level of authenticity in the food and outstanding service.  I haven't had Italian food this wonderful since Italy. Smaller (right-size) portions, a wonderful wine selection, really kind attentive service. This place should not be missed.

Lina Stores is a really good Italian option at reasonable prices. The food is simple but with fresh ingredients and the ambience in the Shoreditch branch is slightly quirky and quaint with its monochromatic pale green interiors. The desserts were super moist and delicious too! Overall, this is a fantastic option for great tasting Italian food at good prices.

There are a few Lina Stores in London with each always guaranteeing a great Italian meal, but the one in Shoreditch boasts a very cool basement bar with excellent cocktail choices. The atmosphere is quite intimate and moody, perfect for a romantic date or a friendly conversation. The food as always was excellent.

PASTA & HIDDEN COCKTAILS 🇮🇹
📍 Shoreditch, London
⭐️ 5/5
💸 ££
🍴Honestly… I’m in love! 😍 We visited the #Shoreditch branch of @linastores, set inside a beautifully restored former bank (yes, with all the charm and grandeur you’d imagine), and it instantly became one of my new favourite date night spots in London✨

We went a little wild with the #Antipasti and it was so worth it:
🫒 #Burrata e Olio d’Oliva – creamy heaven.
🐟 Vitello #Tonnato – MY FAV, so delicate yet packed with flavour.
🍞 #Focaccia al Rosmarino e Sale Marino – so fluffy and salty, a total must.
🦐 #Gamberi Grigliati – grilled prawns that were honestly some of the best I’ve had in London! 🔥

For mains, we went full #pasta mode:
🍅 #Ravioli con Burrata e Salsa di Datterini – huge, soft parcels of joy
🍝 #Pappardelle con Ragù di Salsiccia di Agnello – rich, spicy and comforting

Desserts? Of course!
☕️The #Tiramisù was dreamy
🍮 The #PannaCotta was my personal fave — silky and light!

But wait, there’s more! 👀 We then snuck downstairs into their secret #speakeasy aperitivo bar: @bar___lina 🍸 So mysterious, so chic, and honestly the perfect post-dinner vibe. We were overwhelmed with amazing #cocktail options but the bartender was super helpful and made incredible suggestions.
My top picks:
🍊CONFORMISTA – Adriatico #Amaretto, Cadello 88, Grapefruit, Rooibos
💚BASILICO – Basil-infused #Gin, Mancino Secco, Milk… refreshing and smooth

Truly a 10/10 experience. Delicious food, elegant setting, hidden cocktail bar… the dream cute & sexy date night combo!
I’m a little bit of an Italian food snob, and the green salad, fried artichokes, and pici pasta were all amazing! The staff was really kind, and I felt comfortable dining solo there.

venues.name: Lahpet Shoreditch
venues.description: An array of small & shared plates in a contemporary setting with lively hanging plants, & full bar.

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food with friendly stuff. Super nice place to have a lovely evening. The superstar dish for me is the coconut noodles. Cocktails are great as well

BEAUTIFUL SPACE
The interiors are bang on the money, this location has a homely and welcoming and communal feel. The paper menu placemats and beautifully curved reusable branded coolers and bamboo straws, felt intentional, purposeful and reflective of the brand. It's clear I'm in love with the space (the bar stools with backrests sealed the deal for me).

The food, is done well. We ordered a number of dishes so we got a good sample of the menu. It was delish!
The menu is selective without being limiting.

This is a really nice spot. Highly recommended.

Excellent Burmese food in a modern restaurant with good service and ambience! Shared tea leaf salad, papaya salad, hake curry, chicken coconut noodle soup, coconut rice and crème brûlée between three people. All dishes were consistently reasonable in portion, flavoursome and delicious. The crunchy salads and the perfectly cooked fish were my favourites. The chicken noodles were lovely but I wouldn’t have again (personal preference). Highly recommend this place - ticks all the boxes ie enjoyment, quality and value.

Incredible food at a good price - Burmese cuisine is one of the most underrated in my opinion! Pyae was a really helpful and kind waitress, and Min is a terrific head chef! Dishes were super delicious!

This place has the most amazing food. The portions are really good as well. I went here for my birthday and was entirely pleased with the whole experience. I'm definitely going back, I recommend you all give it a try, too.

venues.name: The Clove Club
venues.description: Cutting-edge restaurant and bar for innovative British menu using often-overlooked ingredients.

address.formatted: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old St, London

venues.vicinity: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old St, London

reviews.text: A lovely tasting menu with a few surprises along the way. The extra course of Scottish blue shell lobster was the most memorable, especially the curly noodles in lobster bisque in the 2nd serving. The portion size with the extra course was good.  In fact, most dishes were quite small and light, although understandable for a summer menu, the overall portion could be more generous throughout. The restaurant was situated inside the Shoreditch Town Hall but the interior design was not able to capture the classic elegance of the original architecture. It was more or less a typical London restaurant establishment. Service was prompt and friendly, with a minor error on the bill in the end that the more experienced server admitted the mistake right away and took it to rectify.
My daughter and I had a wonderful meal. The wine and NA pairings were a great compliment to each dish. Stellar dining experience and top notch hospitality. Very much looking forward to returning.

Had the best birthday dinner here.
I have been to many fine dining places before as a former New Yorker and The Clove Club topped a lot of the previous experiences I had.

All dish were experimental and creative but very well balanced in every aspect. There are some dishes with flavors and textures I've never tasted. Overall exquisite!
The service and hospitality was also exceptional. I would definitely recommend The Clove Club to my friends and would love to come back!!! Thank you for completing my perfect birthday celebration.

I had a blast at The Clove Club. The food was fantastic across the board- with some of the highlights being the scallop sashimi,the lamb, the langoustine and the granita. Portions are perfectly sized and the flavors balanced so that you never feel too full and bloated. Excellent selection of wines and a sommelier who's clearly passionate about his trade.  In fact, every member of the staff was courteous and attentive while leaving enough space for the guests to feel relaxed.

Truly, a pillar of the London fine dining scene.

Be respect to the most kindness, warm and focus on detailed services from Mr Pablo, Daniel and the team.

And for sure, the atmosphere, the taste of the each section, as I also I want to highlight the best dishes “Raw Orkney Scallop”, excellent excellent excellent.

Definitely will recommended to our friends if drop by London. And we must come back later.

venues.name: Camino Shoreditch
venues.description: Colourful, eclectic venue with a relaxed ambiance for inventive Spanish tapas and interesting wines.

reviews.text: The food was generally very good, but the mushroom coca was truly unique and special — the best mushrooms I’ve ever tasted. The succulent pig was a little on the dry side, but everything else was excellent. The service was outstanding, and the atmosphere was beautiful, with wonderfully tasteful décor.
Firstly, the service was top notch. Lovely, friendly staff. The food was as good as I’ve had in Barcelona. They even got it out to me in a couple of minutes as I was in a rush. 10/10 will be back.

Ended up going twice on two consecutive nights! Really nice tapas, selection wasn't huge but everything I had was really well done. Ended up trying both the tomato bread, tortilla, ox cheek, flattened pork, croquettes, bravas, padron peppers and the cheesecake. Everything was really tasty. Cheesecake in particular was incredible - creamy but not too sweet. Prices were about what I expect for the area. Service from Sergio and the other guy (sorry didnt catch his name!) was really friendly and attentive. Will 100% be back when I'm in the area again.

Went to Camino a while back for a bit of dinner with an old pal and it was a really enjoyable experience. The place was quiet (which is why I’ve only given 4 stars for atmosphere) but the food was great, the wine was delicious and the over experience was top notch.

Highly recommend Camino if you are looking for somewhere for good quality tapas that’s centre to the City or Shoreditch

Really good tapas dishes with decent portions. We had 6 plates between the 2 of us and that was enough to fill us up. It was relatively quiet as it was a sat afternoon but would expect it to be busy in the evenings. Would definitely recommend

venues.name: BRAT Restaurant
venues.description: There’s strong Basque influences on the menu of this rustic Spanish spot with open wood fire grill.

reviews.text:
The restaurant had been on my list for years but I did not know they got a Michelin star in 2025.

Food was amazing from start to finish. With some Tartare, Mussels toast and Pigeon skewer to begin with.
And then some Dover Sole, Mallard, vegetables and potatoes. All that with a side of bread and butter. And a cheesecake finish.

Service was great and they explained everything. Wine list was also great with lots of options (including Sherry and Dessert wine)

I highly recommend the place

Beautiful restaurant with highly imaginative cooking. The only areas where it comes up a little bit short are, first, value for money - the portions are small considering their prices, and the pricing on the grilled fish and meat is particularly dear. Second, the dining room is packed in a little bit tight and there is very little room to manoeuvre, once you arrive and are sat you pretty much have to stay put as the dining room is very dense and very busy. The vegetable dishes were the star of the show and if I were to do it all over again I would order only vegetarian dishes and a bottle of wine. Standout items were the red peppers cooked for 24 hours in sherry and olive oil, the skewer of squid and sobrassada, the squash with seasonal greens and yogurt, and the chocolate sorbet with plum. I’d booked the restaurant for a special occasion, and besides acknowledging that from their notes nothing was done about it including not providing the table by the kitchen as I had requested and they’d promised to do. Overall glad we went and we did enjoy the vibe and the overall experience.

Excellent and attentive service. Super friendly and engaging staff who take the time to explain the menu and story behind it : thank you for all the dishes and wines recommandations!

Lunch was delicious from start to finish: a special mention for the Dover sole & grilled veggies and sparkling white wine👌🏾

Loved watching the big open kitchen work while enjoying my lunch, as well as seeing the other options ordered by fellow guests. A must try when in London. I will definitely come back, MERCI !

Mix bag feeling after my first visit and considering the price point and the 1 Michelin star rating.
Quality of ingredients is great and flavours are clean and strong. However, food was like warm and a very long wait between starters and mains. This was also the case for the 2 tables next to us and even the waiter was advising other tables to place their order all together as there will be long delays in serving the main. So it feels like a regular issue.
Service was great and attentive. When commenting on the delays, they positively reacted.
Atmosphere is more one of a gastro pub than a Michelin star. Tables too close to each other, you are literally touching elbows with your neighbours. I would also expect a proper napkin at this price level and not a paper one. Cutlery and china are basic.
Maybe the venue in Hackney delivers more buck for money but I was not really impressed here. Feels like they are squeezing the maximum juice from their reputation here and rely on tourist to fill their seats.

Wonderful grilled bread and wood pigeon. Very difficult to book though. Tables were too close to one another to be fully comfortable and servers were always behind or above my head trying to get cutlery to serve other tables as I was seated next to the cultery station. Nonetheless, seeing the kitchen in action was amazing.

venues.name: Rochelle Canteen
venues.description: Cafe/restaurant in bike shed of school turned arts and media complex serving short, modern menu.

reviews.text:
This is a lovely restaurant tucked away behind a wall. You need to be buzzed in to eat here. What this means, of course, is that you have to be intentional to eat here, and make a reservation. It is worth it.

It was a lovely day, so we ate outside under the pergola filled with ripening grapes. For starters, we had the cod roe dip with fresh baby radishes and absolutely delicious tomato salad topped with feta. The tomatoes were fresh and juicy, and it was just a lovely summer dish. For an entrees, one of us had the tuna with white beans. The fish was perfectly cooked, and the portion was substantial. The rest of us had two of the specials of the day. I had the crispy lamb ribs, which were quite an unusual preparation, but they were very tender and tasty. The wagyu beef entree was sensational. Perfectly cooked beef served with horseradish and some spicy greens. It was truly a lovely meal.

They have several cocktails plus a nice list of wines by the glass.

The staff is great, and the ambience very calm and beautiful. Beautiful. I highly recommend this lovely restaurant.

The food was great with good ingredients. The service was excellent and very quick. The restaurant was in a covered area which was nice but would have been nicer in the outside garden area in the summertime. Overall was a bit pricey but the quality of the food was good. Portion sizes were normal

Been wanting to come here for a while now.
Food was mostly good. Cod was cooked perfectly, short rib was a beautiful cut in a delicious gravy. The lamb croquettes were a highlight!

Sides were a bit undercooked for my liking. Tough cabbage and potatoes. Wine was excellent and service mostly good.
One waiter would just dump our plates on the table without talking us through the dishes. Maybe that's not their policy but it's a nice touch to be reminded of the elements.
Otherwise, our main waitress was excellent.

Rochelle is certainly one of the institutions in East London and I have been trying many times to visit.
I left very disappointed.
The food was ok, good products but nothing to rave about. My main garnish was stone cold and the steak cooking instructions was not as requested. The service was so slow, although they do ask you to place your order within 15 minutes of your booking to get the tables back, but didn’t deliver speedy delivery.
That’s a shame as the setup is great, a little oasis in the middle of London.

Delicious food with delicate and amazing flavours - loved the scallops, the mussels, the courgettes and the pumpkin soup (bread was a bit disappointing as it was cold and the butter was hard to spread - excellent to dip in the sauces of the dishes though). Excellent wine list. Servers were friendly and attentive. The garden area is really beautiful on a sunny day. Will definitely be back!

venues.name: The Light Bar & Dining
venues.description: Converted warehouse with beer garden and roof terrace, Modern European dining and weekend DJs.

reviews.text:
We booked the Loft at The Light Bar this weekend to host our wedding drinks and couldn’t be happier with the top tier service we received!
Great communications and explanation throughout. Excellent food & bar service and very grateful for the little extra mile they went on countless details of hosting a wedding party night for 90 approx people.
They provided ample amount of the amenities needed, kept me updated throughout a smooth running night. Fantastic staff and service. Thanks team!

I was there once and I liked the experience! We were 3 girls, ended up at The Light Bar on a Friday evening. We ordered cocktails and I loved mine! The service was good, the staff is nice and the space is spacious. I do think that it might be also a good venue for celebrations or events. There was a live DJ playing and he really nailed it. Although it is a bit loudy, I really liked the place and you can still find a place to chill and hear each other somewhere upstairs. Recommended!

The Light Bar hosted my VIP Dinner for women in my professional network in London. From the moment of booking, the staff were so helpful and communication and planning was spot on. We did a group set menu and the food was spectacular, so delicious and very generous servings with wonderful fresh, rich flavours. They kindly catered to dietary requirements and the service was impeccable - they really took care of us and we were all super impressed. They accommodated us moving to an outdoor table given it was such a beautiful balmy June evening and it was truly magical to relax and connect. Would absolutely recommend it for any corporate or personal event - it was an amazing venue.

Along with cocktails, the group set menu was absolutely spectacular starting with burrata and peppers, salmon fennel citrus salad, trout and crème fraiche, flatbreads both plain and topped with olive and tomato, and crispy chickpea hummus. Next came shared mains - delicious hispy cabbage on ratatouille, basil pesto baked orzo with rocket and Parmesan, and a baby chicken with gravy and greens. And of course we squeezed in the mountain of crispy churros with chocolate pots because dessert obviously goes into another tube.

I was truly blown away by the fresh flavour-packed dishes, perfect location, and wonderful service. I’m still dreaming of that heavenly trout dip…

the burger is decent but not really really good. the menu got limited choices. service is alright but it took a while to get a pint from them. dj music is a bit too loud at dinner time. dont really know the positioning of this restaurant / bar. it is below average if you consider it as a restaurant. it is ok if you treat it as a bar. probably not visit again in the near future.

Nice little after work hang out spot, but I would definitely book a table if you can, especially if you’re coming in a bigger group. Margaritas were fantastic and the food was even better!!! I really recommend the flatbread and they have loads of different toppings for it. As soon as they closed the retractable roof, it became very cosy and intimate. Also good music!

venues.name: Barrio - Shoreditch
venues.description: Vibrant destination serving tapas-style food & cocktails, plus late night club with DJs.

reviews.text: Fun place with amazing tacos. We went on a friday evening and it was happy hour (woot woot) cocktails were refreshing on a hot day like that.. the tacos were delicious! Music was great. Overall a good experience and would definitely bring more people with us next time.

Food was not too bad, it came and it was already cold. Tacos are cheap and small, fries too expensive for what you actually get.
We were also asked to leave a 5 star review and mention Mohit for drinks (who didn’t serve us either), we did but he never came back! Spoiler alert Mohit: you can update the review after submitting it! 😜

I stood at the host stand with 3 people chatting for a while before I was acknowledged. The bar experience was the same. The “Tommy’s Margarita” was so sweet and gut-rot worthy tbh. & the tacos were SO disappointing. Literally krafts singles  (as pictured) & tasteless.
Atmosphere & decor were lovely but otherwise so truly disappointing.
& having to pay a service charge while I’m ordering from a QR code.

Barrio Shoreditch was such a fun vibe. Great spot for tacos and cocktails with a proper party atmosphere. Music was lively, the decor was colourful, and the staff were great. Perfect place to start a night out, definitely going back.

Unfortunately a really disappointing service on a birthday night out. Went to order drinks at the bar and had to struggle to get the two free bartenders attention then finally ordered but our bartender slowly stopped and took shots with another bartender instead while we waited.
The jug was filled with ice and barely garnished which the official instagram had led us to believe was part of service.
The bar is very pretty and the drinks were okay but disappointed how customers seem to be a hindrance to staff

venues.name: 34 Mayfair
venues.description: British game and world meats cooked on an imported Argentinian grill in art deco-inspired brasserie.

address.formatted: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London

venues.vicinity: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London

reviews.text:
Went here on day 1 of our London trip for anniversary dinner.

Fancy interior and utensils.
Food was delicious, particularly hummus and broccoli.

Staff were friendly and kind and they also have live music.

Definitely recommend for dates/friends gathering/family dinner.

This place is amazing. We had outdoor seating which I highly recommend if the weather is nice. My wife had the lemon sole, which was the special of the day and I had the ribeye. Both were very good, but the real winner here were the desserts. We had the chocolate fondant tart and the homemade donuts. I'm not sure how both of them can rank in our top 10 desserts ever, but they do. We're in town for a week and are already planning to go back for dessert again. Highly recommended!
And a word about our server, Remus - he was fantastic. Very attentive, helpful with suggestions and quick to clear dirty plates. While we were there a lady at the table next to us (seating is very close) complained to him about a menu item that was not available. He responded apologetically but she wouldn't take no for an answer she continued on and on and made mention of how betrayed she felt and that she felt like she was lied to by the receptionist she spoke with earlier in the day. Remus maintained his composure and continued to respond kindly to her. The situation was clearly beyond Remus' control. Much respect to him for handling the situation with grace.

Today, we had lunch at the 34 Mayfair in London. The food was not that great but not bad either. However, the portion sizes were very, very small. The octopus was minuscule. Avoiding gluten was impossible no matter how carefully one orders. The matcha-based non-alcoholic drink was quite disappointing – it was overpowered with lemon and didn’t taste like it had any matcha. Additionally, the salad looked limp and the leaves didn’t seem very fresh. Also, all bread was sweet. Riffle with chicken tasted good but the coating on the chicken didn’t stick well and the croffle was too sweet to be in that dish. The sole was good. Overall, it was just an okay meal, not really a great experience.
An average fine dining. My favorite Mac & cheese. Others liked the steak but we all agreed that the burrata salad wasn’t a great choice.
One of my best dinner experience in London. Definitely coming back. My wife loved it so much. The food is top notch and the staffs are awesome.

venues.name: Bacchanalia Mayfair
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.author_name: Samira Hotel, Food, Travel& Beauty Expert
reviews.text:
Breathtaking atmosphere — a true visual spectacle.
The interior at Bacchanalia is absolutely stunning. The ceiling installations with the winged horses and the opulent garlands are nothing short of mesmerizing — it feels like dining inside a living artwork. The decor alone makes the visit unforgettable.

The only downside was the wait. Even with a reservation, we had to wait quite a while for our table, which was a bit frustrating considering how busy it was. However, the staff handled it well and offered us an aperitif, which was a classy touch and made the delay more bearable.

Once seated, everything turned around — the food was outstanding. The flavors, presentation, and quality were exactly what you’d expect from a place of this level. Service throughout the meal was warm and well-coordinated.

Bacchanalia really does feel more like an experience than just dinner. The space is dramatic — Roman statues, rich colors, and a kind of grandeur that makes you pause when you walk in. It’s bold and theatrical, but somehow still inviting.

The food was excellent across the board. Fresh seafood, perfectly made pasta, and a wine list that clearly had thought put into it. Service was attentive without being too much, which I appreciated.

The star for me, though, was dessert — the Medusa pavlova (pictured). It’s almost too beautiful to touch, a sculpted meringue surrounded by cream, berries, and coulis. But once you dig in, the flavors are as good as the presentation — light, crisp, tangy, and sweet in just the right balance.

The food here is decent but not outstanding — I’d give it about 6.5 out of 10. Service is around 6 out of 10 as well. The atmosphere, however, is excellent — a solid 10 out of 10. Overall, if you’re coming mainly for the ambiance, it’s worth visiting. But if you’re looking for really great food, this might not be the place for you.

Extremely disappointing experience. The food fell far below expectations—what was meant to be “truffle tagliatelle” ended up tasting like a fish soup. The pasta itself was overcooked and mushy, the sauce thin and watery instead of creamy, and there was no hint of truffle at all. Easily the worst truffle pasta I’ve ever had, despite trying similar dishes in top restaurants across Dubai, Doha, Marbella, Paris, and London when the waiter
Tried to make it seem as if I wouldn’t know what good truffle pasta was supposed to taste like
The restaurant’s interior is undeniably beautiful, with elegant décor that raises your expectations, but sadly the food did not match the setting. The starters were average at best, and the main course was a complete letdown. For the price charged, the quality simply isn’t justified—I left both hungry and annoyed.

Adding to the disappointment, TikTok suggested there would be entertainment—music or a show—but the atmosphere was completely flat. On a Saturday night, the place was lifeless, and we were told to leave at midnight when it closed.

Overall, a waste of money and time. I won’t be returning, and I wouldn’t recommend booking here.

This place is… something. Lavish refurbishment? Yes. Tacky and remarkable in equal measure? Also yes, though not always in a good way. We came for a friend’s birthday lunch, having booked a set menu online that included three courses, a welcome drink, and a cocktail. Sadly, what we got was a juice shot, no cocktail, and a bizarre negotiation with staff to honour what we’d already paid for. The waiter admitted the deal wasn’t running anymore but said a manager might approve it. We eventually got our drinks—after pleading—and overheard the same thing happening to the table next to us.

The food was fine, the live opera we barely caught, and the senior staff were dismissive at best. Host team and servers were lovely, but the overall experience left a bad taste.

It’s the sort of place where the decor’s louder than the service. Not awful, but wouldn’t rush back.

venues.name: COYA Mayfair
venues.description: Upmarket venue with 3 open kitchens, serving Peruvian sharing plates, char-grill dishes and ceviche.

reviews.text:
Beautiful restaurant if you are looking for something special.  The service and attention was refined and not overwhelming. The sommelier was knowledgeable and eager to help find that right wine.
The food was cleverly presented and eye pleasing.
That had several dining option which was very much appreciated. Set menu pair with drinks or order a la cart
The thing you need to be aware is if you want a leisurely meal the set menu is at the kitchens pace. Felt a bit rushed and even the lunch menu states it’s designed to be an hour. Meaning looking to turn tables.
The waiter never made us feel rushed but the pace nonetheless felt it. Waiter tried to accommodate.
It is a bit pricey and value of food was almost there but was stretched. Again beautifully presented. We asked for our beef fillet medium rare but was medium well. But the value was made up by ambience and the staffs attention.
So more of a destination dining experience than a culinary destination.
That honestly stated , we had a most enjoyable dining experience.

Tried during June for 2, we weren’t super hungry so we got this and was more than enough:

Tacos de Shiitake con Chalaquita (6/10), tasted soulless tbh, but others could enjoy it as a vegetarian option.

Classic Sea Bass Ceviche (10/10) absolutely divine.

Pollo a la Parrilla (10/10) so soft and full flavor, amazing.

Would love to come here again to try other dishes 👍🏻

Nothing special! Definitely not worth the fortune we paid. The waiter forgot one of our starters and generally, we were advised that we had ordered loads of food whereas we left the place hungry. The portions are extremely small for what you pay.
Will not go back.

I had an amazing first experience at Coya Mayfair London! From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with the warm smile of Zuzana, which immediately made me feel welcome. Even though the restaurant was very busy with a private event, she did her best to accommodate my request to change tables — something I truly appreciated.

My server, Peter, was outstanding — patient, attentive, and explained everything in detail, which made the whole dining experience even better. The food was absolutely delicious, and throughout the evening, different staff members checked in to make sure everything was perfect.

Special mention to Zenek, the manager, who handled everything so professionally and ensured the atmosphere stayed smooth and enjoyable despite the busy night.

Highly recommend this place for its incredible food, warm hospitality, and top-notch service. Can’t wait to come back!

The staff were excellent! very attentive and created a welcoming atmosphere. The food was decent, though I don’t think it fully justified the price, but it was still better than average. I also appreciated that the empanadas were made with corn flour.

venues.name: Gaia Mayfair
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The foods don’t worth the price！The seafood pasta was way too sweet and the broccoli was not even cooked. Raw prawn (50pounds per)and scallops (28-29pounds per scallop and we ordered 2) def don’t worth their money …. As well as I feel I am spending money for a Michelin but I literally sat in a noisy pub🤯Having my friend birthday here and both of us were super disappointed .we did not order a drink so no comment lol..

Gaia in Mayfair is a stylish and upscale Greek restaurant with a fine-dining atmosphere. The place has a chic, modern vibe — exactly what you’d expect in this part of London. The food is exquisite, with authentic Greek flavours and a sharing-style concept that makes the experience more enjoyable and social. The quality is excellent, and the service is just as impressive. Overall, it’s a fantastic spot for a refined Greek dining experience in the heart of Mayfair.

The food and atmosphere were nice, we ordered the seafood orzo, mousaka, truffle potato’s, sea bream, and frozen yoghurt for dessert. All these dishes tasted lovely. We had to return the chicken dish because it had a smell, was chewy and quite tasteless. The manager was nice enough to speak to the chef and cut it from our bill as we weren’t able to eat it and had it returned to the kitchen. The only reason I’m rating it 4 stars was due to the fact we felt a little rushed to place our orders. The service was good, but the front of house reception staff member was rude as we arrived 15 minutes late to a reservation which we did call in advance to let them know we were running behind schedule and they told us that it’s fine and they would hold our reservation, baring in mind when we arrived the restaurant it was half empty and there was lots of space as we left a couple of hours later. Other than that experience, the staff allocated to serving our table were kind and knowledgeable about the menu. The wait staff good suggestions and recommendations and they were attentive to our table. Really friendly and polite.

perfect ambiance. the service was amazing and our waiter helped us so so so much. she was so friendly and we loved her service. the food was SOO good and i loved it. the mousaka is AMAZING. the grilled prawns were the best ive ever had. these two, you CANNOT miss! i really recomend the taziki and greek salad as they are so yummy, fresh and perfect staples. for mains, we got the grilled chicken to share, which was so fresh and marinated so well. the side, the truffle potatoes are amazing and a must try. ofcourse, the froszen yogurt is also amazing and i really recomend. overall really yummy and great place.

Gaia is one of the London restaurants that you want to go to, the food was nice and the waters were so welcoming, they took us to our table and we requested to change it and they helped directly.

The atmosphere was nice with a little bit noise but you can easily talk and hear..

For the food we tried the steak and it was juicy and perfect, the linguine pasta was nice with the lobster also.

Generally i like the place and for sure I will come again to try different dishes.

venues.name: The MAINE
venues.description: New England cuisine spotlighted in an opulent, historic venue with cabaret entertainment.

reviews.text:
We went to Maine Mayfair in London for a girls’ night out and absolutely loved the vibe and atmosphere from start to finish. The food was great, the music was amazing, and the cabaret dancer was lovely (though the performance ended a bit too soon!).

A huge thank you to Maria, who handled our booking — she was absolutely incredible from beginning to end. Our server, the hosts, and the sommelier were all so attentive and kind.

The only part that wasn’t perfect was when an older gentleman wearing a cowboy hat who works there asked us to turn off our flash, saying it might disturb the musicians, even though our flash wasn’t facing the stage. Many others were using flash around us without being told anything, which left us feeling a bit singled out.

That aside, we had the best table in the house — right in the middle in front of the stage — and the atmosphere was incredible. As a Canadian, I also loved discovering that the restaurant is owned by a fellow Canadian, Joey Ghazal which made the experience even more special.

Overall, it was a wonderful night, and we’d definitely come back again in the future!

We went to The MAINE Mayfair to celebrate our civil wedding anniversary, and once again, they completely exceeded our expectations. Every time we visit, the service, food, and atmosphere leave us speechless — it’s exactly why we keep coming back.

This time, we started with the butter lettuce salad, which was so fresh and tasty with a uniquely delicious dressing. The cauliflower taco as a starter absolutely stole the show — the highlight of the evening. For the main course, we had the large cut sirloin, perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor, paired with asparagus on the side. Everything was spot on.

For dessert, we tried the cookie topped with ice cream — simply heavenly! To our surprise, the team brought out a chocolate cake with a “Happy Anniversary” note, which made the evening even more special.

The service here is consistently outstanding. Every staff member is attentive, kind, and genuinely welcoming. The atmosphere is just as remarkable — we always love the beautiful décor and the lively entertainment that makes the whole experience unforgettable.

The MAINE Mayfair is truly one of our favorite places in London, and we cannot wait to come back again.

An exceptional dining experience in the heart of Mayfair. The MAINE offers more than just a meal it’s an atmosphere. The setting is glamorous yet comfortable, with a lively energy that makes the evening feel special from the moment you walk in.
The food was outstanding fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavour. Every dish showed real attention to detail, with quality ingredients cooked to perfection. The lobster and seafood are a particular highlight, but even the smaller plates and salads were memorable.
Service was professional, warm, and attentive throughout, striking just the right balance between elegance and friendliness. The cocktails and wine list were equally impressive, adding to the overall experience.
This is not just dinner it’s a night out worth remembering. A perfect spot for anyone looking for world class food, ambience, and hospitality in London.

I booked for 8pm on Saturday for my anniversary with my partner so I could catch the live music. The music was very good, both the normal and Cuban jazz.

Food was amazing from the Oyster starters, steak as my main course and chocolate mousse for dessert. Service was amazing and we had a great time. I'd definitely recommend coming here.

I think I may take my parents next time and pay a little extra to sit on the main floor with a better view of the singers and cabaret.

As it was our anniversary, they also gave us an anniversary cake which was a nice touch, and even that multilayered chocolate cake was amazing. I've been disappointed by recent restaurants and I had high hopes for this one. They definitely didn't let me down!

The place is also styled nicely with lots of different sections for all types of vibes. It may be worth exploring other rooms at some point.

Had a fabulous lunch here with my husband. The 3 piece band was wonderful. They played Dakota by Stereophonics for me. They played Bruno Mars and The Spice girls for other tables. The atmosphere was upbeat and elegant. We sat on the terrace. My only slight critique is that my lobster roll was very small. My husband really liked his steak. It felt like they could have made the lobster roll a bit bigger for the price. But everything else was perfect. The staff are very friendly and playful.

venues.name: ROKA Mayfair
venues.description: Premium sushi & grilled Japanese offerings in a refined, warmly furnished dining destination.

reviews.text: We got the lunch menu available till 6pm and was still able to order at 5:56pm which is brilliant if you work late! The sushi was great very fresh and the lots of variety too. With the premium lunch you get a filet of steak which was lovely and tender but was not a great portion and the peanut sauce for the starters salad could do with a lot more seasoning. Otherwise I loved the service and great spot for amazing quality sushi in London !!

My friend and I were here for dinner last night. The food was amazing we had seasonal tasting menu and everything was well presented and tasting amazing. The service lacked a bit of attention, the food arrived before the wine we ordered and we had empty wine glasses a couple of times and had to wait to refill them, the second bottle of wine I was not asked to try, being a new bottle I think it is normal to have it tried before serving and also no one did a check after the food was served. Also the wine was not opened in front of us and I think it is only fair to open the bottle in front of the customer. But overall it was a good experience . Highly recommended !!!

Really disappointing experience overall. I had booked in advance and arrived slightly early, so was asked to go grab a drink at the bar (which was full), so went across the street to Ivy instead. We arrived back at Roka about 5 minutes before our reserved time slot. We were told to wait a bit longer which is fine since we were slightly early. After 10 minutes I reminded the staff we were still waiting, he acknowledged and said he would be back to take care of us, this never happened. After standing around and waiting a total of 25 minutes past our reservation time slot and seeing customers who were behind us in line get seated, we asked to speak to the manager who asked us to wait another 5 minutes. We then saw some of the staff clear off the table which were then given to us. We were frustrated at that point, but since our friends had been raving about the place we decided to try and enjoy the rest of our evening. The experience after we were seated was not good at all, it was a busy night and service felt chaotic, inattentive and rushed. We were hoping the food was going to be the redeeming factor, but we were overall very disappointed. The food was not bad...but not great, just mediocre and for the prices they charge it was just not worth it. Would not recommend this place as there are many other great choices around this area.

Amazing quality sushi and food all around. The ambiance is amazing from the inside seating to the outside. Dimmed lights inside and great patio seating to enjoy beautiful weather.

Wafu Salad - absolutely delicious, crispy and cold!

Skewers (Beef/Chicken) - juicy and very tasty

9 Piece Nigiri - chef's choice and super high quality!

Only downside was the amount of time it took to get our food and for the staff to come back to our table to check if we needed anything else such as refills or more food. They took forever which dampened the experience.

Roka Mayfair has been my go to spot every time I’m in London where I get my Japanese food fixed. I’ve always loved the ambiance, the buzzing atmosphere, and the consistently great service.

However, during my most recent visit, I did notice a slight drop in the quality of some of the dishes I’ve regularly ordered over the years. It’s a little disappointing, especially when you’ve come to expect a certain standard from a place you love. It does raise the question of whether it’s a one-off or something that needs attention.

That said, the overall experience was still enjoyable. The vibe and service were as great as always, and I’m hopeful the food will bounce back to what it used to be.

venues.name: Corrigan's Mayfair
venues.description: Modern gourmet cuisine in a high-end destination highlighting thoughtfully sourced ingredients.

reviews.text:
Had a lovely lunch at Corrigan’s. The ambience is elegant but welcoming, with a classic interior that makes the experience feel special without being overly formal. Service was smooth and attentive, creating a relaxed pace to enjoy the meal.

The food was fresh, simple, and well executed. Each dish was cleanly presented with good ingredients allowed to shine — from the light starters to the perfectly cooked fish and thoughtful desserts. A refined lunch that balances comfort and finesse.

Just stunning! Service was exemplary, perfectly attentive but not at all intrusive. Everyone was charming and extremely knowledgeable, from the barman who served our drinks beforehand and chatted to us, through to all the waiting staff. Our food was sublime (shellfish cocktail, asparagus; whole rabbit for two; souffle and ice-creams), each dish was technically excellent, tasted amazing but also generously portioned. The sommelier's suggested wine pairings were lovely and didn't take advantage in terms of price per glass. We can't fault the evening.

I think this was the most delicious meal that I have ever eaten!! Every mouthful was sumptuous. This restaurant is a real treat of a place, not only wonderful food, but lovely, kind and attentive staff. I could have stayed all day. Thank you for such a fabulous experience. I felt truly spoilt. If ever you get a chance to go here - take it!

What a wonderful meal and experience. Service was attentive and friendly, the food was truly excellent, the wine pairings superb. We were using a Virgin Experience voucher, but were treated as honoured guests. The rooms are beautiful - a perfect background for a romantic lunch. No hesitation whatsoever recommending Corrigans for a (very) special occasion. Pricey, sure, but worth every penny.

So impressed with this restaurant! We made a last-minute reservation near our hotel and felt so lucky to have the opportunity to dine here. The food was amazing and we tried dishes that we had never had before under the recommendation of the staff. Presentation and taste was absolutely excellent. The shining star of the night however was the sommelier. His recommendation was perfect for our palette and the courses we selected. I felt the restaurant was upscale, yet warm and welcoming, regardless of what you were wearing or where you were from. Highly recommend you check this place out if you are in London!

venues.name: Isabel Mayfair
venues.description: Upmarket restaurant plating local & global fare, plus weekend brunch & a robust wine list.

reviews.text: The food at Isabel Mayfair is exquisite – beautifully presented with rich, layered flavours that make every dish feel special. Their cocktails are just as impressive, perfectly balanced and creative, each one tasting as good as it looks. Together, the food and drinks create a dining experience that feels indulgent yet effortless.

I absolutely loved my experience at Isabel! 🥂✨
The food was incredible – every dish bursting with flavour. The atmosphere is sophisticated, warm, and full of vibrant energy, perfect for a special dinner or a more lively night out.
The champagne was perfectly chilled and absolutely delicious! 🍾
I had such a great time and will definitely be coming back. A true gem in Mayfair!
We had such a wonderful evening at Isabel. The atmosphere is intoxicating, food is delicious and staff took care of us very well. Isabel is one of my favourite places in Mayfair.

I had an exceptional dinner at Isabel in Mayfair last night, truly one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in London.

From the moment we arrived, the staff were warm, attentive, and incredibly professional. The customer service was faultless, every detail was handled with care, and the team made sure we felt welcome and well looked after throughout the evening.

The food was absolutely phenomenal. Every dish was beautifully presented, full of flavour. You can really tell that quality and creativity are core part of their menu.

The atmosphere in the dining room was elegant yet relaxed, striking just the right balance for a special night out. And what really elevated the experience was discovering that Isabel has a stunning downstairs space for dancing after dinner, the perfect way to transition from fine dining to a lively, glamorous afterparty.

Isabel definitely isn’t just a restaurant, it’s a full evening experience. I can’t wait to go back!

Had such a fun night at Isabel! 🍸
The food was super tasty, the place is gorgeous, and the vibe was just right. The champagne was nice and cold – exactly how I like it! 🥂
Honestly, I had a blast and can’t wait to go back. Such a cool spot in Mayfair!

venues.name: Noble Rot Mayfair
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Noble Rot is a lovely restaurant tucked away in the heart of Mayfair. There is a nice selection of wine and a good menu to choose from. Personally I found the food a little underwhelming given the price tag, a little more upmarket pub grub than up and coming Michelin.  The bread had a good flavour but the focaccia had been cooked with too much butter for my taste, giving it an almost fried texture. The lamb dish was a good piece of lamb but the fat wasn’t rendered away very well. In general all the dishes I tasted were over salted. Finally, the cold rice pudding was a bit al dente.The food aside, service was good and attentive and the atmosphere is great

My partner and I dined at Noble Rot Mayfair the night before our wedding and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. The ambience/vibe was relaxed but elegant, the food and service exceptional.

Our waitress was knowledgeable and friendly, offering expert wine pairings that perfectly complemented each dish. You could tell she was genuinely passionate and the kind of service that really sets itself apart.

I’d mentioned our upcoming wedding when booking, and the team went out of their way to make us feel special, giving us a lovely table and acknowledging the occasion with warmth which made the evening even more memorable.

We’ll definitely be returning, thank you to the whole team for such a genuinely lovely dining experience.
My go to restaurant in London. Ticks every box for what I want in a restaurant, from the cooking, fresh ingredients, knowledgable staff and the decor. Just keeps me coming back.

After two visits at this establishment, I can safely regard it as having the best duck in London. Unfortunately it’s no longer on the menu, but if it ever returns, I’ll be back faster than my ability to say the restaurant’s name. The sauce was ethereally delicious to the point I needed 2 rounds of fresh sourdough to soak up every drop.

The food and service in this restaurant is outstanding. Every member of staff was friendly and helpful. The advice they gave on what food and wine to choose was excellent. The restaurant holds quite a few people but somehow feels intimate. If you are a wine expert or enthusiast (which we aren’t) the wine menu is 49 pages long so plenty of choice. We will definitely be back

venues.name: The Ivy Asia Mayfair
venues.description: Elegant destination with dramatic decor serving high-end meals, plus cocktails, afternoon tea & DJs.

reviews.text:
Gorgeous restaurant and incredible food.  We had a table of four, did some appetizers and tried the experience menu and it was amazing.  The tempura prawns were great and I don’t even like tempura.  I might be a tempura fan now!!  Also, the beef fillet was very good!!

We had drinks after dinner and had a blast.  The dirty martinis were on point and the bartender was friendly and attentive.  We would definitely go back!!

Absolutely underrated. Stunning menu and service was excellent. Went for my best friend's birthday meal and we was no disappointed. Their set menus were good but unfortunately we missed the time slot so chose from the A La Carte Menu and we were not disappointed. The quality and taste of the food went beyond our expectations and we all thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and would love to come again! Our waitress was very kind and lovely.

The food and atmosphere were amazing. Shame about the service, our waiter, Romanos, didn't pay much attention to us and everytime he served us he had a look on his face that he didn't want to be there. I kept having to waive my hand in the air to get him to serve us and one time even had to get up, for such a nice establishment, it should happen. We didn't bother staying for dessert because of this but I would definitely want to return as the food was top class and we had pleasant interactions with other staff. We ordered the Gochuchang Chicken, black cod, yellow tail sashimi and the prawn rendang and all those dishes were amazing. Would definitely recommend!! The statue in the washroom is hilarious BTW 🤣

We made a last-minute booking at Ivy Asia, Mayfair for our wedding anniversary lunch and what an incredible decision that turned out to be!

From the moment we stepped in, the entire experience felt effortlessly luxurious and welcoming. The team went above and beyond to make our day feel special, despite it being a spontaneous visit. The staff were attentive, gracious, and genuinely warm, making us feel celebrated and well taken care of throughout.

And the food absolutely exceptional. Each dish was a burst of flavour, beautifully presented and perfectly balanced. Everything felt refined yet full of personality. Ivy Asia truly knows how to blend flair with authenticity.

The atmosphere was just right for the occasion stylish, vibrant, and with that signature Ivy touch of elegance. The attention to detail, from décor to service, made it a meal to remember.

We couldn’t have asked for a better way to mark our anniversary. Thank you to the amazing team at Ivy Asia, Mayfair for turning a last-minute plan into a truly memorable celebration. We’ll definitely be back next time, with a reservation in advance!

I really enjoyed the fusion Asian dishes and the vibrant atmosphere of the restaurant. The service was friendly and attentive, and the overall quality of the Asian cuisine was outstanding—definitely one of the better spots in London for this type of food. The jasmine rice was slightly dry and harder than expected, which was a minor letdown. I didn’t try the sushi this time, but I’m looking forward to sampling it on my next visit.

venues.name: Grilandia Mayfair
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Avery Court, 10 Grosvenor St, Greater, London

venues.vicinity: Avery Court, 10 Grosvenor St, Greater, London

reviews.text:
Everything about this restaurant was outstanding. My friend booked it for her 20th birthday, and it was truly one of the best dining experiences I’ve ever had. The interior was warm and cozy, with beautiful instrumental piano music playing in the background.

The service was exceptional—special thanks to Ahmed for making our evening unforgettable. He attended to every request promptly and with genuine kindness; his service was flawless.

The food was equally impressive. Everyone at our table enjoyed their meals. The meat remained perfectly juicy, even after I asked Ahmed to have it cooked a little longer—a rarity in most restaurants. The chips were cooked to perfection, and the drinks were excellent. (The passion fruit drink comes highly recommended; my friend still dreams about it!)

Overall, this is a truly lovely place to dine. I’ll definitely be returning soon.

My experience in this restaurant was wonderful! The place is cozy, very well decorated and gives a nice feeling when you arrive. The service was fast, friendly and always with a smile. The food was delicious and well prepared. It is a place with good food, great service and a charming space. I really recommend it.

Absolutely amazing! 💕

My friend had her birthday dinner here and it went so well! The staff were great with our dietary requirements, helpful and had a great sense of humour! We got given break baskets on the house and they give free deserts plus fruits with candles for diners celebrating their birthdays 🎉 🍰

We had it GOOD! I’d recommended the baby chicken dish! It was SO GOOD! And if you can’t finish it, you can get a to go takeaway box like I did☺️ as for the drinks, the non alcoholic ones aren’t the best :( the PassoFlora was too sweet for both me and another girl so we asked for extra ice on the side and that request was guaranteed 💕

My dinner at Grilandia was a great experience. From tender, well condimented chicken, waiters in vests, to elegant interior, everything was splendid. They took care of my gluten-free and wegetarian members of the group.

I went to Grilandia for my 21st birthday and they didn’t disappoint. The service was spectacular. The waiters were very accommodating to mine and my friends needs. We ordered a range of delicious food to the table including prawns, lamb kafffa and more.

There was a live singer and guitarist who played beautifully. To top it all off I was given a complimentary birthday song. I started the day off a bit gutted because a few people dropped out last minute, but going to Grilandia made my night amazing as the staff are so charming.

venues.name: Hakkasan
venues.description: Dim sum, Modern Cantonese delicacies and signature cocktails on 2 floors with designer decoration.

reviews.text:
I first came to Hakkasan back in 2016 — nine years ago — and I’ve been in love with this place ever since. Few restaurants in London have managed to maintain such a consistent level of excellence over time. Every visit feels just as special as the first.

From the moment you step in, the atmosphere envelops you: dim lighting, elegant music, and that signature balance of modern luxury and intimacy that only Hakkasan can create. The service is always refined yet relaxed, perfectly matching the restaurant’s understated sophistication.

The food remains absolutely outstanding. The crispy duck salad, the black truffle roasted duck, and the legendary pipa duck are on another level — perfectly cooked, flavourful, and beautifully presented. The dim sum selection and wagyu beef dishes are equally impressive, with every bite showing precision and artistry.

Over the years, Hakkasan has never lost its magic. It continues to set the standard for contemporary Cantonese cuisine in London — a place where perfection feels effortless. Whether for a celebration or a quiet dinner, it remains one of my all-time favourites.

Simply exceptional — from the duck to the cocktails, everything is top-tier.

We had an amazing time at Hakkasan Mayfair. We visited before but came back again. Love this place. The dimsums are just amazing. The food is amazing as usual. But what’s also really great is the ambience and the warmth with which you are received and hosted every single time. It was an amazing meal from such amazing hosts.

I am deeply disappointed by my experience at this restaurant. The environment was far from pleasant — the basement dining area was extremely noisy, with loud music and people shouting over each other. It felt more like a chaotic market than a restaurant.
Despite the place not being full, the food took an unreasonably long time to arrive. When I asked about it, the waiter casually said the kitchen was busy. I ordered the second most expensive set menu, expecting a quality meal, but it was a complete letdown. None of the dishes were tasty or authentic. The roast duck and dim sum were just acceptable, but everything else was barely edible. At least three dishes were so unpleasant that we asked the waiter to take them away after just one bite. Most of the food was overly sour, strange, and unbalanced — the so-called “champagne honey fish” even tasted rotten.
When we told the waiter that the food really wasn’t to our taste and asked for the dishes to be removed, he simply took them turned away without any reaction. The service throughout the meal was slow and indifferent. And to make matters worse, they still added a 15% service charge.
Overall, it was one of the most disappointing dining experiences I’ve ever had — poor food, poor service, and a completely unpleasant atmosphere.

Upon entry, we were greeted by exceptionally polite security staff who felt more welcoming than typical security. Inside, the wonderfully decorated space, bathed in dim lighting, offered a convenient bag and coat check. The front desk staff provided a warm greeting, and since we were early, we had the option to sit at the bar or proceed to our table. Naturally, I checked out the bar, which was pleasant with good service.
Descending the stairs, past the nicely segregated dining areas, it was impossible not to notice how busy and well-organized the venue was. At our table, the waiting staff introduced themselves and presented menus, including various options (if you're on a budget, it's wise to plan your meal in advance). The service was good, though there was a little room for improvement. The food, however, was excellent and cooked to perfection.
As I had mentioned it was a special occasion when reserving and confirming, our dessert arrived with a lovely personalized touch, which was much appreciated. Overall, we felt we got what we paid for, and I would highly recommend it.

The atmosphere was nice, although the lighting was a little dim, but that wasn't a problem. The service was excellent and professional, and the food was delicious. The first course, the dim sum, every bite tasted different and was very delicious. The steamed Chilean sea bass, it tastes delicious, you can't stop eating it. In short, dishes with no mistakes. Although a little expensive, I highly recommend it to those who love food and special flavours.

venues.name: Bluebird Chelsea
venues.description: European food and cocktails in smart spot with monochrome floor tiles, feature lighting and terrace.

reviews.text:
Coming to Bluebird was a great experience from start to finish. The ambiance was vibrant yet relaxed, making it a perfect spot for both casual outings and special occasions. One of the first things we noticed was how warm and welcoming the staff were—friendly, attentive, and professional. The service was truly top-notch, easily a 10/10.

We appreciated the flexibility of having both indoor and outdoor seating options, which is always a plus depending on the weather. We chose to sit outdoor this time as the weather was lovely plus they had the heaters on .

For our meal, we ordered a beautifully cooked salmon dish and a plate of gnocchi. Both dishes were excellent—flavorful, well-presented, and satisfying. The portion sizes were just right, leaving us room to try dessert. We couldn’t resist ordering one to share, and it turned out to be a great decision—the dessert was absolutely delicious and provided the perfect end to our meal.

Given the central location and the high quality of food and service, we found the prices to be quite reasonable. We paid roughly £90 in total, which included a beer and a cider.

We’d definitely come back again and would recommend Bluebird to others!

Took my mum here for a birthday lunch and it was such a lovely experience. The food was absolutely delicious (Caesar salad was perfect) and the team were so friendly and welcoming. They really spoiled my mum and made it feel special, and we never felt rushed.

The salmon here is absolutely outstanding – truly the best I’ve ever had. Perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor, it really shows the chef’s skill and attention to detail. If you love salmon, this place sets a new standard!

A spacious restaurant with a very good decoration but the food was average and expensive compared to allow other similar in the are.
The worst of all at least today was the service. Our waiter was exceptional but something was wrong in the kitchen. Although at the time we have been there almost half of the takes were free or under reservation however it took more than 20 minutes to serve us even when we asked for additional drink.

We sat outside, table for 5. Really friendly service. We had two steaks, burger and chips and I also had the crab starter - all were excellent. Looking at the other guests, next time I'm going to order from the bar snacks instead of a main meal because the chicken burger and burger from the snack menu was very reasonably priced compared to the full menu and they looked a good size too!

venues.name: Rabbit British Bistro
venues.description: Sustainable ingredients and wines from the family farm in Sussex are served in a bucolic space.

reviews.text:
We happened across Rabbit when walking in the neighborhood. What we found was amazing!

The food and service were fantastic. Our server Harsh, was so attentive and made excellent recommendations.

We started with oysters and their home made beards and butter.  Our main was roasted chicken with roasted veggies and an amazing potato and leek terrine.

The family has their own vineyard and all the food is farm to table.

Highly recommend. We’re going back for more!

We live within 5 minutes to Rabbit Bistro but haven't tried it yet. I am glad we found a little gem in Chelsea.Last week my daughter and I had fab 2, 3-course lunch there. We also tried their signature  mushroom marmite eclair. Service was polite and swift. Very reasonable price in the heart of Chelsea. Unpretentious and comfy place. We enjoyed it so much I already made another reservation to introduce it to my goody friend. Definitely recommend.

The food was fantastic, especially the Gressingham Duck Breast and the Beef with Chimichurri. Both were perfectly tender and very flavourful. The lamb skewers were fine, but were not as interesting as the other options. The Rabbit Spritz was also delicious, and is one of my new favourite cocktails.

The service could have been a bit more attentive. I understand it wasn’t a busy night and we were the only people sat in our area, but we didn’t have anyone come past us for ages and couldn’t order another drink.

We loved everything about The Rabbit. The service was outstanding on every level.

Really lovely little touches continuous water without being prompted.  Great recommendations and such passion about the food and wine and the concept of what Gladwin Brothers is all about. I have never come across such lovely staff who were genuinely passionate about what they do.
The food was delicious every course had depth of flavour and was presented well. We came out of The Rabbit with a massive smile on our face. Cannot recommend this restaurant enough.

Lovely restaurant in the centre of London. Beef tartare was the highlight of our meal, a perfect balance of flavours and very fresh, good quality beef, the best one I’ve had for a while! Fries were well cooked as well. Overall a great meal, fairly priced and I’d recommend trying here.

venues.name: The Ivy Chelsea Garden
venues.description: Modern British menus served in a refined, art-filled space with a garden terrace and an orangery.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner! This place was recommended by a local client of mine and it was amazing! They first guided us to a table all the way in the back of the garden next to the bar, which wasn’t great so we asked to be moved and we got a way better spot! Great atmosphere, super friendly staff! The food was on point! Highly recommend!

The food is nice and the place is well decorated, however the lady served our table gave us 2 vege breakfasts instead of one vege and one full fat.

A bit careless as she could have double checked with us for the order before it is placed.

There were only us ordering at the time and she only took orders and not serving. It is another person served food to us.

Dear Ivy Chelsea Garden event team,

I just wanted to extend my warmest thanks to you and your team for making my sister’s bridal shower last weekend so special. Everything was beautifully arranged — from the delicious food to the beautiful atmosphere at the Glasshouse and attentive service — it all came together perfectly.

Your staff support and attention to detail truly made the day stress-free and enjoyable for all of us. I couldn’t have imagined it going any better, and I’m so grateful for the care you put into making it such a memorable event.

I absolutely loved the experience at The Ivy Chelsea Garden, and I know this will be the first of many events we’ll celebrate with you in the future.

With gratitude,

Saeeda

5 stars

We had the most wonderful experience at The Ivy Chelsea Garden for a special family celebration. The atmosphere is absolutely stunning—lush greenery, elegant interiors, and a warm, vibrant vibe that makes you feel instantly at ease.

The food was delicious and beautifully presented, and the cocktails were just as impressive. What really made the evening exceptional was our server—attentive, friendly, and spot-on with recommendations.

This is the kind of place you come to for a memorable occasion or even just to enjoy the ambiance. We would return in a heartbeat—highly recommend for both locals and visitors looking for that perfect mix of style, comfort, and excellent service

I’ve attended a wedding celebration in the private room at The Ivy, and everything was absolutely perfect. The setting was elegant and intimate, creating the most beautiful atmosphere for such a special occasion to celebrate my brother’s wedding. The food was outstanding, every course was delicious with the highest quality ingredients and full of flavor. Service was impeccable throughout, attentive, professional, and warm without ever being intrusive. From start to finish, the experience was seamless and truly memorable. An unforgettable celebration in every way. I would definitely recommend to anybody looking for an amazing venue to celebrate a special occasion.

venues.name: La Mia Mamma King's Road
venues.description: Quaint Italian restaurant plating regional fare & fresh pasta offering cookery classes & party hire.

reviews.text:
Veramente autentico! There is so much to be said about this delightfully cosy little Italian spot on King's Road, very much in the heart of the Italian Quarter, and a real treat for anyone looking for food and service becoming of Il Bel Paese.

The food, service, warmth and feel of La Mia Mamma was exactly what we were looking for, and I can't recommend anymore in words just how pleasant an experience it was, simply visit and enjoy!

Response to your reply:

I’m giving you straightforward feedback  not looking for drama or attacking your restaurant. I’ve eaten at top places around the world, and what you served didn’t meet the mark. Instead of getting sassy or defensive, take it as a chance to improve. That’s how standards get better.

I went to the kings road one on Saturday, the staff were extremely kind and welcoming, atmosphere was also nice. I ordered the pasta with truffle and honestly it was extremely salty and i couldn’t eat that. I thought maybe be it was the truffle so didn’t think too much of it. Then on Monday my pasta craving was still here as I was left very unsatisfied after Saturday’s experience. Decided to try the one on Hollywood road. It was Monday, less hectic on the kitchen staff so I assumed food will also be better!! Again super warm welcome from staff, we sat outside and it was really lovely. They served us a welcome bruschetta which was delicious. We then ordered Arancini, potato croquettes, potato al forno then the same pasta but this time without the truffle as I thought may be thats what made it too salty. Anyway my honest opinion about their Italian food is. Arancini was tasteless, potato al forno was very good, the pasta was extremely salty and the cheese they made the sauce with was most likely of very commercial quality. One of the worst Italian food experience i have ever encountered. They say “run by real italian mamas” like seriously if i had a real mama cooking italian food like this for me everyday, i would ask her to better rest and don’t cook at all.  Left the restaurant extremely disappointed, may be i didn’t choose the right dish, ill never know as we aren’t going back there ever.

There's nothing quite like going to a restaurant where you feel at home. The chefs are in fact mothers, who cook traditional Italian food for their families at home. Food was exceptional, atmosphere and vibes to match. They were very accommodating with the tasting menu, as I have a few dietary restrictions. Overall very happy tummys, I highly recommend the visit!

Pleasantly surprised with this place. Apparently they got different mammas every month or so, who specialise in food from different regions of Italy. This month it was from Sardegna.
They offer 3 different set menus: pasta, main or pasta + main.
We chose the only-pasta one, it was more than enough, because includes starters (which by itself could be a complete meal), a lot of small delicious dishes, the outstanding one being the semolina and cheese with honey, and it was incredible, it is a cream that you can eat with bread, absolutely delicious! First time in many years I'm surprised with something's flavour and texture, and I do eat many different foods from everywhere.
By the time we got to the pasta dish, we were almost full, but still I made space for my pistacchio pesto pasta with guanciale, which was delicious.
The rest and dessert we took it home.
Service was ok but maybe a bit distant, except for la mamma who came to our table to talk a bit and brought us some bruschetta, courtesy of the house.
Delicious and abundant food, I don't think you can get a more Italian place in London than this.

Thank-you to all at La Mia Mamma for an incredible dining experience and taste of Sardina. The food and atmosphere were amazing, even if we overestimated our stomach's capacities! We went for set menu of the the pasta + main each (4 people in our party). This is not for the faint of heart. I'd definitely recommend this beautiful Italian but perhaps think about just how much food you're likely to consume. The staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. Think they realised that we couldn't continue eating and offered to pack it up for us to take away. The starters came out as they were ready, then we had a short break between the next two courses of pastas and our mains. The only feedback I could suggest is perhaps to talk through the set menu options to gauge how hungry or how much people can potentially eat before they order, as upon reflection we'd have ordered according to our capabilities as to not overload or feel bad in not being able to eat what we'd ordered. Mama Flore and the rest of the team were extremely friendly and accommodating. The way they celebrate birthdays &/or other celebrations was amazing and definitely added to our evening. We would highly recommend as not only was the food a taste sensation but also the atmosphere and of course the wonderful staff. Thank-you again!

venues.name: The Chelsea Corner
venues.description: Polished Italian restaurant prepping pizza, pasta, meat dishes & fish, plus cocktails & wine.

reviews.text: As a tourist, I felt absolutely welcome here. The service, and our waiter, Rose, were nothing short of amazing. We first ordered drinks and they were very good, and then we ordered our food. Rose forgot to put in our orders at first, which wasn’t a big deal. We are all humans, we make mistakes, but in light of that, she gave us a free round of drinks. Rose was a very great waitress. Very cordial, professional, and friendly. Our food was absolutely delicious and it was overall a 10/10 experience. If I’m ever back in London, I will for sure be coming back here.

We were having dinner at The chelsea corner in the spring in 2023.
Love the Lamp chops and the vibe of the restaurant. We also ordered a bottle of wine that’s really highlight the meal up to the next level.
The staff provides good service when we were there, thanks a lot.

Our dinner tonight at the Chelsea Corner was hands down the best dinner we’ve had on our 9 day trip to London. Carl and Francis took excellent care of us and made sure we were well taken care of. The Mozzarella garlic bread with caramelized onions was the perfect start to our meal. The pasta was fresh with perfect portion and  presentation. I had the prawns, another had the bolognese special, and my daughter only wanted chicken Alfredo, which wasn’t on the menu, but they made it for her and it was delicious! We finished with sorbet and tiramisu which were both light and refreshing. Gent, the bartender, poured excellent drinks and remembered our special orders. If you’re like us and tired of pub food and want something different and satisfying, look no further than Chelsea Corner! I wish it wasn’t so far away from New Jersey. It’s saved for next time though!

What a fabulous meal. Delicious, freshly prepared and tasty food, buzzy restaurant, and lovely staff.

Vee our server was very attentive, always there to check in, bring us another drink and just generally an all round friendly guy.

Very reasonably priced and worth the trip!

Our server Carl was AMAZING. Tough night after a Chelsea loss, but he made it so much better for us! Asked if they could do spaghetti carbonara and he was able to ask the chef who said yes! Service, drinks, food, all 5 stars. A win is a win! Thank you Carl!

venues.name: Daphne's
venues.description: Italian mainstay for a well-heeled clientele, known for people-watching and classic cuisine.

reviews.text:
The linguine with scallops was excellent, and the seabass was cooked perfectly, though the sauce wasn’t to my taste so I couldn’t finish it.

Decor is stylish and the staff are extremely attentive—at times a little too present, but always very polite and helpful. Overall, I’d recommend this restaurant.

Went to Daphne’s for a birthday dinner and it was absolutely perfect! Definitely make a reservation, the inside is so charming, it really feels like you’ve been transported to Italy. Cozy, cute, and full of great vibes, with service that was top-notch. We started with a few cocktails, and they even surprised us with a little happy birthday treat, which was such a sweet touch. For dinner, we tried the Ravioli di Mozzarella and the Risotto, both were incredible. If you’re in Chelsea and looking for a cozy, authentic Italian spot for a special night out, I highly recommend Daphne’s.

Daphne’s is such a charming and welcoming restaurant. The atmosphere feels warm and inviting, and the team is super friendly. The Italian food is absolutely outstanding – authentic, full of flavor, and beautifully prepared. Located in a very trendy area, it’s the perfect spot for a relaxed lunch or a special dinner. An absolute recommendation!

Lovely experience, good tasty food .. i mean the food portions are small, elegant seating area, lovely waiters, fast service.. i don’t like any restaurant who tells you that you have 1 hour 30min for the table.. we past 5 min no one asked us to leave but i didnt feel comfortable, i was trying to rush so i dont hear:  sorry we need the table ..
it is an expensive restaurant so i really prefer to enjoy my food and my time.. i entered many restaurants, it’s the only one who said u have 1.5 hrs. That was not nice,
It was crowded but still empty few tables,
It became very noisy around 13:00.

We had the fish of the day for £36, it was so tiny, you add extra sides.
Burrata Raviolli with pees, delicious but basics.
Wagyu carpaccio was normal
Tiger prawns as a starter was very good
Tiramissu normal

My husband and I just dined at Daphne’s for the first time since we had our wedding breakfast held there back in June.
Food, service and atmosphere are impeccable - we wouldn’t have wanted to host our wedding breakfast anywhere else and on our return visit, standards remain the same.
Firstly to speak about our meal and experience this past weekend: we ate seabass crudo and courgette flowers to start and spaghetti alla vongole and mushroom and pea risotto for our main. Both were delicious and our meal ended on their famous tiramisu, definitely the best in London.
