All in all, my verdict is, the restaurant could do better if they replace this arrogant waitress who clearly does not like her job and implies that she is bigger and better than the poor people come to this restaurant to eat.
Avoid this place at all cost and if you still decide to go there thinking is a fake review like many other alleged reviews here, you may kindly check, you cant complain, because you have been WARNED!

Here is the food review of monal with a shout-out to Warda
Just had the most incredible meal at The monal ilford! Seriously, every dish was bursting with flavor. The chicken was perfect and rich, and the naan was perfectly fluffy. Big thanks to Warda and Sami for services – you guys nailed it! If you're looking for authentic and delicious pakistani cuisine, this is the spot. Five stars all the way! And thanks for gulan jamuns ☺️

I’ve been coming to this restaurant for years, and it never disappoints. The quality of the food is consistently excellent—always fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. You can really taste the difference.

They’ve recently done a full refurbishment, and it looks absolutely amazing. The new design is modern, warm, and inviting—such a great atmosphere to enjoy a meal in.

It’s great to see a place not only maintain its food standards over time but also invest in creating an even better experience for its customers. Highly recommend!

venues.name: Royal Nawaab Ilford
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
The food here is absolutely amazing. There’s a wide variety of options, with an amazing Pakistani cuisine represented beautifully. Every dish is packed with flavor, prepared with care, and served fresh. It’s an all you can eat buffet self serve which makes the experience all the more fun!

The restaurant has a very inviting and elegant atmosphere. The space is clean, well-kept, and tastefully designed, making it feel comfortable yet special. Whether you’re coming for a casual meal, a family gathering, or even a celebration, the setting creates the perfect backdrop.

The service is outstanding—fast, professional, and friendly. The staff are attentive and make you feel genuinely welcomed without ever being intrusive. Their warm and thoughtful approach adds so much to the overall dining experience.

Royal Nawaab Restaurant Review
I recently dined at Royal Nawaab, and it was an exceptional experience! The all-you-can-eat buffet featuring Asian cuisine was a highlight, offering a fantastic variety of dishes. The starters were delicious, with a great selection that set the tone for the meal. The main courses were equally impressive, bursting with authentic flavors and beautifully prepared. The dessert selection was the perfect way to end the meal, with every option being absolutely amazing. The quality and variety of the food made for a memorable dining experience. Highly recommend Royal Nawaab for anyone craving a top-notch Asian buffet!
Rating: 5/5 stars

Enjoy a bigger dinner here. There are lots of variety of food. Mainly with a little bit spicy to medium spicy for me. Their lamb dish are all superb, 10 types of cooking combination with different spices or method. I love the slow cook lamb leg and my friend would recommended the lamb steak. You can order the food from the second row. They serve nann and garlic nann for différent table.
The drink are not included but it’s worth the money.
Definitely will visit it again.

Family dinner
So much choice and selection..freshly cooked, chefs make the most delicious food. Well done, team 😀.
Atmosphere is bright and very spacious. Music was a little loud... but apart from that, it was awesome. Really good marketing tool to have small plates so you can try a little of everything.

Amazing food in a great restaurant with oriental vibes.
For the price you get an incredible selection of traditional pakistani food all you can eat until you can eat no more!

They have a selection of deserts, ice cream, various cakes, Pakistani sweets and more to feast on.

venues.name: Hyderabad Darbar
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Words can’t express how impressed we are of how amazingly authentic the taste of the food.  Honestly have not tasted biryani as good . It’s like it’s made at home .
The staff go above and beyond in ensuring that all our needs we meet. Have been there three times in a week .
What more can I say .  Looking forward to my next. Visit. :  )
Easily one of the best chicken biryani I've ever eaten. Very flavourful and great value for money. Will definitely be back to try some other dishes as well.

Best chicken lollipop in town🥰 dum ka murgh was fantastic i love it with some butter naan❤️biryani was nice; meat was cooked perfect but if rice was little more cooked if was little less it was 100% perfect… the price was so reasonable ❤️must visit place🥰 surely going back again and again👀

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Hyderabad Darbar, and I must say it was a truly delightful experience. The food was exceptionally flavorful, capturing the rich and authentic taste of traditional Hyderabadi cuisine. Every dish was prepared with great attention to detail, offering both quality and taste in every bite.

The service was equally impressive—staff members were courteous, attentive, and ensured that our dining experience was smooth and enjoyable from start to finish. The ambiance was welcoming and well-maintained, adding to the overall positive experience.

I highly recommend Hyderabad Darbar to anyone looking for delicious food paired with excellent service. I look forward to visiting again soon.

This place was exceptional from the welcoming approach of the staff. The food was amazing ordered lamb chops £8.50 (5pcs) chilli paneer £6.99 very delicious and a generous portion, biryani lamb I think was also £8.50 was full of flavour I’m not used it but I guess that’s how it’s done very empowering. Me and my partner really enjoyed it I had people sitting next to me and even there food look delicious I am extremely fussy and I can confidently say I will be coming back. As the place is on ilford lane parking might be a slight issue however if you park maybe 5 minutes away you will be fine plenty of food choices for all types of pallets

venues.name: Punjab Grill Lounge
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I'm sorry but I'm going to have to give you a his a mediocre 3 out of 5.
Me and my friend came here, wanting to try the Mixed Grill, thinking it would be the same Mixed Grill as other places, that come with lamb chops, chicken tikka, lamb tikka and seekh kebabs, but this was just two seekh kebabs (each cut into half) and lots of chicken smothered in the sauce (which was very nice BTW, maybe too much sauce). I've had mixed grill one too many times from different eateries all across the UK, ie Tayyabs, Needo Grill and so on, and have a general idea of what's supposed to be in a portion. In this case, there's so much chicken, hardly any lamb, therefore not really mixed, hence shouldn't be called Mixed Grill, an appropriate name would be Grilled Chicken with Seekh kebabs, as you can see from the pictures, it's mostly chicken. It cost us £19.99 which is quiet steep considering it wasn't much, and was mostly chicken, would have been cheaper if we just went Nando's instead to have all that chicken and bought seekh kebabs as take away elsewhere.
I get lamb costs more than chicken hence I don't see the justification of this being priced the amount it is. As much as I would love to support a new up and coming business, as I've travelled a long way to come here, I can't help but feel a tad bit disappointed.

Absolutely loved our visit to Punjab Grill Lounge! The team made us feel so welcome and looked after us from start to finish. The cocktails were amazing (could easily have had a few more) and the starters and curries were just incredible – proper authentic Punjabi flavours, honestly the best we’ve had in London so far. Perfect spot for a great night out with friends. Can’t wait to come back!

Punjab Grill is hands down one of the best places for authentic Indian flavors! The grills are smoky, tender, and bursting with spices that feel straight from the tandoor. Their curries are rich, creamy, and packed with depth—every dish tastes like it’s made with love. To top it all off, the mocktails are refreshing and pair perfectly with the food. The atmosphere is warm, the service is friendly, and the food never disappoints. A must-visit for anyone who loves great taste and great vibes!”

Brilliant food and service!!!Worth the money! We have been here multiple times and they have never disappointed us. Freshly cooked great Indian food with perfectly authentic taste served with love, hospitality and respect in a nice ambience! Keep it up!!!

Food was relatively okay, it didn't hit the spot for us unfortunately, so we'll not be back, but it could just be our tastebuds. We felt food lacked flavour overall on the grills. Clean place with nice ambience

venues.name: Tawa Grill
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We ordered the Afgani Tawa grill 4-6 & the Mix Grill 3-4,  everything was very tasty n the butter nans too! Excellent tawa’s n grills! The staff services were 10/10 n very polite n considerate. The generous lady sever she was lovely n very helpful! Only let down by a star are the mocktails! Lacked quality n average n too expensive! But asides that, it’s a must try, I’d be back again for the Tawa’s solely! Thanks guys👊🏾😋

The food was amazing, way bigger portions than I thought, and the service was great! I ate way more than usual, those tawa dishes were a fantastic idea. Thanks for a wonderful dinner, I'd definitely recommend it.

Ordered Lahori platter, the rice were dry and crackling, like microwaved/plastic rice.Chicken was dry, Karahi was below average in taste, the only good thing was the grill, which had some flavour. Low quality but pretty expensive for the quality. This platter was £95.

The place was small but you can’t fault the service and food.

Had the Gol Gappey as a starter and must say the imli pani was absolutely amazing it was sweet and sour and having it with the puri was absolutely awesome when the favours just burst into the mouth in one bite.

After this we had the Lahori Tawa Grill which we really enjoyed the variety of meats each with its own flavour was really tasty and even the curry’s and rice had a really nice flavour.

Overall an enjoyable experience would recommend.

🌟 Tawa Grill – A Hidden Gem in Ilford!

I recently visited Tawa Grill on Cranbrook Road, and I must say, it was a delightful experience from start to finish. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with the warm aroma of sizzling spices and grilled meats that instantly whet your appetite.

🍽️ Food Highlights
The mixed grill platter was the star of the show—perfectly marinated lamb chops, juicy chicken tikka, and tender ribs, all served with fluffy Afghani naan and a vibrant chutney. The chapli kebab had that authentic Peshawari kick, and the kabuli pilau was rich and aromatic. Every bite felt like a celebration of bold, traditional flavours.

👨‍🍳 Service & Atmosphere
The staff were attentive and friendly, making sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. The ambiance is relaxed and welcoming, ideal for both casual dinners and family gatherings. Despite being busy, the service was prompt and professional.

💰 Value for Money
Portions were generous, and the pricing felt fair considering the quality and variety offered. It’s a great spot if you’re looking to indulge without breaking the bank.

🎯 Final Verdict
Tawa Grill is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic grilled dishes with a South Asian twist. Whether you’re a local or just passing through Ilford, this place deserves a spot on your foodie map.

venues.name: The Connaught
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Food: Lovely food. The platter was great and good portions. The chops, pulled beef, strips were yummy. The wings could have been a bit tastier.
Price: Great price for the food and quality.
Atmosphere: Very nice and comfortable. Perfect for couples, families or friends. We went for a birthday and 8 of us ate.
Service: Amazing service. The staff were great and got a complimentary Chai Latte.

I have been here for brunch several times now and it’s a go to for me because of how great the food is, the friendliness of the staff and the fact that it’s a nice family oriented place to have a meal. The portions are great and the price is very competitive. There is a queue outside at times but it is worth the wait. Had to wait a while today with my husband and they handed out little hot chocolates to us and others waiting which was a lovely touch and shows their commitment to providing a great service. Highly recommend a visit to The Connaught for brun.

We visited this place for dinner, met with a smiley welcome, very helpful and accommodating.
Beef fries were the best - husband was hungry - went down well. The chicken steak and angus steak were nice and tender. I preferred the peppercorn sauce over the mushroom one.
Loved it! Thank you

We had a complimentary chai latte from our friendly staff.
Highly recommend this place.

I had the chicken steak with mash and vegetables, and it was absolutely fantastic. The chicken was tender, juicy, and cooked to perfection, with just the right amount of seasoning. The mash was smooth and buttery, and the vegetables were fresh and perfectly cooked—still with a bit of bite, just how I like them.

The dish was well presented, showing real care from the kitchen. It looked as good as it tasted, and for the quality, the price was very reasonable. You can tell the chef put real effort into the dish—top marks for flavor, texture, and presentation.

While I was there, I also noticed the breakfast plates and platters being served to other tables. They looked just as impressive, and I’ll definitely be back soon to try them.

What a positive vibe in the cafe a lot of well behaved youngsters in the cafe who are running the show.

Its look like that i am at Michelin star cafe excellent culinary experience. Prices are very affordable as compared to presentation. They know the art of running the cafe. Visited this town after 27 years and this cafe was a surprise. Wish them best of Luck. Coffee beans were strong.

Thank you for your kindness and hospitality. its feels like home made food.

venues.name: Nosh
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Nosh Restaurant offers a truly delightful dining experience. From the moment you arrive, the beautiful setting creates an inviting and relaxed atmosphere—perfect for anything from a casual lunch to a special night out. The decor is thoughtfully designed, blending elegance with comfort, and it really enhances the overall ambiance.

What stands out most, though, is the exceptional customer service. The staff are attentive, friendly, and genuinely committed to making sure every guest feels welcome and well taken care of. Whether it's a recommendation from the menu or a small thoughtful gesture, their professionalism and warmth add so much to the experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy great food in a lovely setting with top-notch service.

A large group of us are dinner for a friends birthday. Food was well presented, and the service was good. Can't say the same thing about the taste of the food. The lamb chops were thin. The kebab was good. The lamb shank hardly had any meat on them. The butter chicken, not authentic. I couldn't distinguish what the meat curry was. The Mango lassi was the best thing on the night.

We dined here on a very quiet Wednesday evening. We were walk-ins as the restaurant wasn't that busy. Our hostess greeted us with a smile and showed us to our table. The restaurant floor is really nicely decorated and you can tell that a lot of attention has gone into it. The staff were friendly and explained the specials and recommendations to us. Whilst the decor and service is good, the food was decent. We ordered the mix grill (6/10), Lamb Mandi (6/10), kulcha naan (6/10) and a tandoori roti (6/10). Although the food's presentation was good, the flavour was decent, and didnt hit the spot as I'd expected. I'd rate this place at a solid 6 outta 10. It is worth a try.. parking is plenty as you have a clements road car park literally a few meters away from the restaurant.
Walked in during lunch. The place was bit busy. It was clean and tidy. Lovely decor. Ordered our food and it came within 20 minutes. Service was great. Food is OK. Good portion size. Decent pricing.

We 2 adults have been here just once so far, and it was mid day on a weekday. Ordered indo chinese chicken hakka nuddles and rice and fish masala fry.

Food quality -
1. Fish Fry - very bad, no fish flesh, too much of corn flour used to make it crispy, felt dehydrated after eating this.
2. Chicken hakka noodle - very bad, chicken was half cooked and with raw flesh smell. Didn't finish the full dish by
3. Chicken fried rice - just fine, but the same chicken used, rice was edible by taking out chicken pieces. Didn't finish the full dish

Food quantity -
1. Fish fry - good
2. Noodle - very good portion for 1 person
3. Rice - very good portion for 1 person

Food temperature -
1. fish fry - very, very hot
2. Noodle - mild warm and rest of the disb turned cold while eating
3. Rice - same as above.

Service - there was no rush, and one member of staff was there to take orders , he was friendly and helpful but he was cleaning the floor and taking orders at the same time which didn't look appropriate specially he was also serving the customers. We did report the feedback on food and its quality. Staff member was patient and accepted chef's mistake and apologised and didn't charge for the noodles and rice.

Atmosphere - ambience and overall clealiness observed.

No onsite parking but citi car park is nearby

venues.name: Banana Leaf
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful time in Banana Leaf. Staff were great and very helpful. Food was awesome. Chef made special adjustment with onion and garlic as we had puja on the day. Highly recommended.

Fantastic food, very pleasant atmosphere, great amenities, and the staff was friendly.

Will definitely return, such a gem!

Was craving uttapum and it did not disappoint! Food was fantastic, most people have the shovel dish but do not sleep on the other items on the menu. We really enjoyed the uttapum and puttu and daal. The service was really slow, I did go on a Friday night but it wasn’t relatively busy. I must give a shout out to Pravita (sorry if i’ve got it wrong( who was super helpful with recommendations and checked in with the kitchen staff if she was unsure about the questions we asked and relayed information back to us. I will be going back to try more dishes.
FYI The meat is halal, but they do serve alcohol.

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (7.5/10)

I visited Banana Leaf Ilford today and overall had a good experience. The service was outstanding — very attentive and friendly staff. Portion sizes were generous, more than enough for two people, and definitely great value for the price.

The rice was tasty and the fried fish, though a little salty, was well-cooked and crispy. However, I found the curry sauce a bit lacking in flavor, and the naan was quite oily, which might not be the healthiest option.

All in all, I’d recommend Banana Leaf Ilford for an occasional visit. It’s a nice spot for trying something different, but perhaps not for regular dining.

Overall rating: 7.5/10

Was craving Chettinad chicken so thought we would give it a try. There wasn't enough staff to the number of people dining. I had to go over to the front desk a few times to ask for things. When the food did come it was average. I've eaten a lot of south Indian and Tamil cuisine so my expectations were high. I ordered some lamb samosa's which turned up rock hard.

There were so many tables that still had dirty plates on them with no one sitting there. The floor under the tables were very dirty too. I had fish skin on the floor next to me.

The one good thing were the two ladies who were front desk. They were running around like headless chickens tending to everyone and still managed to do everything with a smile and respect. More staff were needed tonight. Would I come back again? Probably not.

venues.name: Zamana
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Zamana offers a delightful culinary experience with a platter that stands out for its rich, flavoursome taste certainly ranking among the best compared to other restaurants I've visited. The staff are welcoming and friendly, adding a warm touch to the ambience. However, the service tends to be on the slower side, which might require a bit of patience. Overall, Zamana is worth a visit for its exceptional flavours, though some improvement in service speed would enhance the dining experience.

Had a good experience. Lovely ambience, great food and nice service. What I loved the most is that the food is 100% Authentic Pakistani, and that’s the reason why its is absolutely delicious! Prices are reasonable, though portion sizes can be improved. Would definitely recommend it and will visit again. 👍🏼
We ordered Platter No. 2. The meat was very tender and flavorful. The portion was enough for four people, and we also had some extra naan. It was definitely worth visiting.

The restaurant was slightly quiet as we wanted to come after the rush of iftar. The starters were amazingly flavoured as well as the mains. We tried a variety of different dishes, all being very well prepared. Would recommend.

Delicious Pakistani food without the high oil content often found elsewhere. The atmosphere and service was excellent too. Loved our experience and food. Portions are generous so took back some doggy bags.

venues.name: Meat Street
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I'd heard about Meat Street a while ago & decided to give it a try today. By far the best medium rib eye steak with chips I've ever had!
I had half Chimichurri sauce, which was absolutely delicious
& half peppercorn sauce, also lovely.
I was advised to eat the steak & chips straight away - which I did & it was amazing! So succulent & tender. I would definitely recommend that you give them a try

I stumbled upon this place randomly as I was craving steak and this exceeded all my expectations of a food truck. The steak was tender, well seasoned and the peppercorn and chimichurri sauce was super moorish and tasty. The owner was so friendly and let me try my steak before it was ready to ensure I was happy with the taste. Overall this was a brilliant experience for a spontaneous dinner and I will be back soon!

After seeing some of the viral videos about this place I thought I’d give it a try….and oh boy was it amazing!!!!
I got the rib eye loaded fries and a brisket burger, eating it fresh off the grill on nearby seating in the high street. It was cooked to perfection with the meat so tender it was falling apart and the seasoned chips and sauces were sublime. The burger was also nice with the chef spicing up the sauce for me so it had a little kick.
I would 100% recommend this place and already encouraged friends and family to visit. I’ll be going back soon!
The service was great with the staff offering suggestions on sauces and combinations, even giving me a piece of meat whilst preparing my order to check I was happy with it (which was so succulent!!!)
It’s a food truck on the high street opposite Argos, so plenty of space for kids to play around too. Go, go, go!!!!

Caught Meatstreat from Ilford on their tour stop in Preston seriously impressive. We had the sirloin and ribeye with peppercorn sauce, grilled onions, and cheese. Juicy, flavorful, and the fries were spot on. If their tour’s coming near you, don’t miss it.

An outstanding dining experience from start to finish. The service was attentive and professional, creating a welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere. I ordered the sirloin steak, which was cooked to absolute perfection  tender, juicy, and full of flavour. It was complemented beautifully by a rich garlic butter, a bold peppercorn sauce, a vibrant chilli chimichurri, and perfectly crisp fried onions. Every component was thoughtfully prepared and incredibly well-balanced. A truly memorable meal that exceeded expectations. Highly recommended.

venues.name: restaurant favorit
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Food is very good here . I would recommend the mici and cartofi prăjiți and  the papanasi desert. I can't really say that I like the atmosphere there because of the 'famous manele music' but overall it's a good place to eat romanian food.
Really enjoyed the lamb pastrama dish tonight absolutely beautiful, service from waiters was 5 star couldn’t want for anything. Highly recommend!
UBER EATS....FOR THE FIRST TIME I USED UBER EATS...IT WAS OUTSTANDING...SO FAS SP EASY SO CONVENIENTLY EASY....RHANK YOU INDEED...I COULD BELIEVE WHEN MY PHONE RINGED....THANK YOU....UBER....

Visited many times and always was nice but last week when visited again with family was very disappointing!
There I am guessing new waitresses(boy and girl)none of them speak English at all,I understand it’s romanian restaurant but there many different ones so people speaks English!
I have to repeat my order many times because boy can’t understand what we want ,brought it beer we newer asked for,while taking order from us at same time  speaks in romanian to others !this is very unprofessional and disrespectful,I am paying for food not eating for free ,chef changed I think also as rice with garlic not as delicious as it was before,same with crab plate from fish menus .
There one guy who speaks English and who has professional manners of serving but he wasn’t there on afternoon time ,food not cheap so service should be much way higher,each time we go each time we spend around 150£/170£ for 2 adults and 2 kids ,this is definitely our last visit .
Not coming back again

Not a nice place, to be honest.
First thing: they charge full price a coffee (£3.5 same as any other shop), but they use instant 3in1 satchels which are disgusting. They should invest in a proper coffee machine.
Second thing: the food. I had the mixed grill which is a staple for Romanian cuisine. Where do I begin?
The "mici" were disgusting, definitely not fresh (frozen?), and uneatable.
The pork shoulder was ok....but not the best.
The grilled chicken wings looked like they have seen other tables before.
The sausage.....is a sausage. Can't go wrong with that as you just buy them from a shop and slap them on a grill.
The grilled chicken was quite chewy.
I asked if they used good, fresh romanian tomatoes for the salad, waiter said 100%. The tomatoes that came in the salad resembled the ones you can buy for 50p in iceland or lidl.
I recommend this place if you just want some drinks....but based on what I tasted, I don't recommend the food.

venues.name: Manjaros Restaurant Ilford
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had a great meal at Manjaros. We ordered the wings platter, smash burger, waka waka chicken and chilli chips. Everything tasted amazing and the service was spot on. The only small thing was the chilli chips being a bit too tangy, but overall it was a really good experience. Definitely coming back

We visited Manjaros around 12pm on a Sunday for an early lunch, hoping to avoid queues. First impressions were positive, the restaurant was well decorated, clean, and had thoughtful facilities including a good-sized prayer room and a baby changing room. The menu offered plenty of choice, catering for different tastes and appetites.
For our meal, we ordered the mixed skewers and the tandoori flatbread. Unfortunately, the mixed skewers were a real letdown, they didn’t seem freshly prepared, more like precooked chicken pieces that had simply been reheated on the grill and coated with sauce. The tandoori flatbread was fine, but the overall experience of the food didn’t live up to expectations.
To add to this, the service was stretched. There was only one waitress managing the entire restaurant, and as more customers arrived, it was clear she was struggling to keep up despite doing her best.
This was our first visit to Manjaros, and given the positive reviews we had read, we had gone in expecting much better. Sadly, the experience fell short and left us disappointed.

I visited Manjaros illford branch today, and ordered couple of things from their menu. And tbvh i like everything, Prawn size was genorous and the sauce raise the game. If I talk about the Hot shot Parmesan, i would say 10/10 because the quantity and quality both was perfect, if you want to eat pizza and some steak i’d suggest you to order this item.❤️
The only thing i didn’t like was their fries, they were soggy and not crispy. I think they should change the brand they are using.

I had a great experience at this restaurant, largely thanks to Nicole! She was incredibly helpful and kind — it seemed like she was the only person working, running around to serve everyone, yet she stayed friendly and smiling the whole time. Truly excellent service, 10/10.

As for the food, the Hot shot Parmesan Chicken was very good — full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The Chicken Tikka was just okay in comparison. Prices were a bit on the higher.

I originally went for the buy1 get 2nd half off but it was only limited to 3 dishes on the entire menu which didn’t really add up. Instead I bought the Mushroom Waka Waka which was really nice especially the pilau / steamed yellow rice.  My party bought the half-chicken meal. For drinks, we bought the J2O and the Lychee Mocktail which was actually nice (just remember to stir the drink before drinking).
I REALLY wanted to try the new Chocolate dessert which I had ordered, Unfortunately that was not available and so I had to get a refund. I was really gutted at that point, so I left and bought some chai from ChaiiWala 😭.
I feel that dessert would’ve made a difference as an end of meal dessert, but sadly it’s not available but it’s still actively on the menu 🤦🏻‍♀️😭.

venues.name: Singam Bay
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I’m giving 3 stars mainly because of the taste of the food. I usually choose the restaurant for our weekly dinners, and unfortunately, this was the first time everyone in our group of six was unhappy with my choice.
It was a disappointing experience. We couldn’t finish any of our meals, everything was too salty, and most dishes looked and tasted the same, with the same colour and gravy across the board. I've tried many Sri Lankan restaurants around East London, but sadly, Singham Bay didn’t meet the mark.
We mentioned the saltiness to the staff, but apart from a quick “sorry,” there was no real acknowledgment — even though they could clearly see we hadn't touched most of the food.
We originally ordered 3 biryanis, but after taking the order, we were told they’d run out. Later, they brought just one biryani, which looked unappetizing and tasted just as poor.
The dosa was too oily, the chutneys lacked flavour, and the fish had no seasoning or taste. The chicken lollipop was oddly sweet and salty at the same time. The fish platter was underwhelming, and the naan was rubbery.
On the positive side, the decor was nice  but the music was far too loud, which made it hard to talk.
Sorry, Singham Bay — I really wanted to like the place, but the food and overall experience left me very disappointed. I felt I needed to share this so others know what to expect. You need to work with your food taste.

Absolutely unbeatable food and for the quality you get for the price you pay is unmatched. Authentic Sri Lankan food with amazing bits from starters to mains and even the deserts! We ordered way too much food and paid around £35pp between 6 people including drinks!

Will definitely go back

We had an amazing experience at Singam Bay in Ilford! We were a group of 27, and Thantha managed everything smoothly with professionalism and friendliness — truly outstanding service.

The food was just as impressive: flavourful chicken lollipops, sizzling mixed grill platters, and crispy calamari, all beautifully presented.

Highly recommend for authentic Sri Lankan cuisine and excellent service!

Delicious beyond words.
Super friendly staff, kind and helpful.
Made our time so enjoyable last month.
Our first time trying Sri Lankan food and this place did not disappoint 🔥
Definitely coming back with my friends and family.

Absolutely outstanding. Top quality food and very kind waiters. All the food was delicious and at a very affordable price. It was our first time dining in this area and we thoroughly enjoyed it. We will definitely be returning! The staff were all lovely and service was quick. Interior was beautiful and had an expensive feel.

Accessibility is good, free parking available right outside

Recommendations: Nethili Fry (was so good we ordered it twice!), chicken 65 and roti and lamb curry.

venues.name: Zahra Grill Restaurant
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Visited here yesterday, was pleasantly surprised, for £4.99 you get a big plate (thaali) with halwa, freshly made puri’s, chana and aloo bhaji. The food was piping hot when it came out, the mango lassi tasted very fresh and the karak chaii was perfect, all in these cost £10 together which was amazing. The server was very nice, we asked for a takeaway portion of the halwa but she didn’t charge us and gave it free of charge which we did not expect at all.

I just had the best experience at Zahra Grill with my friends! The desi flavors were on point - it felt like a taste of home, just like Pakistani food! Our server, Muhammad Naveed, was super friendly and went above and beyond. He even surprised us with complimentary kheer and saag, which was the icing on the cake! I'm definitely taking my family here again, can't wait to share the love!

Absolutely awful experience at Zahra Grill in Ilford. The food was shockingly bad – oily, salty, and completely tasteless. The rice was clearly not fresh, hard and reheated in the microwave from days ago. The garlic naan was rock solid, and I had to ask them to remake it.

The curries were swimming in so much oil that we ended up draining it off the plates, but the oil just kept coming until there was barely any sauce left. By the end of the meal, I had an upset stomach and chest pains because of how greasy everything was.

If you’re looking for a heart attack on a plate, this place will happily serve you one. Honestly, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant to my worst enemy. Absolutely appalling – avoid at all costs.

The environment was amazing, and the staff was very welcoming. I absolutely loved the halwa puri and lassi — both are a must-try! The chana had a rich, authentic flavor.
We also tried the roti, naan, and aloo gosht — everything was fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of taste. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys delicious desi food!

The desi breakfast is soooo good here. The chicken cheese paratha with karak chai is my favourite. I'm hooked. The staff are warm and welcoming especially Varsha she is literally the sweetest woman ever! She is always nice to me and my husband ❤️ Highly recommended for some quick and easy breakfast craving fix.

venues.name: Kahani
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Decided to try Kahani after seeing posts on instagram. Unfortunately I was left dissatisfied and disappointed. I hate giving negative feedback and try to see the positives. I hope this feedback is taken onboard and seen as constructive rather than insulting.
There was no one to greet us/sit us down when we entered. I had to go find the member of staff. However apart from this the service was very good.
The decor was excellent however there was no one else at the restaurant when we arrived so I cannot comment on the atmosphere. One bit of advice here I would give is that they should spray the restaurant with a form of fly killer as there was an abundance of fruit flies which were flying around us and amongst our food. It was very off putting. When mentioned to the staff they just disregarded it as normal because of the fruit!? I then had to ask the staff to remove the empty plates to discourage the flies.

Food ordered:
Teapot Gol Gappe: Gappe were burnt and hard but the water was nice but could have been a bit more tangy.
Seekh Kebab: A bit pink inside but nice taste.
Grilled Wings: good portion and very nice taste.
Chilli Chicken: was ok, good presentation but chicken was on the harder side.
Charsi Lamb: Well seasoned and presented. The only problem? You could smell the meat needed some more spices to hide smell as off putting.
Haleem: could only taste the wheat and grain. Not the meat. Very well presented. Let down by taste.
Mango Daiquiri: Very nice and refreshing
Strawberry Mojito: was nice but not cold enough and lacked slightly in taste.

Note to Management: you have a great idea and have spent a vast amount on advertising. My advise is to sit down and try all your dishes. Only slight improvement needed and you will be on to a winner.
**Edit**
Great response from genuine people. Will definitely revisit again.

What surprised me straight away was the crowd. I was half expecting a few Bengalis and Pakistanis to roll up in an RS3 or a BMW with a balloon in one hand chatting about Bushras in Bradford while their wives sit at home watching Turkish dramas. But no, the vibe was way more relaxed and the crowd was lowkey and respectful. Definitely not your usual shisha circus.

It was a great experience from start to finish. The place is clean, well laid out, and has a chilled welcoming vibe. The lighting is just right, the seating is comfortable, and there is a solid mix of music playing throughout the evening. They also had live entertainment while we were there which added a nice touch without being too much. It is definitely the kind of spot where you can actually relax and take your time.

We asked the waitress for shisha recommendations and she was spot on. She suggested the blueberry and raspberry mix and another one with frozen apple and blueberry. Both were excellent choices. The blueberry and raspberry was fruity and sweet without being overwhelming, smooth and easy to enjoy. The frozen apple and blueberry was even better in my opinion. The apple gave it a cool crisp edge and the blueberry added just the right amount of softness and sweetness. The flavour came through clearly in every pull and the setup was done properly with no harshness and no rushing through coal changes. It lasted a good amount of time and stayed smooth throughout.

Kahani also serves food and desserts and the whole menu is halal which is great to see. We did not try the food this time around but it is good to know you can have a full meal or something sweet if you are there for a longer evening.

I did go for a nonalcoholic mango mojito which was probably the only letdown of the night. It was far too syrupy. The drink felt heavy, more like mango squash than a proper mojito. The mint and lime were almost nonexistent so it lacked the fresh sharp taste you expect. It looked good but the flavour just did not match up. I would not order it again to be honest.

All in all Kahani is a solid spot for anyone looking for good shisha a clean setting and a calm atmosphere. The staff know what they are doing and the flavours are clearly thought out. Just maybe give the mojito a pass and stick to what they do best. I will definitely be back.

We came here for breakfast and ordered a halva puri breakfast and an omelette breakfast. Both were very nice. In my opinionI the omelette lacked flavour, despite everything in it and also it was more like a flan as it was cooked and served in a heavy pan. I probably should have ordered the desi omlette.

We also noticed one or two small (what looked like fruit flies) around us and it was only when my husband got up to pay the bill that I glanced around the restaurant and noticed at least 20 to 30 flies over the wall and ceiling just above us.  I strongly suggest the owners look into this.

Amazing staffs
Amazing food
Karak chai was good had 2cups
Desserts 🩷💜
Will definitely come back
For shisha & the new mocktails
The best highlight was kahani herself (parrot) although I was abit scared. ❤️

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 80k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

We recently visited an Indian/Pakistani restaurant in East London, and it turned out to be a real gem. From the moment we stepped in, we were captivated by the stylish and welcoming decor. Thoughtful touches, like the birds in the back creating a serene atmosphere, and a projector playing kids’ shows to keep little ones entertained, made it a place where every detail was designed with care. Hands down, it has one of the best ambiances we’ve experienced in the area.

Now, let’s talk about the food—absolutely bursting with flavor! We tried the Nihari, lamb chops, haleem, and a few other dishes, and every bite was a treat. The Nihari stood out with its rich, deep flavors, perfectly balanced without being overly spicy. And their Karak chai? A dream—smooth, strong, and oh-so-comforting.

But the true star of the meal was the parathas. Seriously, these were next-level—flaky on the outside, warm and soft on the inside, and just downright delicious. It’s not every day you find parathas this good.

If you’re looking for a place with incredible food and a stunning atmosphere, we can’t recommend this spot enough!

venues.name: Saffron Street
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Delicious food. Masala fries where probably the best I’ve ever eaten. The tacos were nice, but a bit too oily.

One negative was the attendee when I arrived within the 15 minutes holding time. I was not aware the entire group had to be there to claim the reservation (especially when one of them is arriving with a newborn baby!) and feel like it could have been communicated more nicely especially once our original table had been given away. Other than that, the service was fine.

Was craving some chaat. I’ve been to their other restaurant - Saffron Kitchen many times and I’ve always loved the chaat platter there. Since I was in the Gants Hill area however and didn’t fancy the drive to Leyton, we decided to come here instead because they do the same platter.

I’ve been here several times too over the years, and whilst the food has always been consistently decent, it’s definitely never been anything to remember - just more of a nice convenient place if I’m in the area and can’t think of anywhere else to go. Anyway, I hoped the chaat platter would be just like Saffron Kitchen’s, unfortunately, it wasn’t - all the chaats were far too sweet, and the gol gappe were filled almost entirely with yogurt, which none of us enjoyed.

The mains were better - nothing wow as usual, but decent with nice balanced flavours and decent portions. The Indian dishes were definitely better than the Chinese fusion options though.

That said, the restaurant itself is very aesthetic, and we were seated quickly with great service throughout. The food presentation is always on point, with a bit of added theatricals for the gram if you’re into that kind of thing.

We traveled 125miles to come here because my son loves this place. The captions says it all. The best hands down , the vibe is so good here too and waiter service great, large mocktail and daiquiri range too. Been coming here for 5 years twice a year for anniversaries and birthdays . The biryani's are awesome here too a whole lamb shank protruding out of it.  The kids always  wake up early to travel here and sleep the way back home (That says it all really)

Wow!
Words cannot describe how the food was, simply amazing 🤩
Made me feel like i am eating on the streets of Mumbai… 🥰
Every dish in the menu is simply amazing
The taste, the flavours, the aroma and the service, just loved it.

The service was very fast.

I would not consider and compare the place to fine dine or any such restaurants but would rather say it’s the best Street Food Joint in London.

The taste and flavours beat a famous fine dine around here as well.

Best Value for Money as well…

Keep it up 👍🏻

This is a hidden gem in Ilford. Have been following reviews for few months, and thought will give it a go for Sunday Lunch 😀

Nice choice for vegetarians and good selection if you are foodie 😊

Kalai the chef, ensured our order was served within 15 minutes. Staff were very polite and recommended few signature dishes from the menu. Lunch crowd was just building up for a Sunny Sunday at 14.00 pm, but the place got pretty full by 3.30 and there was big reservation for 20 people, so we were on time before they arrived 😋

Kitchen was super busy with Deliveroo orders too, so it must be popular one for locals!

Please make sure, you are super hungry before you come to this place to do justice to the meal. Definitely coming back 🤗

venues.name: Jilani Curry & Grill Restaurant
venues.description: A celebration of Indian flavors with contemporary London style - expect the unexpected. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had take out a few times and eaten in too. The Thai food is so good. Authentic flavours red/green curry’s, pad Thai and Pad prik were amazing. Tried the mixed grill which was good too. Huge burgers. Will Definitely be back
Alhumdulilah amazing food and service.  Few of us met up and decided on this place. Worth every penny. We will defo be coming back In shaa Allah and recommending to others.

Just had one of the best Thai meals I've had in a long time. Everything we had was fresh, piping hot and had amazing flavours. We ordered mixed starters, tempura king prawns and chicken satay with mains of Thai green curry with beef, Chicken Pad Kra Pow and King Prawn fried rice. The beef, chicken and prawns were cooked to perfection and melted in your mouth. The decor inside is more modern cafe than Thai but the staff were very friendly and accommodating. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this restaurant.

Surprisingly awesome experience! Didn’t expect this to become our local favourite but we went as a big group and all enjoyed it very much. The waiter was amazing, very attentive and polite, food was exceptional quality and décor lovely. Thank you guys very making our night so nice.

B good.
Good. Portion
Best food ever
This place is 10/10
Please pop in

venues.name: Sahara Grill
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I went to Sahara Grill with the family for a birthday celebration. We started with buffalo wings, dynamite prawns, and prawn croquettes. As ever, the wings were top tier with the sauce tangy and spicy. The prawns were also good but came a distant second to the chicken. For mains we had a selection of burgers grill chicken chicken steak and saute beef. I would say all items were good, the saute in particular was tasty, with the other items also hitting the mark. Overall i would definitely recommend and go back again

Absolutely loved our experience at Sahara Grill Ilford. From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed by the staff l, who were genuinely friendly, attentive, and always happy to help with recommendations.

The menu is impressively broad, offering a wide variety of options that cater to all tastes, whether you're after something hearty, spicy, grilled or mild. But hands down, the standout dishes for us were the lamb chops and lamb shank; both cooked to perfection. The lamb chops were juicy, tender, and packed with flavour, and the lamb shank was fall-off-the-bone soft and richly spiced. You can tell they’ve really mastered their grills.

Service was quick and well organised, even during busy hours, and the food arrived fresh and hot. The portion sizes were generous, and everything we tried was full of flavour.

A lot of reviewers mention the consistently high quality of food, and I’d agree. It's clear they maintain high standards.

Highly recommend Sahara Grill Ilford for anyone looking for great food, great service, and a genuinely enjoyable dining experience.

We had a lovely meal at Sahara Grill in Gants Hill. The food was delicious and served quickly, so we didn’t have to wait long. Fahim provided excellent service and made us feel welcome. We ordered the Sahara steak cooked medium rare — it was tender and a real delight. My son loved it! I also enjoyed the half chicken, which was full of flavour. My other son really liked the buffalo wings. Overall, we had a great time and would definitely visit again.

Sahara Grill Gants Hill offers a solid halal dining experience with well-prepared dishes and a comfortable atmosphere. I tried the chicken steak, which was tender, flavorful, and nicely grilled. The chicken bites were crispy, well-seasoned, and made a great starter. Portion sizes were generous, and the presentation was clean. The staff were polite and attentive, and the overall service was smooth. A good option for casual dining with quality halal food.

I visited the Ilford Sahara Grill and I had a great experience.
The food was presented very well with generous portion sizes and it was very tasty.
The service provided was excellent. We had  a wonderful waiter called Nazrul - he was attentive and very accommodating toward our needs. He was also well spoken and very respectful.
A great evening ☺️

venues.name: Shah's Halal Food Ilford
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
The guys that were working was  clearly talking to eachother and not listening to my order at all! I asked for combo over rice but they gave me only chicken! They did that with not one but two boxes! One was regular size and the other was supposed to be a large! They gave us both regular!
I asked them sauce on separate container but as you can see!
Total disappointment!
Best rice & chicken platter and gyros in Ilford! Clean place, lovely staff, and Adnan is a star. Highly recommend!
I was wrong before about them on Uber Eats, but after listening my complaint, they improved their service at there best. Now, I am the regular customer who loves Shah Halal food soo much.
The platters were quite big.Good value for money unfortunately their was not sitting area but we went into the shopping mall and sat and ate our lunch

We ordered takeaway today from Shah. The order said it will take 50 minutes and the delivery was made almost 2 hours later. That's not the worst of it, it was the wrong order completely. We spent £40 and no food to show for. As we had broken our fast needless to say we were hungry. Tried calling them but they didn't pick. Absolutely the worst customer service. I would give them no start but that isn't possible

venues.name: Naan Staap®
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Very good taste Reminds about Pakistan ♥️ tea is amazing ♥️
Harisa and chicken jalfarazi is amazing. Just one thing please add raita too in the menu. It will double the taste.

Tucked along the bustling stretch of Ilford Lane, Naan Stop is a recent discovery that delivers a refreshing and satisfying dining experience, especially for fans of casual yet high-quality South Asian street food. This was my first visit, and it certainly left a strong impression.

Atmosphere & Seating
The first thing that struck me was the inviting interior. With its lovely modern decor and spacious seating areas, Naan Stop strikes the perfect balance between casual comfort and a trendy, contemporary vibe. Whether you’re dining solo or with friends, the layout accommodates a relaxed meal without feeling cramped – a rarity in busy high-street eateries.

Service & Ordering
Service here is friendly and efficient. The setup is straightforward: you order at the till, and once your food is ready, they call out the number printed on your receipt. It’s a quick, no-fuss system that keeps things moving even when it gets busy, and staff maintain a warm and welcoming attitude throughout.

Food Quality
Now to the highlight: the food. I opted for the potato naan, which came packed with flavour. Not your average aloo naan – this one had chilli and onions mixed in, giving it a real kick of heat and depth that elevated it beyond expectations. The naan itself deserves a special mention – light, fluffy, and not overly doughy – a sign that it was made fresh and with care.
On the drinks front, the kadak chai lived up to its name – strong, well-balanced, and perfect with food. It complemented the spiced naan beautifully and rounded off the meal with a touch of comfort.

Final Thoughts
This visit to Naan Stop was a pleasant surprise. From the quality of the food to the ambiance and service, everything came together to create an enjoyable experience. It’s clear that attention to detail is a priority here – whether it's the freshness of ingredients or the overall customer experience.
If you're in the area and looking for something flavourful, fast, and fresh, Naan Stop is definitely worth a visit. I’m already looking forward to returning and exploring more of their menu.

We had a great experience at Naan Stop! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service provided by Majbeen was excellent—very friendly and attentive. The highlight for us was definitely the Naan Harisa—full of flavour and perfectly cooked. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for tasty, authentic food with great service.

This was our first visit with family of 3. We had good time and enjoyed the taste of foods, gentleman who was serving us made our food time more enjoyable with his friendly and informative service from the till as well as was getting feedback about how was the food.

Dum Qeema naan was lovely and reasonably priced. But I feel like I need to complain about the service... Iqra & Rashi were so friendly, welcoming & down to earth that the service became more enjoyable than the food.

The problem with such good service is you start to expect it everywhere and then end up disappointed when it doesn't arrive. So please guys, don't spoil us...

venues.name: PHAT BITE Ilford
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Delicious food, fantastic service and a nice chilled out vibe in the store. Highly recommend coming here!

Came here for the first time, service was good and cleanliness not an issue. We got the mixed platter for £14.99 lamb and chicken.

Personally lamb was better chicken was a bit tough but had flavour, wings and burger was really good and Masala fries was nice however was very spicy bear in mind.

Would definitely come here again.

The food was the best especially the boneless wings and the service was excellent Muhammed took care of me with a big smile on his face and made me welcome
Will come again and recommend to people .

Order loaded box with chicken donor, smash burger, spicy fries, wings. To be honest for the price, it is a good offer. Chicken donor is little spicy so if you don't eat much spice do let them know.
Overall I rated 4 because I had better smash burger BUT for the price it is good. Tasted nice and did the job (as I was really hungry).

Also need to find Parking, so nothing available at the door, need to park further up...

Service was good, food was served within 10 minutes and it was warm, so enjoyed it.

I deffo recommend this place... Thank you.

The food is great. We tried the Fully Loaded Platter with naga chips and buffalo wings. The wings felt too salty for me. But loved the rest. Cheaper price. Decoration is good and colourful. But the temperature is bit warm inside.

venues.name: Watan - Afghan & Pakistani Restaurant Ilford
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We visited this restaurant on Tuesday night around 10:30 PM. The service was excellent, and the food was delicious. The seating area was very comfortable, and the staff treated us with great respect and hospitality. It was my first visit, it was little expensive 🤭 but I would highly recommend this place to everyone.🫰🤤

I visited Watan on a Tuesday evening around 8:30 PM, and as always, the experience was excellent. We ordered the large platter, chapli kebab, paneer curry, chicken karahi, and keema naan—and every single dish was bursting with flavor. The taste is consistently 10/10, and Watan rarely disappoints when it comes to the quality and seasoning of their food.

That said, when the place gets really packed, the food might not come out sizzling hot temperature-wise—but it's still warm and delicious. It's something to keep in mind, especially during peak hours when the kitchen is clearly under pressure.

The ambiance can also get hot and humid when it’s full, which may be uncomfortable for some. But honestly, the amazing food makes up for it.

Price-wise, it’s a bit on the higher side. I’ve noticed they’ve increased prices generously over the years, which is understandable to an extent, but it does push it into the “slightly expensive” category for what it is.

Overall, Watan delivers fantastic food, and if you can handle a busy atmosphere and a bit of heat, it’s absolutely worth a visit.

First visit. There was a queue to the door which usually means good food. We were told to sit on a table then waiters decided to move us to another table, Which we didn’t mind.
Chapli kebab was the highest as it was perfectly cooked and with the sauces it was delicious.
Charsi lamb was not up to the standard and not fully cooked.
Drink looked good but tasted very average.
Overall not a bad experience but I will not go again.

I recently visited Watan on Ilford Lane, which markets itself as an authentic Pakistani cuisine restaurant. Unfortunately, my experience did not live up to the expectations that the branding and pricing suggest.

The most disappointing aspect was the food itself. We tried the nihari, which was passable at best, lacking the rich depth and spice that one would expect from a traditional Pakistani dish. The barbecue platter, which came with a hefty price tag, was particularly underwhelming. The meats were bland and poorly seasoned, to the point that it was genuinely difficult to tell whether we were eating chicken or lamb. The flavours were indistinct and certainly did not justify the high cost.

The restaurant is quite small, which might have been manageable if the space had been better utilised, but it felt cramped and overcrowded. The atmosphere seemed chaotic rather than lively, and the overall dining experience felt rushed and uncomfortable. It is heavily overhyped in my opinion, perhaps relying more on social media buzz than actual substance.

In summary, Watan is a restaurant that promises authentic Pakistani food but falls short in nearly every respect. The food lacks flavour, the prices are unjustifiably high and the environment is far from enjoyable. I would not recommend it for those seeking genuine Pakistani cuisine or good value for money.

I was nearby so found this place online and reviews were quite positive so gave it a try.

Man oh man, it did not dissapoint. The food was amazing! The service was top notch.

We had their chapli kebab and mix grill.

The Chapli kebab was on of the best i've ever had. The mix grill was brilliant. The food was so fresh and tasty. The kebabs were so good. Perfectly cooked meat and chicken. The lamb chops were really tender and flavoursome.

Can't rate this place enough. Highly recommend!

venues.name: Spice Khazana
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Fantastic Experience at Spice Khazana!

I recently visited Spice Khazana, and it was an amazing experience from start to finish! The buffet offered a wide variety of authentic Pakistani halal dishes, each full of rich flavor and perfectly prepared. My absolute favorites were the Haleem, Paya, Chicken Tikka, Doi Bora, and Pani Puri — every bite was delicious and full of authentic taste.

The service was excellent — the staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. The restaurant decor was beautifully done, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Plus, there was plenty of space, so it felt comfortable even when it got busy.

Overall, Spice Khazana is a wonderful spot for anyone looking to enjoy an authentic Pakistani halal buffet. Highly recommended for families, friends, and food lovers alike!

I had a party at Spice Khazana Restaurant and the experience was fantastic! They’ve added new dishes like dahi bhalla, spring rolls, samosas, and even nuggets for kids. Souwas very tasty overall The food was fresh, tasty, and the service was excellent. Truly the best food in London, Ilford – highly recommended!

A lovely NASHTA experience at Spice Khazana Ilford. Food was very tasty, hot, and appetising with  reasonable price. I went with my friend this time and we would definitely come back with families next.
Maram chai was just so perfect.👌
I would rate service was little slow but the guy who served us was very humble, polite and served us very respectfully.
We recieved our food bit late as we were last ones to be served but we didn’t mind that as the atmosphere was so calm and positive
*Overall, would definitely recommend!!! A perfect place to go either with kids or families and friends.

I had a very disappointing experience. The food was old, overly oily, and completely unappetizing. The atmosphere was unpleasant and smelled bad. Even the toilets were dirty and had a strong odor. On top of that, the prices were unreasonably high. I definitely do not recommend this place to anyone. I took photos of the food I was served—tried it once and will never return.

We had birthday party at spice khazana. Food was tasty and service was best. We invited 50 people there to celebrate our son birthday. We been service nicely. All guests loved food and service. Best thing is free parking there.

venues.name: Sultan
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Went to sultan after a few years as I usually go down to north London. But I have to say this will be my go to spot food was brilliant. Crispy toasted and season bread with very well cooked meat. Highly recommend this place

Our family favourite Turkish restaurant as food & service is always great.
We love the platters.
Friendly & attentive staff.
Complementary bread, salad, dips & Turkish tea.

Visiting from North America, was delighted to dine at this highly recommended restaurant. The meat was extremely flavorful and the sides were impeccable. The fresh baklava was also one of the best i have had. Above all, was very impressed by the service. We had a guest with allergies and the staff was extremely knowledgeable and exercised great care to serve us. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting.

I had a wonderful dining experience at this establishment. The food was exceptionally delicious, with each dish freshly prepared and full of flavor. We were pleasantly surprised to receive complimentary baklava, which was a delightful touch.

The pricing was very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the food. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with tasteful decor that added to the overall charm of the restaurant. Additionally, the facilities, including the restroom, were impeccably clean.

The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, contributing greatly to our positive experience. I left very satisfied and would not hesitate to recommend this restaurant to friends and family. I look forward to returning in the future.

I LOVE THIS PLACE!!!!

I cannot recall the amount of time I have Sultan's but I would say I do not go more than 2 months without visiting. I always purchase the platters because for the price you pay, you get a lot of food... it is so worth the money. The chicken is so soft and well marinated. The same can be said about the Ribs...omg the Ribs are divine, some of the best I have had. The bread you get with the houmous and other sides is so fresh, as well as the salad too. All in all, lovely place, staff are kind and food is always, always delicious. I love Sultans so much!!

venues.name: Colony Restaurant
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: First time coming here and it was to celebrate my brother's birthday. The staff are so lovely and helpful. The decor is amazing and the place is very clean. The food was really nice. Mocktail was amazing! Loved the dessert too. Would definitely recommend.

First-time visit and it was great 👌
We went on a family outing to celebrate a relative’s first anniversary. It was a Saturday evening, just as the restaurant opened, and we had made an earlier reservation for the group.
The service was excellent, from a warm welcome, to accommodating our request for seating that allowed space for a baby in a pram. The waiters were especially friendly with our two young children and even gave them a little treat (boxed brownies) at the end of the meal.
We ordered a variety of starters including poppadoms, paneer, prawns, and chaat. The prawns were fantastic, well cooked with just the right amount of spice for a little kick. The only small criticism was that the poppadoms could have been served with larger portions of dips.
For the mains, we had steak, a mixed grill, curries, and burgers for the kids. Everything was cooked well, full of flavour, and enjoyed by all. The chops and steak in particular received rave reviews.
To finish, we ordered a selection of desserts along with kharak chai. The desserts were excellent, rich in flavour, with the right texture and moisture. The chai was smooth, flavoursome, and perfectly sweetened.
Before leaving, it was time for prayers, and once again the staff accommodated us by providing a prayer area and prayer mats.

Overall, the experience was outstanding. The combination of great food, excellent service, and a clean, spacious setting makes this restaurant ideal not just for casual meals, but also for celebrating special occasions. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening and will definitely be going back to try more of the dishes we didn’t get to sample this time.

First time here with family and we all loved it. We came when it was rather quiet. All the staff were extremely friendly and attentive. All our courses was delicious. The restaurant was clean. Parking available in a nearby carpark free in the evening. Praying facilities also available. Staff also gave free brownie favour to the kids. Will return again.

went for a birthday dinner - would definitely recommend the chops, the cheesecake, the samosa chaat, and the buttered naans, they were the standouts ! their mocktails were lovely as well, my family really liked the pina coladas.

there’s free parking near the back in the academy in the evenings, and the interior of the restaurant is lovely for gatherings !

they did forget one of the dishes we ordered and a drink, so we had to cancel one item off the menu - but they were quite quick with their service otherwise

I don’t usually leave reviews, but this experience has stuck with me and I feel it needs to be said. We came here for a family Eid meal a while back and were absolutely shocked to be served a completely raw burger for my 3-year-old son. It was pink and cold inside totally unsafe to eat.

Staff removed the service charge and gave 10% off the bill, but considering the risk this posed to a toddler, that gesture honestly felt like a slap in the face. My son complained of stomach pain after and I spent the evening worried sick, not knowing if he’d fall ill.

No proper apology, no follow-up, no accountability. I even sent dms, emails and messages but received nothing back! I’ve kept the photos and have seriously considered reporting it further. I wouldn’t trust this place with kids or vulnerable people and that says it all.

venues.name: Franzos Ilford
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Food was very good. A bit noisy but you can expect from that many prople. Not very expensive as well.

Food was average, would have gone to Nando’s.
The toilet blocked up and the place smelled badly, staff tried covering the smell by using air freshener’s, would not recommend this place.
My chicken tenders had more batter then meat.

Very tasty chicken, it’s second to none. I tasted Nando’s and tried Franzos chicken they almost taste the same. Franzos sauces are very good, it’s their signature sauces which uplifts the taste . Chicken was very tender .

Wonderful staff at this restaurant, super helpful I was served by Harry and Rima. The food was fresh and tasted great. The chicken tastes better than Nando’s so definitely worth a visit! Bursting flavours and great portions

Wonderful atmosphere , Bhavan looked after us very well , she was helpful and informative, food was wonderful specially burgers children loved them. Excellent place for family friends and worth to visit again and again.

venues.name: Naan Staap
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Amazing taste and staff specially Usman and Amina, great service, ordered Lamb Hareesa, Nashta Platter, Naan and Bombay Sandwich along with Cinnamon Roll and Karak Tea without Sugar

Do Naat Staap here!  I orders the only breakfast meal they have for £9.95 and it was atrocious! It comes with 4 items, some oily canna, halwa, bread ( can choose from naan, paraotha and something else) and chai oh yeah and some measly pickles. I can't believe they charge nearly £10 for this. As there were 2 of us it equated to nearly £20 I could've bought some decent engine oil with that price instead I got plate full of curry oil. The place is run by a lady with little to Naan customer experience she saw we had young children all under the age of 6, and could not even offer them tap water when the weather was 26C outside! Absolutely ridiculous and blaming the management for it.. Well this review is also to address the stingy management why can't you offer better breakfast like Chaiiwala? Instead you give us plate full of oil for £10,  save yourself a hastle and just offer customers a can full of cooking oil.

Collected lamb bhi a paying 11.95 .
6 very small /tiny pieces of lamb with lots of sauces . Very disappointing. Compare to other place.

It was early morning, Monday, 5 May 2025. Nice staff and freshly made paratha for breakfast 😋 👌
Thanks

My family and I have been going to Naan Staap since it opened. Their food is exceptionally tasty and of high quality.

In addition to that, the staff are extremely calm, friendly and considerate. Most definitely one of the best customer service experiences we have had.

Furthermore, I regularly book and use their private hire space for functions and events. It is clean, well equipped and wonderfully managed!

I highly recommend.

Tahreem

venues.name: Grill House
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I have ordered with Uber eat delivery two peri peri burgers and two wraps,taste was good but presentation was not really good.from them we ordered on 30/01/2023 they change there presentation and get better so that’s good move from them.peri peri grill full chicken taste really good,its cost £10.00 with fries good deal on Uber eats they have deals buy one get one free peri peri wraps and burger 🍔 so 2 wraps £5.49 and 2 peri burger£5.49 so really good deal.👍👌thank you

Having seen a good overall rating here, I was encouraged to try out the food here.
I ordered, via Uber, for delivery.
I put in an order for a grilled peri chicken wrap with some peri fries and a drink.

Strangely, the order took a considerable amount of time. I contacted the driver responsible for the delivery after I was getting concerned how long the order was taking to arrive. 45mins had passed and the tracker showed the driver in a random area nowhere near the shop. The driver hadn’t moved towards to the shop at all since being assigned.
The driver refused to answer my calls and even cut me off each time I tried to. I messaged and the driver claimed there was an error on the map and that they were on their way to deliver.
1.5 hours had elapsed and there was still no sign of the driver. After multiple messages of queries, the driver simply stopped responding.
The order couldn’t be cancelled as it was in process and officially assigned to a driver who had gone AWOL.
Suddenly, after almost 2 hours, a new driver was assigned and seemed to have collected the order and was on their way.
The food was finally delivered, the new driver apologised and mentioned that they did not know what happened with the previous driver.

So, finally, on to the food. Well, after working up a huge appetite by this point, one would hope this was going to be worth it.
However, once I opened up the box, it did not look promising. This meal cost approx. £13. The size of the wrap was quite small and certainly looking terrible in the face of its fast-food competitors. The portion of the chips also tiny - see images.
The taste of the chicken wrap was not bad, was flavoured fine although not as tender as it could have been. The chips were terrible. Undercooked, soggy with no flavour at all. Not to mention they weren’t peri fries, just regular fries - so they got the order partially wrong too.

Now you could say that, quality of food aside, it was not Grill House’s with the delivery.
However, delving deeper in to the reviews there is an recurring theme where customers have had to wait an extremely long time before getting their food, facing similar issues with Uber drivers. There’s something clearly not quite right with this establishment.

The portion of the food, and the quality of it simply does not match up to £13(!). There are a plethora of fast food places in the vicinity alone that can give you a good meal that is value for money.

I have had poor food experiences previously, but I am always reluctant to not recommend a place as it may just have been my experience alone.
However, on this occasion, referring to the negative reviews and similar issues faced I would recommend customers to think well before ordering from here. Not just delivery issues alone but food quality, portion and value-for-money as well.

On the whole, a really terrible experience and, unless there are drastic changes to the service and food quality, I certainly don’t see myself ordering here again.
I do hope they treat the negative reviews seriously and make drastic changes to their setup.

Also, a lesson to myself to delve a little deeper into the reviews rather than taking it at face value.

Ordered a mixed grill, payed £19.75 to receive just two uncooked lamb shop and 6 chicken wings.
They called me asking if it's ok to send chicken wings instead of chicken kebab But send just an extra wings and no lamb kebab.
Tried to call them but the landline is not working.
Very dispointed.

Ordered from Uber eat they were delayed by 10 mins but once the food arrived it was delicious. Peri whole chicken drenched in their sauce and meat was juicy and tender how it should be. Great burgers and wraps as well. Well done guys 👏

The food tasted pretty much exactly like Nando's. Very spacious indoor seating arrangement, and service was fast. Portions were large and overall it was a great experience. Would highly recommend. Grill house have nice downstairs hall where we celebrate our son birthdays party . Its so amazing and nice . Would like to go again and again thanks Grill house for delicious food for ilford .

venues.name: Paradise Romford
